text: M7 Chapter 10 Financial Forecasts and Business Planning — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct answer: C (Notes payable) Model answer: In the percent of sales method, accounts that vary directly with sales (cash, accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable, and — at full capacity — net fixed assets) are projected as a percentage of sales. Notes payable, long term debt and common stock are marked 'n/a': they change only when management decides to borrow, repay, issue or repurchase, so the current year's value is carried into the preliminary pro forma statement. The resulting imbalance is the plug value, usually the external funding needed (EFN). 【解題思路】 關鍵考點係「自發性 vs 酌情性賬項」：銷售上升會自然帶動應收賬款、存貨、應付賬款同現金，但 notes payable 只會因管理層主動借貸或還款先變。 A (Accounts payable) 錯：應付賬款隨銷售自發增加（賣得多→入貨多），係自發性資金來源，會減少 EFN。 B (Inventory) 錯：存貨係營運資金賬項，歷史數據顯示維持在銷售的固定百分比，必須隨銷售預測上調。 D (Accounts receivable) 錯：賒銷增加自然推高應收賬款，同樣以銷售百分比預測。 記住初步 pro forma 中「n/a」三兄弟：notes payable、long term debt、common stock；retained earnings 就從 pro forma 損益表嘅 addition to retained earnings 推算。 Question 2 — Correct answer: B Model answer: Project FCF is computed on a 'stand alone' basis excluding financing effects. Interest expense is excluded because (1) it isolates the cash flows generated by the project itself, and (2) the cost of debt and equity financing — including the tax impact of debt — is already captured in the discount rate used in the NPV analysis. Project taxes are computed as EBIT × the company's marginal tax rate (taxes owed as if no debt financed the project), because project profits are incremental to existing profits. 【解題思路】 A 錯：扣利息會同折現率重複計算融資成本；而且項目稅項應用 邊際稅率 (marginal tax rate) ，唔係平均稅率。 C 錯：利息稅務扣減 (interest tax shield) 嘅效果已反映喺折現率入面，唔應再放入項目 FCF。 D 錯：折舊雖然係非現金支出，但係可以扣稅——正確做法係先扣 D&A 計稅（EBIT × (1−t)），再加回 D&A 得出 CF Opns；唔可以喺計稅時剔除折舊。 口訣：「融資入折現率，稅用邊際率，折舊先扣後加回」。 Question 3 — Correct answer: B Model answer (working): Contribution margin per unit = Price − Unit VC = 200 − 120 = HK$80 Pre tax operating cash flow (EBITDA) break even = FC / CM = 24,000 / 80 = 300 units Accounting operating profit (EBIT) break even = (FC + D&A) / CM = (24,000 + 6,000) / 80 = 375 units The EBIT break even is higher because D&A is added to the numerator. 【解題思路】 第一步問自己：分子包唔包 D&A？EBITDA break even（pre tax operating cash flow）只放 FC = 24,000，所以 300 單位；EBIT break even（accounting operating profit）要放 FC + D&A = 30,000，所以 375 單位。 A 錯：375 係 EBIT break even，唔係 EBITDA break even——調轉咗。 C 錯：300 係 EBITDA break even；會計利潤打和要連折舊攤銷一齊 cover，必定較高。 D 錯：EBITDA break even 分子較細，單位數一定 低過 EBIT break even，唔會高過。 本題剛好係整數，唔使進位；如遇小數（例如 166.67）記住向上進位到下一個整單位。 Question 4 — Correct answer: FCF = HK$1,400,000 Model answer (full working): Step Item HK$ Revenue 9,000,000 − Op Ex (6,000,000) = EBITDA 3,000,000 − D&A (1,000,000) = EBIT 2,000,000 × (1 − t) × (1 − 0.25) = 0.75 = NOPAT 1,500,000 + D&A 1,000,000 = CF Opns 2,500,000 − Cap Exp (800,000) − Add WC (300,000) = FCF 1,400,000 Equivalently: FCF = [(9,000,000 − 6,000,000 − 1,000,000) × 0.75] + 1,000,000 − 800,000 − 300,000 = 1,500,000 + 1,000,000 − 1,100,000 = HK$1,400,000. 【解題思路】 跟足 FCF 鏈：EBITDA → EBIT → NOPAT → 加回 D&A → CF Opns → 減 Cap Exp 同 Add WC。 常見錯誤 1：唔記得加回 D&A——折舊係非現金，扣完稅之後要加返，否則會少計 HK$1,000,000，錯答 HK$400,000。 常見錯誤 2：用 EBITDA（3,000,000）而唔係 EBIT（2,000,000）嚟計稅——稅應該係 EBIT × 25% = 500,000，唔係 750,000。 常見錯誤 3：忘記減增量營運資金 (Add WC)——Cap Ex 同 Add WC 都係必要投資，兩者都要扣，漏扣會錯答 HK$1,700,000。 考試貼士：呢類題目 2.5 分鐘內要搞掂，畫返條鏈出嚟逐行填數最穩陣。 Question 5 — Correct answer: EFN = HK$84,000 Model answer (full working): 1. Forecast sales: S₁ = 5,000,000 × 1.20 = HK$6,000,000; increase in sales ΔS = HK$1,000,000 2. Increase in assets required = 50% × ΔS = 0.50 × 1,000,000 = HK$500,000 3. Spontaneous increase in accounts payable = 8% × ΔS = 0.08 × 1,000,000 = HK$80,000 4. Projected taxable income = 6,000,000 × (1 − 0.80) = HK$1,200,000 5. Projected net income = 1,200,000 × (1 − 0.30) = HK$840,000 6. Addition to retained earnings = 840,000 × (1 − 0.60) = 840,000 × 0.40 = HK$336,000 7. EFN = Increase in assets − Spontaneous increase in AP − Addition to retained earnings = 500,000 − 80,000 − 336,000 = HK$84,000 【解題思路】 EFN 邏輯 = plug value：新資產需求（500,000）先由自發資金填——應付賬款增加（80,000）同留存盈利增加（336,000）——唔夠嘅部分先要靠外部融資。 常見錯誤 1：用舊銷售 5,000,000 而唔係新銷售 6,000,000 嚟計淨利——派息同留存係基於 預測年度 嘅盈利。 常見錯誤 2：用 payout ratio (60%) 而唔係 retention ratio (40%) 計留存增加——留存增加 = 淨利 × (1 − payout)，用錯會得 840,000 × 0.6 = 504,000，EFN 變成負數。 常見錯誤 3：以全部資產 (50% × 6,000,000 = 3,000,000) 做分子——EFN 只關心 增量 (50% × ΔS)。 常見錯誤 4：忘記扣自發增加嘅應付賬款——AP 係免費嘅自發資金來源，會減少外部融資需求。 考試貼士：EFN 三部曲——「資產增量 − 自發負債增量 − 留存盈利增量」，記住呢條式就唔會亂。

text: M7 Chapter 10 Financial Forecasts and Business Planning — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Question 1 (MCQ) Dragon Retail Ltd is preparing a preliminary pro forma statement of financial position using the percent of sales method for a forecast 25% sales increase. Which of the following accounts should be carried at its current (unchanged) value in the preliminary pro forma statement because it changes only in response to management's financing decisions? A. Accounts payable B. Inventory C. Notes payable D. Accounts receivable Question 2 (MCQ) Harbour Manufacturing Ltd is estimating the incremental after tax free cash flow of a new project that will be partly financed with bank debt. Which of the following treatments is correct in the FCF calculation? A. Deduct the interest expense on the bank debt from the project's revenue, and apply the company's average tax rate to taxable income B. Exclude interest expense because financing costs are reflected in the discount rate, and compute project taxes as EBIT multiplied by the company's marginal tax rate C. Include the tax saving from interest deductibility in the project's free cash flow, since debt financing is used D. Exclude depreciation from the tax computation because it is a non cash charge Question 3 (MCQ) Pacific Toys Ltd has fixed costs of HK$24,000 per year, depreciation and amortisation of HK$6,000 per year, a unit selling price of HK$200 and a unit variable cost of HK$120. Which of the following statements is correct? A. The pre tax operating cash flow (EBITDA) break even point is 375 units B. The pre tax operating cash flow (EBITDA) break even point is 300 units and the accounting operating profit (EBIT) break even point is 375 units C. The accounting operating profit (EBIT) break even point is 300 units D. The pre tax operating cash flow (EBITDA) break even point is higher than the accounting operating profit (EBIT) break even point Question 4 (Objective calculation) Lantau Electronics Ltd is evaluating a new project. Incremental revenue is HK$9,000,000 per year; incremental cash operating expenses are HK$6,000,000 per year; incremental depreciation and amortisation is HK$1,000,000 per year; incremental capital expenditure is HK$800,000; incremental additions to working capital are HK$300,000. The company's marginal tax rate is 25%. Calculate the project's incremental after tax free cash flow (FCF) for the year. (Show your answer in HK$.) Question 5 (Objective calculation) Kowloon Trading Ltd's current net sales are HK$5,000,000 and are forecast to grow by 20% next year. Total assets vary with sales at 50% of sales; accounts payable vary with sales at 8% of sales; total costs are 80% of sales; the average tax rate is 30%; and the company pays out 60% of net income as dividends (no other liability or equity account changes). Calculate the external funding needed (EFN) for next year. (Show your answer in HK$.)

text: M7 Chapter 10 Financial Forecasts and Business Planning — Study Pack (Week 9) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 現金流是企業命脈 (cash flow is the life blood) ：企業透過生產性資產 (productive assets) 銷售貨品或服務產生現金流；支付營運開支、債權人及稅項後剩餘的稱為剩餘現金流 (residual cash flows)，可用作派息 (cash dividends)、回購股份 (share repurchase) 或再投資 (reinvestment)——再投資是企業增長最根本的方式。 資本預算與增量自由現金流 (capital budgeting & incremental after tax free cash flows, FCF) ：項目評估只計算「有項目」與「無項目」之間公司總稅後自由現金流的差額 (FCF_project = FCF_firm with project − FCF_firm without project)，並應用獨立原則 (stand alone principle) 把項目視為獨立公司分析；利息開支不包括在內，因為融資成本已反映在折現率 (discount rate) 中。 財務規劃模型與預計財務報表 (financial planning model & pro forma financial statements) ：模型由三大元件組成——輸入 (inputs：現行財務報表、銷售預測、投資及財務政策決定)、模型本身 (the model itself)、輸出 (outputs：pro forma 報表、財務比率、現金預算)；銷售預測 (sales forecast) 是最主要的驅動變數。 銷售百分比法與外部融資需求 (percent of sales method & external funding needed, EFN) ：編製初步預計財務狀況表 (preliminary pro forma statement of financial position) 時，隨銷售變動的賬項以銷售百分比預測，報表不平衡的差額即「plug value」，通常就是 EFN。 業務規劃工具 (business planning tools) ：現金流收支平衡分析 (cash flow break even) 與現金預算 (cash budget) 用於掌握企業現金需求；商業計劃書 (business plan) 則是集資、設定目標、績效基準及對內外溝通的路線圖 (road map)。 2. 必背考點清單 A. 增量自由現金流 (Incremental Free Cash Flow, FCF) Revenue = 項目的增量收入 (incremental revenue / net sales) Op Ex = 增量現金營運開支 (cash operating expenses) D&A = 增量折舊及攤銷 (depreciation & amortisation)——非現金支出，可扣稅但須加回 t = 公司的 邊際稅率 (marginal tax rate) （因項目利潤屬增量，故用邊際稅率計算稅項） Cap Exp = 增量資本開支 (incremental capital expenditures：長期有形及無形資產) Add WC = 增量營運資金增加 (incremental additions to working capital：accounts receivable、inventory 減 accounts payable 等) 推導鏈：Revenue − Op Ex = EBITDA ；EBITDA − D&A = EBIT ；EBIT × (1 − t) = NOPAT ；NOPAT + D&A = CF Opns （現金流量來自營運）；CF Opns − Cap Exp − Add WC = FCF 關鍵規則 ：項目的稅項 = EBIT × marginal tax rate（假設無債務融資）；利息開支及融資現金流 不計入 FCF，因為已反映在折現率內。不變的固定成本 (fixed costs payable regardless) 不屬增量，不納入計算。 B. 間接法營運現金流 (Operating Cash Flow, indirect method) 由應計制淨利 (accrual net income) 轉為現金基礎： 資產增加須減去、資產減少須加回；負債減少須減去、負債增加須加回 ；再加回折舊 (depreciation)。 例：OCF = Net income 100,000 − ΔAR 50,000 + ΔInventory 20,000 − ΔAP 25,000 + Depreciation 10,000 = HK$55,000。 C. 銷售增長率 (Sales growth) D. 派息與留存比率 (Payout & Retention ratios) E. 資本密集比率 (Capital intensity ratio) 即 total asset turnover 的倒數；比率越高，每 HK$1 銷售所需資產越多，公司越資本密集、風險越高（高固定成本在銷售下跌時令利潤急跌）。 F. 銷售百分比法 (Percent of sales method) 與 EFN 隨銷售直接變動的賬項 (vary directly with sales)：cash、accounts receivable、inventory、accounts payable、net fixed assets（ 僅在公司滿負荷運作 full capacity 且固定資產可小額遞增時 才成立）。 不隨銷售變動 (n/a) ：notes payable、long term debt、common stock（由管理層融資決定）；retained earnings 由盈利及股息政策決定，從 pro forma 損益表推算。 初步 pro forma 財務狀況表不平衡的差額 = plug value = External Funding Needed (EFN) ；資金來源次序：內部保留盈利 (addition to retained earnings) + 自發增加的貿易信貸 (increase in accounts payable) + 外部融資 (debt or equity)。 財務模型只產生數字， 最終融資決策由管理層作出 。 G. 收支平衡分析 (Break even analysis) 計算收支平衡 單位數必須向上進位 (round up to the next whole unit)。 焦點：最大化每單位邊際貢獻 (maximise per unit contribution)、最小化經常開支 (minimise overheads)。 H. 現金預算與商業計劃書 (Cash budget & Business plan) Cash budget：按月 (monthly basis) 列示現金流入流出，顯示資金來源與去向，協助及早籌資。 Business plan 的作用：集資 (raise capital)、設定目標 (set goals/objectives)、績效評估基準 (benchmark for evaluating and controlling performance)、與利益相關者溝通 (communicate ideas to stakeholders)。 典型內容：executive summary、company overview、products & services description、market analysis、marketing & sales activities、operations、management team & organisational structure、ownership structure、capital requirements、歷史財務業績 + 財務預測 + pro forma 報表 + 未來兩三年逐月現金預算 (month by month cash budget for two or three years)、appendices。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1: 自發性賬項 (spontaneous, vary with sales) vs 酌情性賬項 (discretionary, n/a) 對比點 自發性賬項 (e.g. accounts payable, inventory, accounts receivable) 酌情性賬項 (e.g. notes payable, long term debt, common stock) 變動原因 銷售增加自然帶動（賣得多→入貨多→應付賬款多） 只隨管理層融資/派息決策改變 Percent of sales 處理 以銷售百分比預測 初步 pro forma 中維持現值 (enter current year's value) 與 EFN 的關係 增加屬內部/自發資金來源， 減少 EFN 是填補 plug value 的 外部融資渠道 例子：Wong Sales 銷售增 30%，accounts payable 由 60 升至 104（+44，自發資金）；notes payable 及 long term debt 在初步報表中維持不變，最後不平衡的 85 才是要靠發債或發股填補的 EFN。考生常誤把 notes payable 當作隨銷售變動，或忘記 retained earnings 要從 pro forma 損益表的 addition to retained earnings 推算。 Pitfall 2: 稅前經營現金流收支平衡 (EBITDA break even) vs 會計經營利潤收支平衡 (EBIT break even) 對比點 EBITDA break even EBIT break even 分子 FC 只有固定成本 FC + D&A（連折舊攤銷） 衡量 現金角度：要賣幾多先 cover 到現金開支 會計利潤角度：EBIT = 0 單位數 較 低 較 高 （分子多了 D&A） 例子：FC = HK$15,000、D&A = HK$3,000、Price = HK$250、Unit VC = HK$160：EBITDA break even = 15,000/90 = 167 單位；EBIT break even = 18,000/90 = 200 單位。考生常錯在把 D&A 加入 EBITDA break even 的分子，或忘記單位要向上進位。 考試貼士：OTQ 見到 break even 題目，第一步先問自己「分子包唔包 D&A？」——題目寫 pre tax operating cash flow / EBITDA 就只放 FC；寫 accounting operating profit / EBIT 就放 FC + D&A。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): State the formula for incremental after tax free cash flow (FCF) for a project and define each component. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: FCF = [(Revenue − Op Ex − D&A) × (1 − t)] + D&A − Cap Exp − Add WC Revenue = incremental net sales; Op Ex = incremental cash operating expenses D&A = incremental depreciation & amortisation (non cash, tax deductible, added back) t = the company's marginal tax rate (applied to EBIT to get NOPAT) Cap Exp = incremental capital expenditures (long term tangible & intangible assets) Add WC = incremental additions to working capital (AR, inventory, AP) Chain: EBITDA → EBIT → NOPAT (= EBIT × (1−t)) → CF Opns (= NOPAT + D&A) → FCF [中文白話解釋]: 計項目的自由現金流，先將增量收入減現金營運開支得出 EBITDA，再減折舊攤銷得出 EBIT，乘以 (1 − 邊際稅率) 得出 NOPAT；由於折舊攤銷並非真實現金流出，要加回去得到營運現金流，最後減去增量資本開支和增量營運資金，就是可以自由分配給債權人和股東的 FCF。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): Why are interest expenses and financing cash flows excluded from a project's FCF calculation, and which tax rate is used for project taxes? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Interest is excluded to isolate the cash flows generated by the project itself from how it is financed The cost of debt and equity financing (including the tax effect of debt) is already reflected in the discount rate used in NPV analysis Project taxes = EBIT × the company's marginal tax rate, i.e. taxes owed if no debt is used Marginal rate is used because project profits are incremental to profits the firm already has This makes it easier to estimate NPV under alternative financing structures [中文白話解釋]: 評估項目時故意不理會融資安排，因為借錢的利息和稅務好處已經反映在折現率（cost of capital）裏面，如果再在現金流扣利息就會重複計算。項目稅項用邊際稅率乘 EBIT 計算，因為項目利潤是在公司現有利潤之上的「額外」利潤。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): In the percent of sales method, which statement of financial position accounts vary directly with sales, and which do not? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Vary with sales (spontaneous): cash, accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable; net fixed assets only if the firm operates at full capacity and assets can be added in small increments Do NOT vary with sales (marked 'n/a'): notes payable, long term debt, common stock — these change only through management financing decisions Retained earnings: derived from the pro forma statement of profit or loss (addition to retained earnings), depends on earnings and dividend payout policy Forecast percentages are set by analysing 4–5 years of historical data as a % of sales and spotting trends [中文白話解釋]: 銷售百分比法下，營運資金賬項（現金、應收、存貨、應付）自然跟銷售同步變動；但票據、長期債、股本只會因管理層主動借錢、還錢、發股而改變，所以初步預測時標記 n/a 並維持原值。保留盈利則要從預計損益表的留存盈利增加額推算。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): What is the 'plug value' in a preliminary pro forma statement of financial position, and how is external funding needed (EFN) interpreted? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: The preliminary pro forma SOFP normally does not balance; the balancing difference is the plug value The plug value is usually the external funding needed (EFN): growth requires new assets, so total assets exceed total liabilities plus equity Funding hierarchy: (1) addition to retained earnings (internal funds), (2) increase in accounts payable (expanded trade credit), (3) external debt or equity (EFN) Options to close the gap: issue debt, issue equity, cut dividends, or scale back the growth target Financial models compute the number, but management makes the final funding decision [中文白話解釋]: 初步預計財務狀況表一定唔會平衡，差額就是 plug value，通常等於公司要向外籌幾多錢（EFN）。資金先用內部留存盈利，再靠應付賬款自然增加，唔夠先至發債或發股；管理層亦可以減派息或調低增長目標嚟縮小缺口。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): A company pays HK$163,961.60 of dividends on net income of HK$298,112. Calculate the dividend payout ratio and the retention (plowback) ratio. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Dividend payout ratio = Cash dividends / Net income = 163,961.60 / 298,112 = 55% Retention (plowback) ratio = Addition to retained earnings / Net income = 1 − 0.55 = 45% Payout ratio + retention ratio = 1 (every dollar of net income is either paid out or retained) Smaller, fast growing companies retain more; mature, slower growth companies pay out more [中文白話解釋]: 派息比率 = 股息 ÷ 淨利 = 55%；留存比率 = 1 − 55% = 45%，兩者相加必定等於 1，因為每一元淨利不是派出去就是留低。高速增長公司通常留存多啲錢去再投資。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): Excellent Traders has total assets of HK$513,480 and sales of HK$723,062. Calculate the capital intensity ratio and interpret it. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Capital intensity ratio = Total assets / Net sales = 513,480 / 723,062 = 0.71 It is the inverse of the total asset turnover ratio Interpretation: the firm needs HK$0.71 of assets to generate each HK$1 of sales Higher ratio → more capital intensive → higher fixed costs/depreciation → riskier when sales fall [中文白話解釋]: 資本密集比率 = 總資產 ÷ 淨銷售 = 0.71，即每 HK$1 銷售需要 HK$0.71 資產支持。呢個比率係總資產周轉率嘅倒數；比率越高代表公司越重資產、固定成本越高，銷售一跌利潤就跌得好快。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): A product line raises fixed costs to HK$35,000; each unit sells for HK$600 and costs HK$390 to produce. Compute the pre tax operating cash flow (EBITDA) break even point, and state how the accounting (EBIT) break even would differ if D&A were HK$4,200. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Contribution margin per unit = 600 − 390 = HK$210 EBITDA break even = FC / (Price − Unit VC) = 35,000 / 210 = 166.67 → round up = 167 units EBIT (accounting) break even = (FC + D&A) / CM = (35,000 + 4,200) / 210 = 186.67 → 187 units EBIT break even is always higher because D&A is added to the numerator Always round break even units UP to the next whole unit [中文白話解釋]: 每賣一個單位賺 HK$210 邊際貢獻；現金流角度只需 cover 固定成本 35,000，所以 167 個單位打和；如果計會計利潤打和，分子要加埋折舊攤銷，變成 187 個單位。記住單位數一律向上進位。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): What are the roles of a business plan, and list the main components of a well thought out business plan. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Roles: raise capital (convince outside investors), set goals and objectives, serve as a benchmark for evaluating and controlling performance, communicate ideas to managers, directors, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders; a road map for set up, survival and expansion Components: executive summary; company overview & comparative advantages; detailed products/services description (state of development, competitive advantages, product life cycle); market analysis; marketing & sales activities; operations & distribution; management team & organisational structure; ownership structure; capital requirements; historical financial results, forecasts, pro forma statements and a month by month cash budget for 2–3 years; appendices NOT included: employees' personal information (privacy) [中文白話解釋]: 商業計劃書既是集資工具（說服外部投資者），又是公司路線圖：訂目標、做績效基準、對內外溝通。內容由行政摘要開始，涵蓋公司、產品、市場、營銷、營運、管理團隊、股權、資金需求及財務預測（連兩三年逐月現金預算）；員工個人私隱資料就唔會放入去。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md

title: M7 Chapter 11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！）

Question 1 — Correct Answer: **C (Economic order quantity (EOQ) model)**
Question 2 — Correct Answer: **D (Repairing products returned by customers under warranty undertakings)**
Question 3 — Correct Answer: **B**
Question 4 — Correct Answer: **Target cost = HK$199.20 per unit**
Question 5 — Correct Answer: **ROI = 15%**
excerpt: M7 Chapter 11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C (Economic order quantity (EOQ) model) Model An…
text: M7 Chapter 11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C (Economic order quantity (EOQ) model) Model Answer (English): The EOQ model defines and determines the optimal inventory level as the one that minimises both shortage costs and carrying costs. It identifies the point at which carrying costs (storage, financing, insurance, spoilage) and shortage costs are the same. Because the model assumes items are sold at the same rate throughout the year, it suits this component's constant sales profile. 【解題思路】 題目關鍵字：「optimal quantity」、「holding costs offset shortage costs」、「constant rate throughout the year」——三個都係 EOQ 嘅 signature。EOQ 模型假設全年銷售速率一致，正好配合題目設定。 A (JIT) 錯 ：JIT 係「貨品在需要時才送達、近乎零存貨」，重點係 timing 同供應商關係，唔係計算「最優訂貨量」嘅成本最小化模型。 B (MRP) 錯 ：MRP 係電腦化系統，令存貨配合 production schedules ，按訂單量推算原材料需求；題目無提及生產排程，只有穩定銷售同成本抵銷。 D (Product life cycle costing) 錯 ：呢個係由產品構思到終止追蹤成本收入嘅長期成本法，同存貨訂貨量無關——典型「風馬牛」distractor。 考試貼士：scenario 題見到「minimise carrying + shortage costs」直覺揀 EOQ；見到「production schedule」揀 MRP；見到「exactly when needed」揀 JIT。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: D (Repairing products returned by customers under warranty undertakings) Model Answer (English): External failure costs are costs incurred in remedying defects discovered by customers AFTER delivery. They include handling customer complaints, repairing products at customers' premises or returned to the company, meeting warranty undertakings, and transport/handling costs arising from returns or recalls. Warranty repairs on returned products are therefore an external failure cost. 【解題思路】 分界線：缺陷係「交付顧客之後」先被發現 → external failure。題目 "returned by customers under warranty" 明顯係交付後。 A 錯 ：TQM training 係 Prevention cost （防止問題發生，屬設計/實施/運作品質系統嘅開支）。 B 錯 ：Audits of quality systems 係 Appraisal cost （檢查監察是否符合規格），唔係 failure cost。 C 錯 ：Rework before delivery 係 Internal failure cost ——呢個係最強 distractor，同 D 只係差「交付前 vs 交付後」一線。「考官報告指出」考生喺 COQ 分類題最常混淆 internal 同 external failure：記住分界線係產品離開公司嗰一刻。 口訣：「預防、鑑定 = 主動付出；內部 = 出廠前出事；外部 = 客戶手上出事。」 Question 3 — Correct Answer: B Model Answer (English): SMA is meant to combine internal and external attributes and to realise the objectives of the organisation through projections and analysis. Unlike traditional management accounting (which focuses on internal metrics), SMA considers external information such as cost trends, prices, market share of the company and its competitors, cash flows and access to resources, generating forward looking projections and models. 【解題思路】 B 完整咁講出 SMA 嘅本質：internal + external、forward looking、實現組織目標——同原文 SMA 定義逐點對應。 A 錯 ："internally focused + quantifies all information + implementing strategies" 描述嘅其實係 傳統 management accounting 嘅角色（SMA 制訂策略、傳統 MA 執行）——呢個 distractor 專登將兩者調轉，考你識唔識分。 C 錯 ：編製 statement of financial position 同 statement of profit or loss 俾外部使用者係 financial accounting 嘅職能，同 SMA 無關。 D 錯 ："expansion of cost accounting" 同 "focus on a single issue (cost, volume or profit) for a single fiscal period" 都係 management accounting 嘅起源同特徵；SMA 恰恰係考慮一連串決策、跨多個期間、著重競爭環境。 考試貼士：呢類「邊句最準確描述 X」題，三個 distractor 通常各自偷換做另一個會計分支（MA / FA / cost accounting）——將四個分支嘅 focus 列成表背熟就萬無一失。 Question 4 — Correct Answer: Target cost = HK$199.20 per unit Model Answer (English): Working (target costing — Exhibit 11.2: Market price − Desired profit = Target cost): Step 1: Desired profit = 20% × HK$249 = HK$49.80 per unit Step 2: Target cost = Market price − Desired profit = HK$249 − HK$49.80 = HK$199.20 per unit The company must design and produce the rice cooker at HK$199.20 or less (covering all production costs over its entire life cycle), otherwise it will fail to achieve the desired 20% profit margin. 【解題思路】 第一步：認清 target costing 係「倒推」——市場價已定（HK$249，因競爭激烈公司無法定價），利潤係 "20% on the selling price "，所以 desired profit = 0.20 × 249 = 49.80。 第二步：Target cost = 249 − 49.80 = 199.20 。 常見錯誤 1：將 20% 當成 cost plus mark up （成本加成），即 target cost × 1.20 = 249 → 207.50。題目講明 "on the selling price"，基準係售價唔係成本，所以 207.50 係錯。 常見錯誤 2：直接用 249 × 20% = 49.80 當答案——呢個係 profit 唔係 target cost，記住公式 Market price − Desired profit = Target cost，要行多一步減。 考試貼士：呢類題 30 秒內要搞掂；寫低公式再代入，數字眼（HK$199、HK$249 呢類 price points）正正係原文 target pricing 概念嘅例子。 Question 5 — Correct Answer: ROI = 15% Model Answer (English): Working (throughput analysis — three formulas): Step 1: Throughput = Revenue − Totally variable expenses = HK$4,800,000 − HK$1,200,000 = HK$3,600,000 Step 2: Net profit = Throughput − Operating expenses = HK$3,600,000 − HK$2,600,000 = HK$1,000,000 Step 3: ROI = Net profit ÷ Investment = HK$1,000,000 ÷ HK$4,000,000 = 0.15 = 15% 【解題思路】 嚴格跟三條公式行：Throughput = Revenue − Totally variable expenses（題目已直接俾咗，唔使自己判斷邊啲係變動）→ 3,600,000。 Net profit = Throughput − Operating expenses = 3,600,000 − 2,600,000 = 1,000,000。 ROI = Net profit ÷ Investment = 1,000,000 ÷ 4,000,000 = 15%。 常見錯誤 1：喺 Step 1 將 operating expenses 都當變動成本扣埋（4,800,000 − 1,200,000 − 2,600,000 當 throughput）——咁樣 Step 2 會變成零，邏輯崩壞。記住 throughput 只減 totally variable expenses。 常見錯誤 2：ROI 用 Throughput ÷ Investment（3,600,000 ÷ 4,000,000 = 90%）——公式係 Net profit ÷ Investment，唔係 throughput。 常見錯誤 3：答案寫 0.15 而唔寫 15%——題目要求 "express as a percentage"，格式都要分。 考試貼士：Throughput analysis 下，改善決策首選 提高 throughput （無理論上限），其次先係 cut operating expenses（最多減到零）；呢個概念點好容易變成獨立 MCQ。

text: M7 Chapter 11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 「限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位）」 Question 1 (MCQ — technique classification) Harbour Electronics Ltd wants to determine the optimal quantity of a component to order each time. The component sells at a constant rate throughout the year, and management wants to find the order quantity at which the costs of holding the component (storage, financing, insurance and spoilage) exactly offset the costs of running short of it. Which inventory management approach is MOST appropriate? A. Just in time (JIT) inventory system B. Materials requirement planning (MRP) C. Economic order quantity (EOQ) model D. Product life cycle costing Question 2 (MCQ — cost of quality classification) Which of the following is classified as an EXTERNAL failure cost under cost of quality (COQ) theory? A. Training employees to implement and maintain a total quality management (TQM) scheme B. Auditing the quality systems to ensure they meet previously agreed specifications C. Reworking defective materials identified before the products are delivered to customers D. Repairing products returned by customers under warranty undertakings Question 3 (MCQ — framework discrimination) Which of the following statements BEST describes strategic management accounting (SMA)? A. SMA is an internally focused system that quantifies all information and is best suited to implementing strategies developed elsewhere B. SMA combines internal and external attributes — such as competitors' cost trends, prices and market share — to realise the organisation's objectives through forward looking projections and analysis C. SMA is the branch of accounting responsible for producing the statement of financial position and the statement of profit or loss for external users D. SMA originated as an expansion of cost accounting and focuses on a single issue such as cost, volume or profit for a single fiscal period Question 4 (Calculation — target costing) Dragon Appliances Ltd can only sell its new rice cooker at the market driven price of HK$249 per unit because of intense competition. The company requires a profit margin of 20% on the selling price. Calculate the target cost per unit (in HK$, to two decimal places if necessary). Question 5 (Calculation — throughput analysis) Peak Manufacturing Ltd reports the following for the year: revenue HK$4,800,000; totally variable expenses HK$1,200,000; operating expenses HK$2,600,000; investment in additional production capacity HK$4,000,000. Using throughput analysis, calculate the return on investment (ROI) (express as a percentage). Answers: see M7_Ch11_Strategic_Mgmt_Accounting_Answers.md

text: M7 Chapter 11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework — Study Pack (Week 10) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 Strategic Management Accounting (SMA) 的定位 ：SMA 將企業的策略目標 (strategic business objectives) 與管理會計 (management accounting) 產生的資訊結合，產生前瞻性 (forward looking) 的預測與模型。傳統管理會計著重內部指標 (internal metrics)、內省式 (introspective)；SMA 則著重外部資訊如成本趨勢 (cost trends)、價格、市場佔有率 (market share)、競爭者 (competitors)、供應商 (suppliers) 及科技 (technologies)。 SMA 的三角架構 (triangular structure) 與 QCT ：SMA 有三大考量——技術分析 (technical analysis)、行為考量 (behavioural considerations)、文化考量 (cultural considerations)；並以品質 (Quality)、成本 (Cost)、時間 (Time) 三因素 (QCT) 檢視，作為企業在市場中脫穎而出的關鍵。 會計各分支之連結 (linkages) ：財務會計 (financial accounting) 負責編製財務報表（statement of financial position、statement of profit or loss），以過去為主；成本會計 (cost accounting) 分析各生產階段的產品成本；管理會計結合兩者支援規劃 (planning)、控制 (control) 與績效評估 (performance evaluation)；SMA 再進一步把結論用於策略決策 (strategic decisions)。董事會 (board of directors) 訂立使命 (mission)、願景 (vision) 與長期目標 (goals)，高級管理層 (senior management) 據此制訂策略計劃 (strategic plans)，經由戰術 (tactics) 落實並以年度預算 (annual budgets) 量化。 業務規劃流程 (business planning process) 五步驟 ：制訂策略 → 估計收入、開支及其他財務變數 → 編製營運預算 (operating budget) → 分析潛在風險與偏差 (risks and deviations) → 監察及檢討績效與結果 (monitor and review)。規劃是持續過程 (ongoing process)，需考慮最差至最佳情境 (worst case to best case scenario)。 七大策略成本管理技術 (strategic cost management techniques) ：JIT、TQM、product life cycle costing、target costing、quality costing、theory of constraints (TOC)、throughput analysis。本章計算重點集中於 target costing 與 throughput analysis 三條公式。 2. 必背考點清單 A. SMA 核心概念 SMA 定義：結合策略目標與管理會計資訊，產生 forward looking projections and models 以支援決策；同時考慮內部因素與外部因素（競爭者、供應商、科技、市場佔有率、成本結構、公司規模、財務資源、產品特點等「position」）。 SMA 三角架構三考量：(1) Technical analysis（針對特定事件的資訊）；(2) Behavioural considerations（達成目標的最佳路徑）；(3) Cultural considerations（組織內共同信念 shared beliefs）。 QCT：Quality、Cost、Time——企業用以在市場中區隔自己，並與顧客偏好及市場需求對照（例：McDonald's 自 1970s 起以 QCT 為業務及營運策略）。 SMA 與傳統管理會計的關鍵差異：著重競爭環境 (competitive conditions)；考慮一連串決策與模式 (sequence of decisions and patterns)，而非單一議題（cost, volume or profit）。 Management accounting 起源：是 cost accounting 的擴展 (expansion of cost accounting)。 SMA 當前議題 (current issues)：全球化 (globalisation) 下的供應鏈風險管理 (supply chain risk management)；SMA 與傳統管理會計的協調 (coordination)；「價值」不限於財務衡量——包括 ESG 影響、品牌忠誠度 (brand loyalty)、消費者意見等無法以金錢量化的非財務議題。SMA 並非要取代 (replacement) 傳統管理會計：SMA 制訂前瞻策略，傳統管理會計負責落實執行。 Behavioural finance 小考點：risk aversion = 不喜歡波動（向上或向下）；loss aversion = 不喜歡價值下降；過度看重近期資訊 = anchoring behaviour。 B. Business Planning Process（Exhibit 11.1 五步驟，必背順序） 1. Develop a strategy（由董事會或高級管理層制訂；策略以 profitability 及 market share 表達，並作為評估績效的基準 benchmark） 2. Estimate revenues, expenses and other financial variables 3. Create an operating budget（可以是 budgets 或 pro forma statements） 4. Analyse any potential risks and deviations 5. Monitor and review the performance and results Financial planning 主要用於估計未來現金流；strategic management plans 預測 1 年至 5 年或以上的公司績效。 C. 存貨管理三方法（11.4.1，分類邊界常考） EOQ model ：決定令短缺成本 (shortage costs) 與持有成本 (carrying costs) 總和最小的最優存貨量；目標是兩成本相等之點。假設全年銷售速率相同 → 適合銷售穩定產品，不適合季節性/月度波動大的產品。 MRP (Materials Requirement Planning) ：電腦化系統，使存貨持有量配合生產計劃 (production schedules)；計算滿足特定訂單量所需的原材料及在製品存貨，配合準確銷售預測可維持低存貨。 JIT (Just in Time) ：貨品在需要時才製造、購入或送達，不長期備存；原材料在生產需要時準時到廠；成品端亦適用（直接由送貨上架，近乎零倉儲時間）。需要與供應商緊密關係 (close relationships with suppliers) 及精密物流 (finely tuned logistics)。 D. TQM（11.4.2） 目標：零缺陷 (zero defects)。收集缺陷數量與類型、返工成本 (rework costs)、保養/服務承諾成本等資訊。 四步循環 PDCA（Plan, Do, Check, Act）：(1) Identify and plan（確定問題、收集資訊、找出根本原因 root cause）；(2) Take action（制訂及實施修正、建立量度系統）；(3) Check the results（前後測試分析）；(4) Disseminate the information（記錄結果、提出建議）。持續重複。 E. Product Life Cycle Costing（11.4.3） 產品生命週期四階段（必背順序）： Introduction → Growth → Maturity → Decline 。 Introduction：建立市場接受度，營銷開支大，成敗不確定，避免大额生產投資。 Growth：建立市場佔有率，推出新版本/衍生產品，擴充分銷網絡。 Maturity：競爭者多，防守市場佔有率，價格有下行壓力 → 可引入 target costing；現金流可能為正。 Decline：銷售下跌、削減成本保現金流、縮減分銷渠道、折價清貨、停產。 Life cycle costing (LCC)：由發明 (invention) 至終止 (termination) 追蹤累積實際成本與收入；代表 total cost of ownership；與傳統成本會計只著重即時會計期間 (immediate accounting periods) 不同，LCC 提供長期盈利圖像。好處：更低成本、更實際的現金流評估、促進長期規劃、更理解增量成本 (incremental costs)。 F. Target Costing（11.4.4，計算必考） 核心公式（Exhibit 11.2）： Market price − Desired profit = Target cost 價格由供求定律 (laws of supply and demand) 決定，企業無法左右 → 盈利靠控制成本。 步驟：選擇市場區隔 (market segment / niche，如 luxury vs economy goods) → 調查顧客願付價格 → 設定 desired profit → 得出 target cost → 由生產、營銷、財務專家組成團隊設計符合品質規格且不超過 target cost 的產品。Target cost 必須包括產品整個生命週期的所有生產成本。 Target pricing 概念顛倒 (reverse) 傳統程序：傳統是「設計產品 → 計算成本 → 定價」；target costing 是「市場價格（如 HK$199、HK$249 價格點 price points）→ 扣除利潤 → 倒推成本」。 G. Quality Costing（11.4.5，四大分類必背） COQ (Cost of Quality) 理論中，quality cost 指 低劣品質的成本 (cost of poor quality) 。 品質成本可佔銷售額 10%–30%，佔營運開支 25%–40%（數字出自原文，可考）。 四大類別（Total cost of quality = 四者之和）： 1. Prevention costs 預防成本：防止品質問題（制訂規格 specifications、品質程序、QA 系統及部門、TQM 培訓 training）。 2. Appraisal costs 鑑定成本：監察與評估是否符合規格（供應商預審 pre approval assessments、品質系統審計 audits、驗證 inputs/processes/products）。 3. Internal failure costs 內部失敗成本：交付顧客 之前 發現缺陷的補救（追查缺陷原因、返工 rework、不可修復存貨損失）。 4. External failure costs 外部失敗成本：交付 之後 顧客發現缺陷的補救（處理投訴 complaints、維修、保養承諾 warranty undertakings、退貨/回收的運輸處理費）。 Activity based costing (ABC) 是識別及量化上述四類 TQM 成本的成熟工具。 H. Theory of Constraints (TOC)（11.4.6） 由 Dr. Eliyahu Goldratt 於《The Goal》(1984) 首次提出。核心：所有企業都有限制增長的約束 (constraints / bottlenecks)，修復約束比追求滿負荷運作更能提升利潤。 三套工具： Five focusing steps （識別及消除約束）、 Thinking processes （分析解難，三問：What needs changing? What should it be changed to? What actions will bring about this change?）、 Throughput accounting （量度績效及支援決策）。 Five focusing steps：(a) 識別約束/瓶頸 → (b) 決定如何改造約束使系統以最高效率運作 → (c) 將消除約束列為最高優先，其他流程配合 (subordinate) → (d) 作出其他所需改變以消除約束 → (e) 完成後回到 (a) 處理下一個最大約束。 約束分內部 (internal：產能追不上需求——設備、員工技能、政策) 與外部 (external：產量超過市場需求 → 應著力創造需求)。 Throughput accounting 觀點：傳統會計把存貨視為資產 (asset)，可能鼓勵囤貨虛增利潤；TOC 視存貨為負債 (liability)，因佔用現金並產生倉儲成本。傳統會計偏重削減開支（理論上限為零）；TOC 強調提高 throughput（無理論上限）。 I. Throughput Analysis（11.4.7，計算必考） 定義：以對 整間公司 （而非單一投資範疇）的影響來評估投資決策。假設單位層面只有材料成本屬變動，其他成本無論是否生產都會發生。 三條公式： Throughput = Revenue − Totally variable expenses （很少成本是完全變動，故 throughput 佔銷售百分比應相當高） Net profit = Throughput − Operating expenses （Operating expenses = 除計算 throughput 所用變動開支外的所有開支） Return on investment (ROI) = Net profit ÷ Investment （Investment = 為增加產能投入的現金） 決策優次：增加 throughput（無上限）優於削減 operating expenses（最多只能減到零）。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：EOQ vs MRP vs JIT —— 三種存貨管理方法的分類邊界 對比： EOQ 是「計算最優訂貨量」的數量模型，令 carrying costs 與 shortage costs 總和最小（假設銷售速率穩定）； MRP 是「配合生產計劃」的電腦化系統，按訂單量推算所需原材料與在製品； JIT 是「零存貨哲學」，貨品在需要一刻才到達，依賴供應商關係與物流。 例子：一家銷量全年穩定的公司想決定「每次訂幾多貨」→ 用 EOQ ；一家按訂單生產、要確保原材料配合生產排程 → 用 MRP ；豐田式零倉存、零件即叫即到 → 用 JIT 。OTQ 給你一個 scenario 問屬於哪種方法，關鍵字：「optimal quantity / minimise holding & shortage costs」= EOQ；「production schedule / orders volume」= MRP；「arrive exactly when needed / very low inventory」= JIT。 Pitfall 2：Prevention / Appraisal / Internal failure / External failure costs —— 品質成本四分類 對比：前兩類是企業 主動付出 以獲得品質（Prevention = 事前防止問題發生，如 TQM training；Appraisal = 檢查監察是否符合規格，如 audits、supplier pre approval）；後兩類是問題 已經發生 的補救成本，分界線在「 交付顧客之前或之後 」——Internal failure = 交付前發現（rework、追查原因）；External failure = 交付後顧客發現（warranty、complaints、recall transport）。 例子：「產品出廠前發現次品要返工」= Internal failure （不是 external，因未交付）；「保用期內免費維修」= External failure ；「品質系統審計費」= Appraisal （不是 prevention，因它是檢查而非防止）。「考官報告指出」考生在分類題常把 appraisal 與 prevention 混淆——記住 prevention 是「防止問題出現」，appraisal 是「檢查問題是否存在」。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What is strategic management accounting (SMA), and how does it differ from traditional management accounting? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: SMA = a specific field of accounting that brings together the strategic business objectives of a business with the information generated by management accounting, generating forward looking projections and models for decision making. Traditional management accounting: internally focused, introspective, historical analysis for single entities/periods, focuses on a single issue (cost, volume or profit); an expansion of cost accounting. SMA: externally focused — cost trends, prices, market share, competitors, suppliers, technologies; considers a sequence of decisions and patterns; focuses on competitive conditions. SMA is NOT a replacement: SMA formulates forward looking strategies; traditional management accounting implements them — coordination between the two is the key challenge. [中文白話解釋]: SMA 就是將公司策略目標同管理會計資訊結合，望向將來、望向公司外面（競爭者、市場份額、科技等）；傳統管理會計只望公司內部、望單一議題。考試記住關鍵字：SMA = external + forward looking + competitive conditions，兩者要協調而非互相取代。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): Describe the triangular structure of SMA and the QCT factors. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Triangular structure — three primary considerations: (1) Technical analysis (information about specific events); (2) Behavioural considerations (best path to achieve objectives); (3) Cultural considerations (shared beliefs within the organisation). QCT factors: Quality, Cost, Time — used by companies to set themselves apart within their market, and contrasted with customer preferences / market demands. Example: McDonald's since the 1970s — high quality, continuous cost control for affordable prices, fast delivery time. [中文白話解釋]: SMA 三角 = 技術（數據分析）、行為（點行先達標）、文化（公司共同信念）；QCT = 品質、成本、時間，係公司用嚟同對手區隔嘅三個因素。MCQ 好易將「economic considerations」之類假選項混入，記死 technical / behavioural / cultural 三個字。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): List the five steps of the business planning process in order. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Step 1: Develop a strategy (set by the board of directors / senior management; expressed in profitability and market share; used as benchmark for performance evaluation). Step 2: Estimate revenues, expenses and other financial variables. Step 3: Create an operating budget (budgets or pro forma statements). Step 4: Analyse any potential risks and deviations (worst case to best case scenarios). Step 5: Monitor and review the performance and results. Planning is an ongoing process, adjusted as situations evolve. [中文白話解釋]: 口訣「策、估、算、險、檢」——先制訂策略，再估收入開支，跟住出預算，分析風險偏差，最後監察檢討。OTQ 常考「邊一步先邊一步後」，記住策略永遠係第一步、監察檢討係最後一步。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Distinguish between the EOQ model, MRP and JIT inventory systems. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: EOQ model: determines the optimal inventory level that minimises the sum of shortage costs and carrying costs (storage, financing, insurance, spoilage); the point where carrying costs = shortage costs; assumes constant sales rate → unsuitable for seasonal products. MRP (Materials Requirement Planning): computerised system aligning inventory holdings with production schedules; calculates raw materials and in process inventory needed for a specific order volume; combined with accurate sales forecasts keeps inventory low. JIT: goods manufactured, purchased or delivered exactly when needed — components arrive at the factory precisely when required; finished goods delivered to end users on demand; requires close supplier relationships and finely tuned logistics; ideal system takes goods directly from delivery to shelf. [中文白話解釋]: 三個方法目標都係降低存貨，但切入點不同：EOQ 計「最優數量」（成本最小化模型）；MRP 計「生產需要幾多料」（跟生產排程）；JIT 係「唔好擺貨，用到先至送到」。題目見 "minimise carrying and shortage costs" 揀 EOQ；見 "production schedule" 揀 MRP；見 "when needed, not before" 揀 JIT。 [Flashcard 5]（計算卡） Front (Question in English): Cute Toys Ltd sells stuffed toys at a market driven price of HK$50 per unit and requires a profit margin of 10% on the selling price. Calculate the target cost per unit and state the target costing formula. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Formula (Exhibit 11.2): Market price − Desired profit = Target cost. Desired profit = 10% × HK$50 = HK$5 per unit. Target cost = HK$50 − HK$5 = HK$45 per unit . Logic: prices are set by supply and demand (outside the company's control) → profitability is pursued by controlling costs; the company must produce at the target cost (or less), covering ALL production costs over the product's entire life cycle, or it will fail to earn the desired profit. [中文白話解釋]: Target costing 係「倒推法」：市場話事定咗價（HK$50），公司想要 10% 利潤（HK$5），咁成本最多只可以係 HK$45。同傳統「成本加利潤定價」方向啱啱相反。計數時留意利潤率基準係 "on the selling price"，唔好乘錯做成本加成。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): List and define the four categories of cost of quality (COQ), with one example of each. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: 1. Prevention costs — costs of preventing quality problems (design/implementation/running of the quality system); e.g. TQM training, drawing up specifications. 2. Appraisal costs — costs of monitoring/evaluating conformance to specifications; e.g. audits of quality systems, pre approval assessments of suppliers, verification of inputs/processes/products. 3. Internal failure costs — remedying defects found BEFORE delivery to the customer; e.g. rework of defective materials, investigating causes of defects, losses on unusable stock. 4. External failure costs — remedying defects discovered by customers AFTER delivery; e.g. handling complaints, warranty repairs, transport/handling costs of returns or recalls. Total cost of quality = sum of the four categories; in COQ theory "quality cost" = cost of POOR quality; quality costs may be 10%–30% of sales and 25%–40% of operating expenses; ABC is a proven tool to identify/quantify them. [中文白話解釋]: 口訣「預、鑑、內、外」。分界線：主動付出（預防/鑑定）vs 出事補救（內部/外部）；補救再分「交貨前發現 = 內部、交貨後客戶發現 = 外部」。考試最鍾意將 warranty repair（外部）同 rework（內部）整蠱你。 [Flashcard 7]（計算卡） Front (Question in English): A division reports revenue of HK$2,000,000, totally variable expenses of HK$500,000, operating expenses of HK$900,000, and investment of HK$3,000,000. Using throughput analysis, compute throughput, net profit and ROI, and state the decision priority implied. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Throughput = Revenue − Totally variable expenses = 2,000,000 − 500,000 = HK$1,500,000 . Net profit = Throughput − Operating expenses = 1,500,000 − 900,000 = HK$600,000 . ROI = Net profit ÷ Investment = 600,000 ÷ 3,000,000 = 20% . Decision priority: the best improvements increase throughput (no theoretical upper limit); reducing operating expenses is less important because expenses can only be reduced to zero. [中文白話解釋]: Throughput analysis 三步曲：先收入減「完全變動開支」得 throughput；再減 operating expenses 得 net profit；最後除以 investment 得 ROI。留意 "totally variable expenses" 通常只係材料，唔好將人工同間接費當變動成本扣。改善策略首選提高 throughput（無上限），唔係一味cut cost。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): Explain the theory of constraints (TOC), its five focusing steps, and how throughput accounting views inventory differently from traditional accounting. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: TOC (Goldratt, "The Goal", 1984): all companies face constraints (bottlenecks) that hold back potential; identifying and managing them raises profits; companies gain more by fixing constraints than by chasing full capacity. Five focusing steps: (a) Identify the constraint; (b) Decide how to exploit/rework it so the system works at maximum effectiveness; (c) Subordinate everything else — make eliminating the constraint the highest priority; (d) Elevate — make any other changes needed to eliminate it; (e) Repeat the cycle for the next biggest constraint. Three tools: five focusing steps; thinking processes (What needs changing? What to? What actions?); throughput accounting. Throughput accounting: traditional accounting treats inventory as an ASSET (encouraging overproduction to inflate accounting profit); TOC treats inventory as a LIABILITY (ties up cash + storage costs). Constraints may be internal (demand capacity) or external (output market demand → create more demand). [中文白話解釋]: TOC 重點係「搵出樽頸、集中火力消除佢」，五步循環記口訣「搵、用、從、升、loop」。最大陷阱：TOC 視存貨為負債（liability）而唔係資產——因為佔住現金兼要倉租。外部約束 = 生產多過市場需求，應該去創造需求而唔係加產能。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md

text: M7 Pricing Strategies and Decisions — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: B (Market skimming pricing) Model Answer: Market skimming is the strategy of setting the initial price HIGHER than competing products to take advantage of consumers willing to pay a high price to be the first to own an exciting new product — the so called "early adopters". After introduction, the price is lowered to capture additional customers at lower price points. Patent protected or unique products (e.g. Apple's iPhones, new patented drugs) are classic cases. NovaTech's patented device, premium launch price and planned subsequent price reductions match skimming exactly. 【解題思路】 第一步：抓關鍵字 ——「patented / no competitor can replicate」、「price well above competitors」、「first to own」、「lower the price progressively」。呢啲全部係 skimming 嘅標誌：高開、搵 early adopters 埋單、之後逐步減價擴客。 第二步：排除干擾項。 A 錯 ：Penetration 係 低於 競爭對手定價，目的係快速上量搶 market share（如 FMCG 自家品牌、小米），方向同題目完全相反 —— 呢個係 skimming vs penetration 嘅經典概念混淆。 C 錯 ：Complementary product pricing 係一件產品（razor）低價求量，靠互補品（blades）賺錢；題目冇提任何互補產品。 D 錯 ：Volume discounting 係買大量先至平，與新產品上市定價無關。 考試貼士：見到 "early adopters"、"premium price at launch"、"price lowered after introduction" 即刻諗 skimming；見到 "rapidly gain market share / economies of scale" 先係 penetration。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: Second degree price discrimination is the practice of setting different prices for different quantities consumed — e.g. mobile data plans or hours with a personal trainer. First degree discrimination (not third degree) is charging the maximum possible price for every unit sold. Third degree discrimination is charging different prices to different consumer groups (e.g. senior citizen transport fares or movie tickets). Under price discrimination, customers with more INELASTIC demand (who need the product more) are charged MORE, not less (e.g. funeral services). For discrimination to work, customer groups must NOT overlap or be able to resell to each other. 【解題思路】 第一步：背熟三度差別定價 —— 一度：每單位收客人願付嘅最高價；二度：按 數量/用量 差別收費；三度：按 顧客群組 差別收費。 第二步：逐項判斷。 A 錯 ：「charge the maximum for every unit」係 first degree 嘅定義，唔係 third degree —— 呢個係故意對調兩個度數嘅陷阱。 B 錯 ：方向調轉咗。需求越 inelastic（越需要）嘅客人應該收得 越貴 （書中例子：funeral services）；elastic 嘅客人才要平啲留住佢。 D 錯 ：差別定價成功嘅前提係客群 不能重疊 （唔可以互相轉售），否則平價買入嘅人會轉賣畀高價客群，策略即刻失效。 考試貼士：OTQ 好鍾意將「度數定義對調」同「elastic/inelastic 方向對調」做 distractor，兩個方向都要背到滾瓜爛熟。 Question 3 — Correct Answer: D Model Answer: Relevant costs are costs associated with a management decision that are likely to change in the future. Under the principle of relevance, only benefits and costs that DIFFER between options — i.e. future incremental (differential) costs and opportunity costs — should be considered. Sunk costs have already been incurred and will not change regardless of the decision, so they are NOT relevant. Absorbed fixed overheads that remain unchanged (unavoidable fixed costs) are likewise irrelevant to a special order price. The original purchase price of an asset is a classic sunk cost (e.g. shares bought on the HKSE ten years ago — only today's transaction costs matter for the sell decision). 【解題思路】 第一步：記住 relevant costing 三大法則 —— (1) 只睇將來先發生嘅現金流；(2) sunk cost 唔理；(3) opportunity cost 要計。 第二步：逐項判斷。 A 錯 ：十年前嘅買入價係典型 sunk cost，無論今日賣唔賣都改變唔到，所以 不相關 。書中特別提到有人心理上一定想計返呢個價，但財務決策上係錯嘅。 B 錯 ：Sunk costs 定義上就係 irrelevant —— 呢個選項將定義掉轉。 C 錯 ：Absorbed fixed overheads 唔會因為接唔接張 special order 而改變（unavoidable），所以唔應放入最低報價；只有 incremental costs（如額外材料、加班工資）先相關。 考試貼士：遇見 special order / minimum price 題目，第一反應係問「呢項成本接單同唔接單有冇分別？」冇分別 → 剔除。 Question 4 — Correct Answer: HK$132.50 per unit Model Answer / Working: Item Working HK$ Fixed manufacturing overhead per unit 300,000 ÷ 8,000 37.50 Fixed selling & admin per unit 200,000 ÷ 8,000 25.00 Total fixed cost per unit 62.50 Variable cost per unit given 45.00 Total cost per unit 62.50 + 45.00 107.50 Desired ROI mark up per unit (25% × 800,000) ÷ 8,000 = 200,000 ÷ 8,000 25.00 Target selling price 107.50 + 25.00 132.50 The company expects income of HK$200,000 (25% × HK$800,000) on its investment, i.e. HK$25 per unit at 8,000 units. Adding this ROI mark up to the total unit cost of HK$107.50 gives a target selling price of HK$132.50 . 【解題思路】 第一步：背公式 —— Mark up per unit = (Desired ROI % × Amount invested) ÷ Units produced。呢度 = (25% × 800,000) ÷ 8,000 = HK$25 。 第二步：砌 total cost per unit —— 固定成本要 兩項加埋再除產量 ：(300,000 + 200,000) ÷ 8,000 = HK$62.50，加 variable cost HK$45 = HK$107.50 。 第三步：Cost + Mark up = Target selling price → 107.50 + 25 = HK$132.50 。 常見錯誤： 用 ROI% 直接乘單位成本（25% × 107.50 ≈ 26.88）—— 錯！ROI 係對 投資額 計，唔係對成本計。 漏計其中一項固定成本（只計 manufacturing overhead 唔計 selling & admin）—— 固定成本兩項都要入。 將 mark up 當 margin 用（107.50 ÷ 0.75）—— 題目講明係 ROI based mark up on cost，唔係 profit margin on sales。 考試貼士：呢條係書中 Illustrative Example 5 嘅變奏版，三部流程（fixed cost per unit → total cost → + ROI mark up）記實就穩攞分。 Question 5 — Correct Answer: HK$1,100 per cabinet Model Answer / Working: Relevant (incremental) costs Working HK$ Refurbishment cost given, per cabinet 800 Transportation cost 120,000 ÷ 400 cabinets 300 Minimum selling price per cabinet 800 + 300 1,100 The original manufacturing costs of HK$12,000 per cabinet are sunk costs — incurred five years ago and unchanged by whatever decision is made now — so they are irrelevant to the pricing decision. The only relevant costs are the future incremental costs of refurbishment (HK$800) and transportation (HK$300 per cabinet). Any price quoted above HK$1,100 per cabinet will generate a profit for Harbour Manufacturing Ltd. This is the relevant/incremental cost pricing strategy. 【解題思路】 第一步：識別 sunk cost —— HK$12,000/件嘅原始製造成本五年前已付，接唔接新客都收唔返， 唔入計 。呢個係全題最大陷阱：好多同學會用 12,000 加料再報價，結果最低價變成 HK$13,100，完全錯。 第二步：計未來 incremental costs —— refurbishment HK$800（每件）+ transportation HK$120,000 ÷ 400 = HK$300（每件），合共 HK$1,100 。 第三步：下結論 —— 最低報價 HK$1,100；高過呢個數就係賺。邏輯同書中 Apply & Analyse 1（冷氣機 HK$500 + HK$200 = HK$700）一模一樣。 考試貼士：Relevant cost 題目嘅作答順序：先圈出所有「已發生/唔會變」嘅數剔走佢，再將「先將來、會改變」嘅成本逐項加，最後嗰句「任何高於最低價的報價均有盈利」寫埋落去更穩陣。

text: M7 Pricing Strategies and Decisions — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 「限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位）」 Question 1 (MCQ) NovaTech Ltd has just developed a patented wearable device that no competitor can currently replicate. It launches the product at a price well above competing devices to capture customers willing to pay a premium to be first to own it, and plans to lower the price progressively afterwards to attract additional customer segments. Which pricing strategy is NovaTech Ltd adopting? A. Market penetration pricing B. Market skimming pricing C. Complementary product pricing D. Volume discounting Question 2 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about price discrimination is CORRECT? A. Third degree price discrimination means charging the maximum possible price for every unit sold to each individual customer. B. Customers with more inelastic demand for the product should be charged a lower price than customers with elastic demand. C. Second degree price discrimination refers to setting different prices for different quantities consumed, such as mobile data usage. D. Price discrimination is most effective when different customer groups can freely resell the product to one another. Question 3 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about relevant cost pricing is CORRECT? A. The original purchase price paid for an asset ten years ago must always be included because it represents the true economic sacrifice. B. Sunk costs are relevant because they measure the total resources consumed by the business. C. Absorbed fixed overheads that do not change as a result of a special order should be included in the minimum price quoted. D. Only future incremental costs and opportunity costs that differ between options are relevant when setting a minimum price for a special order. Question 4 (Objective calculation) Bright Products Ltd is pricing a new desk lamp. The per unit variable cost is HK$45. Fixed manufacturing overhead is HK$300,000 and fixed selling and administrative expenses are HK$200,000. The company has invested HK$800,000 and targets a 25% return on investment (ROI). Planned production is 8,000 units. Using total cost plus pricing with the mark up based on the desired ROI, calculate the target selling price per unit. (State your answer in HK$, to one decimal place if necessary.) Question 5 (Objective calculation) Five years ago, Harbour Manufacturing Ltd produced 400 custom made display cabinets for a customer who went bankrupt before delivery. The original manufacturing costs (already incurred) totalled HK$12,000 per cabinet. The cabinets have been stored in a warehouse since then. A new customer is now interested in the whole batch. To complete the sale, Harbour must spend HK$800 refurbishment cost per cabinet and incur HK$120,000 total transportation expenses. Using relevant cost pricing, calculate the minimum selling price per cabinet that Harbour should quote. (State your answer in HK$.) End of Quiz — 完成後請對照 M7_Ch12_Pricing_Strategies_Answers.md

excerpt: M7 Pricing Strategies and Decisions — Study Pack (Week 10) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 定價的五大影響因素 (Factors Affecting Pricing …
text: M7 Pricing Strategies and Decisions — Study Pack (Week 10) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 定價的五大影響因素 (Factors Affecting Pricing Policies) ：成本資料 (Cost Data)、需求因素 (Demand Factor — price taker vs price setter)、消費者心理 (Consumer Psychology — psychological pricing)、競爭 (Competition) 及政府政策 (Government Policy — price ceilings/floors、tariffs、Competition Ordinance (Cap. 619))。定價前必須先判斷企業是「受價者」還是「定價者」。 八種定價策略 (Types of Pricing Strategies) ：Cost Plus、Skimming、Penetration、Complementary Product、Product Line、Volume Discounting、Price Discrimination 及 Relevant Cost Pricing。每種策略的適用情境與方向（高價 vs 低價）是 OTQ 概念辨析的重災區。 CSR 對定價的影響 ：Cost of Quality（四分類：Preventive / Appraisal / Internal Failure / External Failure Costs）與 Environmental Costs（四分類：Conventional / Hidden / Contingent / Image and Relationship Costs）都會推高或改變成本基礎，必須納入定價考慮。 外部市場因素與內部成本結構 ：外部三要素 = Demand、Competition、Government Regulation；內部則取決於 fixed vs variable cost 比例，並可用 Activity Based Costing (ABC) 四步驟（cost pools → 選擇分攤成本 → cost drivers → denominator volume，ABC 用 practical capacity）提高成本及定價準確性。 非牟利機構定價 (Non Profit Pricing) ：Voluntary Pricing (Pay What You Want, PWYW)、Ability to Pay、Versioning（又稱 quality discrimination）、Bundle Services / Memberships（目的在擷取 consumer surplus）。目標是達成使命 (mission) 而非利潤最大化。 2. 必背考點清單 A. Cost Plus Pricing（本章唯一官方公式，List of Formulas 收錄） Cost + Mark up percentage × Cost = Target selling price （Exhibit 12.5） Mark up = Selling price − Cost = 產品的利潤（Exhibit 12.4） ROI 基礎 mark up （Illustrative Example 5）： Mark up per unit = (Desired ROI % × Amount invested) ÷ Units produced 例：(20% × HK$1,000,000) ÷ 10,000 units = HK$20 mark up；售價 = VC 60 + FC 52 + 20 = HK$132 Margin vs Mark up 兩種計法（Illustrative Example 2，極易考） ： Net profit margin 25%（利潤佔售價）：Price = Cost ÷ (1 − margin) = 780 ÷ 0.75 = HK$1,040 Gross profit mark up 30%（利潤佔成本）：Price = Cost × (1 + 30%) = HK$1,014 優點：簡單；缺點： 忽略需求 (ignores demand) ，且銷量越低，單位成本越高，需收取更高價格才能達到目標 ROI。 Gross profit margin = (Sales − Variable cost) ÷ Sales —— 用 gross profit rate （而非金額）監察定價政策成效（Illustrative Example 1）。 B. Relevant Cost Pricing（計算題核心） Relevant cost = 與決策相關、未來會改變的成本 (cost associated with a management decision that is likely to change in the future)。 Sunk costs 不相關 ：已發生、不論如何選擇都不會改變（如 10 年前已付的製造成本、股票的原始買入價）。 Incremental / differential costs ：因短期業務量變化而增加的成本，相關。 Opportunity cost 要計入 （Exam Practice Q12：small house 現時可賣 HK$3,000,000 即為機會成本）。 存貨材料：常用材料用 replacement cost ；不再使用的材料用 net realisable value （放棄的出售收入）。 勞工：full capacity 時取「加班費」與「基本工資 + contribution forgone」兩者 較低者 ；below capacity 只計實付時薪。 Fixed overheads absorbed（不可避免）→ 不相關。 Apply & Analyse 1：500 部冷氣機最低售價 = refurbishment HK$500 + transportation HK$200 = HK$700/部 ；高於 HK$700 的報價均有盈利。 C. 策略概念辨析（OTQ 高頻） Skimming ：初期定價 高於 競爭對手，瞄準 early adopters（如 iPhone），其後逐步降價；適合專利/獨特產品。 Penetration ：定價 低於 競爭對手，快速搶佔 market share、達致 economies of scale（如 FMCG、小米手機）；與 skimming 方向相反。 Complementary Product ：一件產品低價求量（razor），靠互補品（blades）賺取高利潤。 Product Line ：相關產品組合定價；變化包括 Captive Pricing（KFC 套餐配菜）及 Loss Leaders（超市低於成本招徠）。 Volume Discounting ：大量購買享低價；三原因 = 吸引新客、增強競爭力、降低分銷成本；缺點 = 利潤率變薄、產品貶值、日後難加價。 Price Discrimination ：同一產品向不同顧客收不同價； inelastic demand 的顧客收費較高 （如殯儀服務）；顧客群不可重疊。 First degree：每單位收顧客願付的最高價 Second degree：按購買 數量 差別定價（如 data plan） Third degree：按 顧客群組 差別定價（如長者車票/戲票） Non profit ：PWYW（買家自訂價，可低至零；德國實驗：大多付比正價少 19%，但客量增加）；Ability to Pay（銀行稱 "capacity"）；Versioning（同一產品不同型號不同價，適合 fixed cost 高、variable cost 低的產品如軟件）；Bundling（擷取 consumer surplus = 願付價 − 實付價）。 Psychological Pricing ：HK$149,999 vs HK$150,000；顧客由左至右讀價；優點包括落入較低 price band、方便折扣管理（以 '98' 結尾）、存貨控制（防員工盜竊）。 Government Policy ：price ceilings（上限）/ price floors（下限）、稅項、tariffs；predatory pricing 可能違法 —— 香港 Competition Ordinance (Cap. 619) ，2013 年 1 月 13 日制定。 Break even 定價 （Exam Practice Q10）：Break even price = Total operating cost ÷ average attendance（510,000 ÷ 1,200 = HK$425）；Break even attendance = Total cost ÷ ticket price（510,000 ÷ 400 = 1,275 人）。 Cost of Quality = 與生產 低劣品質 產品相關的成本（rework、testing、after sales service、replacing faulty products）；四分類必背。Quality of design（符合顧客期望）vs Quality of conformance（產品符合設計規格）。 Environmental Costs 四分類：Conventional（原料能源）、Hidden（藏於 overhead）、Contingent（未來如 clean up）、Image and relationship；油業可達 operating costs 的 20%。 ABC 四步驟 ：(1) form cost pools；(2) decide which costs to allocate（只分攤 controllable capacity costs）；(3) identify cost drivers（因果關係最強者）；(4) denominator volume 用 practical capacity → 可揭示 unused capacity。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：Profit Margin on Sales vs Mark up on Cost（Cost Plus 的兩條路） 對比：「25% profit margin」指利潤佔 售價 25% → Price = Cost ÷ (1 − 25%)；「30% mark up on cost」指利潤佔 成本 30% → Price = Cost × (1 + 30%)。同一成本 HK$780，前者得 HK$1,040，後者得 HK$1,014 —— 結果不同，不能互換。 例子：成本 HK$500，要 20% margin on selling price → 500 ÷ 0.8 = HK$625 ；若誤用 mark up 計法會得 500 × 1.2 = HK$600，少了 HK$25。考試看清題目用 "margin" 還是 "mark up on cost / profit on total costs"（如 Illustrative Example 4 的 "20% profit on its total costs" = mark up on cost）。 Pitfall 2：Market Skimming vs Market Penetration（方向完全相反） 對比：Skimming = 高價 入場，榨取 early adopters 的支付意願，之後降價擴客；Penetration = 低價 入場，快速上量搶市佔、攤薄 fixed costs，之後才考慮加價。兩者都是新產品上市策略，但價格方向相反。 例子：藥廠專利新藥/Apple iPhone 高開 → skimming；Wellcome「No Frill」自家品牌/小米手機低開搶客 → penetration。題目見 "early adopters"、"premium launch" 即 skimming；見 "gain market share rapidly"、"economies of scale" 即 penetration。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): State the cost plus pricing formula, and explain the two ways a "profit percentage" can be applied to a cost base. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Formula: Cost + (Mark up % × Cost) = Target selling price Mark up on cost: Price = Cost × (1 + mark up %) — profit expressed as % of cost Margin on selling price: Price = Cost ÷ (1 − margin %) — profit expressed as % of price Example (cost HK$780): 25% net profit margin → HK$1,040; 30% gross profit mark up → HK$1,014 [中文白話解釋]: Cost plus 就是在成本上加一個利潤百分比，但要分清該百分比是「佔成本」還是「佔售價」。佔成本用乘 (1+%)；佔售價（margin）要用成本除以 (1−%)。兩者結果不同，考試最常在此設陷阱。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): How is the mark up per unit set when a company targets a desired return on investment (ROI) under total cost plus pricing? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Mark up per unit = (Desired ROI % × Amount invested) ÷ Units produced Target selling price = Variable cost per unit + Fixed cost per unit + ROI mark up per unit Example: VC HK$60 + FC HK$52 + mark up (20% × HK$1m ÷ 10,000 = HK$20) = HK$132 Weakness: ignores demand; lower sales volume → higher unit cost → higher required price [中文白話解釋]: 公司想要某個投資回報率，就先算「想賺幾多錢」（ROI% × 投資額），再除以預計產量，得出每件產品要賺的 mark up，加到總單位成本上就是目標售價。缺點是完全唔理市場需求，客人未必肯畀呢個價。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): Contrast market skimming and market penetration pricing strategies, with one example of each. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Skimming: initial price set HIGHER than competitors; targets early adopters willing to pay a premium (e.g. Apple's iPhones, patented drugs); price lowered later to capture more customers Penetration: price set LOWER than competitors; aims for rapid volume, market share and economies of scale (e.g. FMCG private brands such as Wellcome 'No Frill', Xiaomi phones); the opposite of skimming [中文白話解釋]: Skimming 係「高開後降」，賺首批忠實粉絲的溢價；Penetration 係「低開搶客」，用量換市佔同規模經濟。記住方向相反：skim = 撇油取高價，penetrate = 低價滲透市場。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Explain the three degrees of price discrimination and the role of price elasticity of demand. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Price discrimination = charging different customers different prices for the same product/service First degree: charge the maximum each customer will pay for every unit Second degree: different prices for different quantities consumed (e.g. mobile data) Third degree: different prices for different customer groups (e.g. senior citizen transport fares, movie tickets) Customers with more INELASTIC demand are charged MORE (e.g. funeral services); customer groups must not overlap [中文白話解釋]: 差別定價即係「同人唔同價」。一度係逐個客人榨到盡；二度係按用量收費（買多平啲）；三度係按群組收費（長者優惠）。需求越「無彈性」（越需要件產品）的客群，可以收得越貴。前提係客群之間不能互相轉售/重疊。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): A company stored 500 air conditioners for 10 years (original total unit cost HK$10,000). To sell them now it must spend HK$500 refurbishment per unit and HK$100,000 total transportation. What is the minimum selling price per unit, and why are the original costs ignored? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Minimum price = refurbishment HK$500 + transportation (HK$100,000 ÷ 500 = HK$200) = HK$700 per unit Original manufacturing costs are SUNK costs — already incurred, unchanged by any future decision → irrelevant Any price above HK$700 yields a profit (relevant/incremental pricing strategy) [中文白話解釋]: 十年前生產的成本係沉沒成本 (sunk cost)，做唔做呢單生意都改變唔到，所以定價時完全唔使理。只有將來先會發生的翻新費同運費先係 relevant cost，加埋 HK$700 就係最低售價底線，高過呢個數就有賺。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): List the four categories of the cost of quality and give an example of each. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Preventive costs: avoid failures — procedures, training, testing, preventive maintenance, supplier qualification Appraisal costs: detect defects before shipping — testing components and final products, testing equipment Internal failure costs: defects found before delivery — rework, scrap, re testing, sales of seconds External failure costs: defects after delivery — returns, warranty claims, product recalls, lawsuits, lost customers/revenue [中文白話解釋]: Cost of quality 係指「品質唔好」帶嚟的成本，記憶口訣 P A I E：預防（開事前）、檢驗（出貨前查）、內部失敗（出貨前發現要翻工）、外部失敗（到客人手先發現，代價最大，包括商譽損失）。內部改善通常平過等客人投訴。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): Describe the four pricing strategies commonly used by non profit making entities. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Voluntary pricing (PWYW): customers choose what to pay, possibly zero; floor/suggested price optional Ability to pay: buyers should not pay more than they can afford; progressive pricing; called "capacity" in banking Versioning ("quality discrimination"): different models of the same product at different prices; suits high fixed cost / low variable cost products (e.g. software) Bundle services/memberships: package priced lower than separate items; aims to capture consumer surplus (willingness to pay − price paid) [中文白話解釋]: 非牟利機構唔以賺錢為目標，定價為達成使命。PWYW 畀客人隨心畀錢；Ability to pay 按負擔能力收費（有能力者補貼無能力者）；Versioning 同一產品出幾個版本不同價；Bundling 打包平賣，目的係將客人的 consumer surplus（願付與實付之差）變成機構收入。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): What are the key external market factors affecting pricing, and how does activity based costing (ABC) improve cost based pricing? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: External factors: Demand, Competition, Government regulation (plus user group, location/point of consumption, time/perishability) ABC four steps: (1) form cost pools by activity; (2) allocate only controllable capacity costs; (3) choose cost drivers with the strongest causal relation; (4) use PRACTICAL capacity as denominator volume Using practical capacity avoids overstating unit costs when volumes are low and reveals unused capacity, giving more accurate costs for pricing [中文白話解釋]: 外部三寶：需求、競爭、政府規管。內部就靠成本結構定價。ABC 比傳統方法準，因為佢按活動歸集成本、只分攤可控成本、揀最有因果關係的 cost driver，而且用「實際可用產能」(practical capacity) 做分母 —— 咁樣唔會因為閒置產能而谷大單位成本，仲可以揭發 unused capacity 幫手控制成本。 「Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md」

title: M7 Chapter 13 Investment Project Appraisal — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！）

Question 1 — Answer: B

text: M7 Chapter 13 Investment Project Appraisal — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: B English Model Answer: The correct decision is to select Project Harbour , because it has the higher NPV (HK$210,000 vs HK$120,000). For mutually exclusive projects, the NPV method prevails: the project with the highest NPV produces the biggest increase in the company's value, which aligns with the objective of maximising shareholder value. The IRR is a relative (percentage) measure — selecting the project with the highest IRR does not necessarily maximise company value. Why each distractor is wrong: A is wrong: Choosing the highest IRR is the classic error with mutually exclusive projects. IRR cannot tell you which mutually exclusive project to select — a smaller project can show a higher percentage return yet create less value. C is wrong: The projects are mutually exclusive , so only one can be accepted. "Accept both" would be correct only if the projects were independent (in which case both positive NPV projects would be accepted). D is wrong: A higher IRR does not always imply a higher NPV. NPV and IRR rankings can conflict for mutually exclusive projects because of differences in project scale and the timing of cash flows. 【解題思路】關鍵字眼係「mutually exclusive」——互斥項目下 IRR 同 NPV 可能打架，此時以 NPV 為準，因為 NPV 直接量度公司價值增加幾多（絕對金額），而 IRR 只係百分比（相對指標）。C 選項混淆咗 independent projects 嘅規則：獨立項目先可以「全部正 NPV 都接受」。D 選項就係考官最常設嘅陷阱，記住「highest IRR ≠ highest NPV」。 Question 2 — Answer: C English Model Answer: Correct classification: Book value of the old machine (HK$800,000): a sunk cost — already incurred and cannot be changed or avoided by any future decision; it must be ignored in the analysis. Feasibility study cost (HK$120,000): a sunk cost — already paid; irrelevant to the replacement decision. Sale value of the old machine (HK$500,000): an opportunity cost — if the machine is retained/used, the company forgoes the HK$500,000 it could receive by selling it; this must be included in the project analysis. Why each distractor is wrong: A is wrong: It reverses every classification — a book value is never a relevant cost, a recoverable sale value is not sunk, and money already spent on a study is not an opportunity cost. B is wrong: Book value is sunk, not an opportunity cost; the sale value forgone is the opportunity cost; the study cost is already paid (sunk), not relevant. D is wrong: Not all three are sunk. The HK$500,000 sale value is a future benefit that would be forgone — a genuine opportunity cost that must be included. 【解題思路】口訣：「過去嘅錢唔理（sunk），將來放棄嘅利益要計（opportunity）」。Book value 同已付嘅研究費都係歷史成本，點決定都改變唔到，所以全部 ignore。反而部機可以賣 HK$500,000，如果留嚟用就放棄咗呢筆錢——呢個先係相關成本。呢類「relevant vs sunk cost」概念辨析係 OTQ 常客，留意題目會故意將三個金額嘅身份調亂。 Question 3 — Answer: C English Model Answer: Statement C is correct: The discounted payback period is equal to or longer than the simple payback period, because future cash flows are worth less once discounted for time and risk. Both methods ignore cash flows beyond the payback/cut off date, and in both cases the cut off date is arbitrary (no objective criterion for a "good" payback period). Why each distractor is wrong: A is wrong: Discounting reduces the value of future inflows, so recovery takes longer, not shorter. The discounted payback can never be shorter than the simple payback for a project with conventional cash inflows. B is wrong: Only the discounted payback considers the time value of money; the simple payback does not. And both methods ignore cash flows beyond the cut off date. D is wrong: Neither payback method has an objective acceptance criterion — the cut off period is set arbitrarily by management, and it is expressed in years, not compared with the cost of capital. 【解題思路】呢題考兩個 payback 方法嘅細微分別。記住兩點：(1) discounted payback 一定 ≥ simple payback，因為折現令未來現金流縮水；(2) 兩者共同缺點係「cut off 之後嘅現金流完全唔睇」兼且 cut off 係任意設定。如果公司識折現，其實直接計 NPV 仲好——discounted payback 只係 payback 同 NPV 之間嘅妥協。 Question 4 — Answer: NPV = −HK$21,262 (approximately); the project should be rejected . English Model Answer / Full Working: Step 1 — Identify all relevant cash flows: Year 0: initial outlay = equipment HK$260,000 + net working capital HK$40,000 = HK$300,000 outflow . Years 1–3: after tax operating cash inflows of HK$100,000 each year. Year 3: recovery of net working capital HK$40,000 (must be included — excluding it would underestimate the NPV). Step 2 — Discount at 10%: Year Cash flow (HK$) Discount factor @10% Present value (HK$) : : : 0 (300,000) 1.00000 (300,000.00) 1 100,000 0.90909 90,909.09 2 100,000 0.82645 82,644.63 3 100,000 + 40,000 = 140,000 0.75131 105,183.80 (Equivalently: PV of operating inflows = 100,000 × 2.48685 = 248,685.20; PV of working capital recovery = 40,000 × 0.75131 = 30,052.59.) Step 3 — NPV: NPV = −300,000 + 90,909.09 + 82,644.63 + 105,183.80 = −HK$21,262 (accepting rounding in the range −HK$21,200 to −HK$21,300) Step 4 — Decision rule: NPV < 0 → reject the project . 【解題思路】第一步要將所有 relevant cash flows 搵齊：Year 0 唔好淨係計部機，working capital HK$40,000 都係即時投入；到 Year 3 完結時 working capital 會全數收回，呢筆 HK$40,000 一定要加返落去，否則會低估 NPV（呢個係考官常考位）。逐步折現之後加埋，得出負 NPV，按決策規則「NPV < 0 → reject」。常見錯誤：(1) 漏計 working capital recovery，會得出更負嘅答案（−HK$51,315）；(2) 將 working capital 當成每年收回；(3) 忘記 Year 3 係營運現金流加 WC 收回一齊折現。 Question 5 — Answer: (a) Discounted payback ≈ 4.26 years ; (b) Simple payback ≈ 3.33 years . English Model Answer / Full Working: (a) Discounted payback period (discount rate 10%): Year Cash flow (HK$) Discount factor @10% Discounted CF (HK$) Cumulative discounted CF (HK$) : : : : 1 150,000 0.90909 136,364 136,364 2 150,000 0.82645 123,967 260,331 3 150,000 0.75131 112,697 373,028 4 150,000 0.68301 102,452 475,480 5 150,000 0.62092 93,138 568,618 The HK$500,000 outlay is recovered during Year 5: Discounted payback = 4 + (500,000 − 475,480) ÷ 93,138 = 4 + 24,520 ÷ 93,138 = 4.26 years (b) Simple payback = 500,000 ÷ 150,000 = 3.33 years . Reason for the difference: the discounted payback is longer because future cash flows have less value once discounted for the time value of money (and risk). Discounting shrinks each year's inflow, so it takes longer to recover the initial outlay. 【解題思路】先計每年嘅折現現金流，再做累計（cumulative）。第四年尾累計得 HK$475,480，仲差 HK$24,520 先回本，而第五年嘅折現流入係 HK$93,138，所以用比例計 24,520 ÷ 93,138 ≈ 0.26 年，加返 4 年即 4.26 年。至於 simple payback 就淨係 500,000 ÷ 150,000 = 3.33 年，完全唔使折現。留意 discounted payback 一定長過（或等於）simple payback，因為折現令未來現金流縮水——呢個正好呼應 Question 3 嘅概念。常見錯誤：用未折現嘅 150,000 去計最後一年嘅比例（會錯得 4.16 年），或者忘記累計應該用折現後數字。 來源：以上答案內容全部建基於 Learning Pack Module 7 Chapter 13（Investment Project Appraisal and Evaluation）之內容，包括 13.4–13.5 各評估技術之決策規則、13.2.1 相關成本原則及 13.4.7 PI 公式。

text: M7 Chapter 13 Investment Project Appraisal — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Question 1 (MCQ) Kowloon Ventures Ltd is evaluating two mutually exclusive projects, Peak and Harbour. Both require an initial outlay of HK$2 million and have conventional cash flows. At the company's 10% cost of capital, Project Peak has an IRR of 18% and an NPV of HK$120,000; Project Harbour has an IRR of 15% and an NPV of HK$210,000. Which of the following is the correct decision and reasoning? A. Select Project Peak because it has the higher internal rate of return. B. Select Project Harbour because it has the higher net present value, which represents the bigger increase in the company's value. C. Select both projects because both have a positive NPV and an IRR above the cost of capital. D. Select Project Peak because a higher IRR always implies a higher NPV for mutually exclusive projects. Question 2 (MCQ) Shatin Manufacturing Ltd is deciding whether to replace an old machine. The old machine has a book value of HK$800,000, could be sold today on the used equipment market for HK$500,000, and a feasibility study costing HK$120,000 has already been completed and paid for. In the incremental cash flow analysis of the replacement decision, which of the following correctly classifies these amounts? A. The book value of HK$800,000 is a relevant cost; the sale value of HK$500,000 is a sunk cost; the study cost of HK$120,000 is an opportunity cost. B. The book value of HK$800,000 is an opportunity cost; the sale value of HK$500,000 is a sunk cost; the study cost of HK$120,000 is a relevant cost. C. The book value of HK$800,000 and the study cost of HK$120,000 are sunk costs and should be ignored; the sale value of HK$500,000 is an opportunity cost and must be included. D. All three amounts are sunk costs and none should appear in the analysis. Question 3 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about the payback period and the discounted payback period is correct? A. The discounted payback period is always shorter than the simple payback period because discounting accelerates the recovery of the initial outlay. B. Both methods consider the time value of money and all cash flows over the project's entire life. C. The discounted payback period is equal to or longer than the simple payback period, and both methods ignore cash flows beyond the cut off date. D. The payback period has an objective decision criterion: accept a project if its payback period exceeds the cost of capital. Question 4 (Calculation — write the numerical answer with units) Cheung Chau Ltd is appraising a three year project. The project requires equipment costing HK$260,000 plus an immediate investment in net working capital of HK$40,000 (recovered in full at the end of Year 3). The project will generate after tax operating cash inflows of HK$100,000 at the end of each of Years 1, 2 and 3. The equipment has no salvage value. The project's cost of capital is 10%. Calculate the net present value (NPV) of the project, rounded to the nearest HK dollar, and state whether the project should be accepted. Question 5 (Calculation — write the numerical answer with units) Discovery Bay Ltd invests HK$500,000 in a project that produces constant after tax cash inflows of HK$150,000 at the end of each year for five years. The discount rate is 10%. Cash inflows are received evenly throughout each year. (a) Calculate the discounted payback period, rounded to two decimal places (in years). (b) State the simple (undiscounted) payback period in years and briefly state one reason why the two figures differ. End of quiz. Do not look at the answers file until you have attempted all questions.
