excerpt: M7 Financial Analysis and Profitability — Study Pack (Week 9) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 本章核心係用 五大比率家族 (five ratio families…
text: M7 Financial Analysis and Profitability — Study Pack (Week 9) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 本章核心係用 五大比率家族 (five ratio families) 去評估企業財務狀況：短期償債/流動性 (short term solvency/liquidity)、財務槓桿/長期償債 (financial leverage/long term solvency)、資產管理效率 (asset management efficiency / activity / turnover)、盈利能力 (profitability)、市場價值 (market based / market value ratios)；再配合 杜邦系統 (DuPont system) 將 ROE 拆解作診斷。 股市指標 (stock exchange indicators)：Price to Book ratio (P/B)、Earnings per Share (EPS)、Price–Earnings ratio (P/E)，將市場價格數據與財務報表數據結合。 短期財務規劃 (short term financial planning) 靠營運週期 (operating cycle) 及現金轉換週期 (cash conversion cycle, CCC) 估算營運資金需要；比率判斷好壞要用 trend analysis、industry group analysis、peer group analysis 三種基準比較。 現金為王：利潤唔等於現金 (profits are not cash)，營運現金流 (cash flow from operations) 先係真正衡量企業產生現金能力的指標；自由現金流 (free cash flow, FCF) 反映扣除資本開支同股息後剩餘可用現金。 盈利預測與財務策略：percentage of sales method 預測外部融資需求 (external financing requirement, EFR)；內部增長率 (internal growth rate, IGR) 與可持續增長率 (sustainable growth rate, SGR) 界定唔借錢/唔改資本結構下嘅最高增長；過度交易 (overtrading) 與過度槓桿 (excessive leverage) 係兩大警號，槓桿程度用 DOL、DFL、DCL 量度。 2. 必背考點清單（核心公式與應用條件） Stock Exchange Indicators / Market Based Ratios Price to book ratio (P/B) = Market value of equity per share ÷ Book value of equity per share。P/B < 1 代表公司未能為股東創造合理價值。 Earnings per share (EPS) = Net income ÷ Shares outstanding。 Price–earnings ratio (P/E) = Price per share ÷ EPS。P/E = 25.4 即市場願意為每 HK$1 盈利付 HK$25.40；高 P/E 可能代表預期高增長，亦可能係當年盈利異常低；EPS 為負數時 P/E 無意義。 Forward P/E = Price per share ÷ Estimated EPS (EEPS)。 Book value per share (BVPS) = Shareholders' equity ÷ Number of shares。 Dividend yield = Dividend per share (DPS) ÷ Current share price (P)。 Dividend payout ratio = DPS ÷ EPS。 EBITDA multiple = Total enterprise value (TEV) ÷ EBITDA；TEV = equity market value + market value of debt，用於收購估值。 Short term Solvency / Liquidity Ratios Current ratio = Current assets ÷ Current liabilities。低於 1 表示流動資產可能唔夠償還流動負債。 Quick ratio (acid test) = (Cash + Marketable securities + Accounts receivable) ÷ Current liabilities；剔除存貨因為存貨係流動資產中流動性最低。 Financial Leverage / Long term Solvency Ratios Total debt ratio = Total liabilities ÷ Total assets。 Debt to equity ratio = Total debt ÷ Total equity。 Equity multiplier = Total assets ÷ Total equity = 1 + Debt to equity ratio。（三個槓桿比率經 statement of financial position identity 互相連繫：TA = TL + SE，知一個可推其餘兩個。） Times interest earned (TIE) = EBIT ÷ Interest。 Cash coverage ratio = (EBIT + Depreciation and/or Amortisation) ÷ Interest。 Asset Management Efficiency Ratios Receivables turnover = Sales ÷ Accounts receivable (average/ending)；Days' receivables = 365 ÷ Receivables turnover。 Payables turnover = Net credit purchases ÷ Accounts payable（或 COGS ÷ AP）；Days' payables = 365 ÷ Payables turnover。 Inventory turnover = COGS ÷ Inventory；Days' inventory = 365 ÷ Inventory turnover。 Fixed asset turnover = Sales ÷ Net fixed assets；Total asset turnover = Sales ÷ Total assets。 Profitability Ratios Gross profit margin = (Net sales − COGS) ÷ Net sales。 Operating profit margin = EBIT ÷ Net sales（用 EBITDA 則為 EBITDA margin）。 Net profit margin = Net income ÷ Net sales；可再拆成 (EBIT/Net sales) × (EBT/EBIT) × (Net income/EBT)。 EBIT return on assets (EROA) = EBIT ÷ Total assets。 Return on assets (ROA) = Net income ÷ Total assets。 Return on equity (ROE) = Net income ÷ Total equity。 Average value = (Beginning value + Ending value) ÷ 2；ROA/ROE 宜用平均資產/權益。 DuPont System ROA = Net profit margin × Total asset turnover。 ROE = ROA × Equity multiplier。 DuPont equation: ROE = Net profit margin × Total asset turnover × Equity multiplier = (Net income/Net sales) × (Net sales/Total assets) × (Total assets/Total equity)。三大改善途徑：profit on sales、asset efficiency、financial leverage。 Short term Financial Planning Operating cycle = Days' inventory + Days' receivables。 Cash conversion cycle (CCC) = Days' inventory + Days' receivables − Days' payables。CCC 為負代表公司有剩餘現金可投資；越短越好。 Growth & Other Key Formulas Free cash flow = Net cash provided by operating activities − Capital expenditures − Dividends。 Profitability index (PI) = PV of future cash flows ÷ Initial cost；PI 1 接受（等同正 NPV）。 Internal growth rate (IGR)：開盤資產基礎 IGR = ROA × b；收盤資產基礎 IGR = (ROA × b) ÷ (1 − ROA × b)，其中 b = retention rate = 1 − dividend payout。 Sustainable growth rate (SGR)：開盤權益 SGR = ROE × b；收盤權益 SGR = (ROE × b) ÷ (1 − ROE × b)。 DOL = % change in EBIT ÷ % change in sales；DFL = % change in EPS ÷ % change in EBIT；DCL = DOL × DFL = % change in EPS ÷ % change in sales。 考試貼士 ：題目若話「closing balance」，IGR/SGR 要用除返 (1 − ROA×b) 或 (1 − ROE×b) 嘅版本；「opening balance」則直接相乘。兩個版本計出嚟理論上完全一樣，千祈唔好溝亂。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：ROA vs EROA vs ROE — 分子分母要配對 ROA = Net income ÷ Total assets：分子係股東應佔盈利，分母卻係股東+債權人嘅總投資，所以會被融資決策同稅項扭曲 (obscured by financing decisions and taxes)。 EROA = EBIT ÷ Total assets：分子係股東+債權人共享嘅經營盈利，分母係雙方總投資，配對正確，更能衡量資產營運效率。 ROE = Net income ÷ Total equity：分子分母都係股東層面。 原則：if the numerator is income to shareholders, the denominator should be shareholders' investment only；if the numerator is total profits from operations, the denominator should be total investment by both debtholders and shareholders。 例子：一間公司 Net income HK$60 萬、EBIT HK$100 萬、Total assets HK$1,000 萬、Equity HK$500 萬 → ROA = 6%，EROA = 10%，ROE = 12%。高槓桿會令 ROE EROA，睇數時要諗清楚邊個先係營運效率、邊個係股東回報。 Pitfall 2：Current Ratio vs Quick Ratio — 存貨係關鍵分別 Current ratio 用晒所有流動資產；Quick ratio 只計 Cash + Marketable securities + Accounts receivable，剔除存貨。 原因：inventory has the least liquidity of the current assets — 瀕臨倒閉公司嘅存貨可能唔值賬面值，債權人難以收回資金，所以銀行會再睇 quick ratio。 例子：CA = HK$800（其中存貨 HK$400），CL = HK$500 → Current ratio = 1.6（睇落健康），Quick ratio = (800 − 400) ÷ 500 = 0.8（其實隨時冇現金還債）。兩個比率差距越大，代表流動資產越依賴存貨。 「考官報告指出」：考生經常喺 OTQ 中將比率歸錯家族（e.g. 將 quick ratio 當成 market value ratio、將 inventory turnover 當成 profitability ratio），或者喺 quick ratio 計算時漏咗剔除存貨 — 答題前一定要默返 quick ratio 嘅分子係「C + MS + AR」。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): How are EPS and the P/E ratio calculated, and what does a P/E of 14 signify? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: EPS = Net income ÷ Shares outstanding. P/E ratio = Price per share ÷ EPS. A P/E of 14 means the market places a value of HK$14 on every HK$1 of net income; investors pay HK$14 for a claim on HK$1 of earnings because prices reflect current earnings plus future cash flows. High P/E may signal expected rapid earnings growth — or just unusually low current earnings; P/E is meaningless when EPS is negative or very low. [中文白話解釋]: EPS 就係將純利攤分落每股；P/E 就係股價除以 EPS，話你知投資者願意為每 1 蚊盈利俾幾多錢。P/E 高可能係市場睇好增長，亦可能係今年盈利特別低，所以一定要同競爭對手同市場趨勢比較先有結論。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): A firm has cash HK$100, marketable securities HK$50, accounts receivable HK$250, inventory HK$400 and current liabilities HK$500. Calculate the current ratio and quick ratio, and explain the difference. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Current assets = 100 + 50 + 250 + 400 = HK$800. Current ratio = 800 ÷ 500 = 1.6. Quick ratio = (100 + 50 + 250) ÷ 500 = 0.8. The quick (acid test) ratio excludes inventory because inventory is the least liquid current asset; a quick ratio below 1 warns the firm may be unable to pay current liabilities from its most liquid assets. [中文白話解釋]: 流動比率 1.6 表面健康，但速動比率只有 0.8，因為一半流動資產係存貨，未必套到現。銀行睇兩個比率嘅差距就知公司有幾依賴賣存貨先還到短期債。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): State the DuPont equation and the three levers management can use to maximise ROE. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: ROE = Net profit margin × Total asset turnover × Equity multiplier. = (Net income/Net sales) × (Net sales/Total assets) × (Total assets/Total equity). Three levers: (1) profit on sales (margin), (2) efficiency of asset use (turnover), (3) financial leverage (equity multiplier). ROA = Net profit margin × Total asset turnover; ROE = ROA × Equity multiplier. Increasing leverage raises ROE but increases risk. [中文白話解釋]: 杜邦公式將 ROE 拆做三瓣：賺錢能力（邊際利潤）、資產用得叻唔叻（週轉率）、用幾多借貸（權益乘數）。想谷大 ROE 可以三管齊下，但靠借貸谷 ROE 係有代價嘅 — 風險會同步上升。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Given a total debt ratio of 0.65, calculate the equity multiplier and the debt to equity ratio. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Total debt = 0.65 × Total assets; Total equity = 0.35 × Total assets (TA = TL + SE). Debt to equity = 0.65 ÷ 0.35 = 1.86. Equity multiplier = Total assets ÷ Total equity = 1 ÷ 0.35 = 2.86. Check: Equity multiplier = 1 + Debt to equity = 1 + 1.86 = 2.86. [中文白話解釋]: 三個槓桿比率係一個三角形關係，靠 TA = TL + SE 互相轉換。記住 Equity multiplier = 1 + D/E，考試見到任何一個數都可以推返其餘兩個。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): How are the operating cycle and the cash conversion cycle (CCC) computed, and what does a negative CCC indicate? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Operating cycle = Days' inventory + Days' receivables. CCC = Days' inventory + Days' receivables − Days' payables. Days' ratios = 365 ÷ respective turnover (inventory, receivables, payables). A negative CCC (e.g. −10) means the company has excess cash to invest for 10 days; a lower CCC implies higher liquidity. CCC lengthens when: inventory builds in peak seasons; lenient credit policy slows collections; it shortens when suppliers extend payment terms. [中文白話解釋]: 營運週期係由入貨到收錢嘅總日數；現金轉換週期再扣返你拖供應商嘅日數，先係你真正要墊資嘅時間。CCC 越短越好，負數即係人哋嘅錢喺你手度滾住，仲有閒錢可以投資。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): What is free cash flow (FCF) and why is it more informative than net cash from operating activities? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: FCF = Net cash provided by operating activities − Capital expenditures − Dividends. Operating cash flow ignores the investment in new fixed assets needed to maintain operations and the dividends needed to keep investors happy. FCF shows whether the company has enough cash, after funding operations and capex, to pay investors via dividends and share buy backs. [中文白話解釋]: 經營現金流睇落好靚都未算數，因為公司要俾錢維修機器、添置資產先維持到生意，仲要派息氹股東。扣晒呢啲必要開支剩低嘅先係自由現金流，先係真正可自由運用嘅錢。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): Distinguish the internal growth rate (IGR) from the sustainable growth rate (SGR), including both formula versions. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: IGR = maximum growth rate achievable without external funding. Opening asset balance: IGR = ROA × b; Closing asset balance: IGR = (ROA × b) ÷ (1 − ROA × b). SGR = maximum growth rate sustainable without changing the capital structure. Opening equity balance: SGR = ROE × b; Closing equity balance: SGR = (ROE × b) ÷ (1 − ROE × b). b = plowback/retention ratio = Addition to retained earnings ÷ Net income = 1 − Dividend payout ratio. [中文白話解釋]: IGR 話你知唔借錢、唔發新股，單靠留返嘅盈利可以增長幾快；SGR 就准你維持現有槓桿借錢，所以一定高過 IGR。記住 b 係留存比率，唔係派息比率；用期末結餘計就要除返 (1 − ROA×b)。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): Define DOL, DFL and DCL and state how they are related. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: DOL = % change in EBIT ÷ % change in sales; high DOL = high fixed costs relative to variable costs → EBIT volatile vs sales. DFL = % change in EPS ÷ % change in EBIT; DFL of 1.25 means EPS moves 1.25% per 1% change in EBIT. DCL = % change in EPS ÷ % change in sales = DOL × DFL. Total earnings risk = business risk (operating leverage) + financial risk (financial leverage). [中文白話解釋]: 經營槓桿量度銷售變化點樣放大落 EBIT；財務槓桿量度 EBIT 變化點樣放大落 EPS；兩者乘埋就係綜合槓桿，由銷售直達 EPS。固定成本越高、借貸越多，兩層放大器就越勁，好景時勁賺、逆境時勁蝕。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md

Question 5 — Answer: **31 March 2026** (s.60(1) IRO — six-year time limit)
excerpt: M9 Administration of the Tax System in Hong Kong — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: B Model Answer: The assessment raised is an estimated assessmen…
text: M9 Administration of the Tax System in Hong Kong — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: B Model Answer: The assessment raised is an estimated assessment under s.59(3) IRO . An estimated assessment may be raised where no return is filed, where an unacceptable return is filed, or where books are not kept in satisfactory form. Here, Mr Kwan failed to file his 2022/23 profits tax return and his books were unsatisfactory, so the assessor was entitled to assess him based on an estimate of his profits. To object to such an estimated assessment raised in the absence of a return, Mr Kwan must file a valid completed return together with the notice of objection within the one month objection period; otherwise the objection is invalid. 【解題思路】 關鍵事實係「無交報稅表」+「帳簿唔妥」→ 呢個係 s.59(3) 估計評稅嘅典型觸發條件。呢類評稅係 首次 評稅，唔係追加。 A 錯：standard assessment (s.59(1)) 只喺納稅人交咗可接受嘅報稅表時先發出；Mr Kwan 根本無交表。 C 錯：additional assessment (s.60(1)) 係喺已經有評稅、但發現納稅人 not adequately taxed 時追加嘅；呢度之前並無任何評稅。呢個係考官最常考嘅分類邊界 —— estimated（無表→估）vs additional（評漏咗→加）。 D 錯：s.82A 係「罰則」性質嘅補加稅 (additional tax)，唔係一般評稅，而且題目無講 IRD 要罰佢，只係評稅；failure to file 唔會「自動」變 s.82A 罰款。 記憶口訣：無表/表唔得/簿唔妥 → s.59(3) estimated；評少咗 → s.60(1) additional（6 年，fraud/wilful evasion 10 年）。 Question 2 — Answer: C Model Answer: Statement C is correct. Under s.70A IRO, a taxpayer may apply to correct an assessment that is excessive by reason of an error or omission in a return (or an arithmetical error/omission in the tax computation) within six years after the end of the year of assessment concerned, or six months after the relevant notice of assessment is served, whichever is the later . 【解題思路】 C 啱：s.70A 嘅時限就係「課稅年度結束後 6 年」同「評稅通知書送達後 6 個月」取較後者。記住呢條係「更正無心之失」嘅條文，即使評稅已 final and conclusive 都仲用得。 A 錯：呢個係偷龍轉鳳！「6 年 / 6 個月取較後」係 s.70A 嘅時限；objection (s.64(1)) 嘅時限係評稅通知書日期起 1 個月 。考官最鍾意將呢兩條時限對調。 B 錯：holdover of provisional tax 嘅申請死線係「繳稅到期日前 28 天」或「暫繳稅繳稅通知書日期後 14 天」，取較後者 —— 唔係「評稅通知書後 1 個月」（嗰個係 objection 嘅時限）。 D 錯：同 objection 唔同，局長對暫繳稅緩繳申請 無酌情權 接受逾期申請；「不在港／患病可延期」只適用於 objection (s.64(1)(a)) 同埋向 BOR 嘅上訴。 Question 3 — Answer: B Model Answer: Statement B is correct. The additional tax was raised under s.82A IRO — the administrative penalty regime used where the offence is not so serious as to warrant prosecution or the evidence is insufficient for a criminal prosecution. Procedurally, the IRD must give the taxpayer a notice specifying the reasons and inviting written representations within 21 days , consider the representations, and then raise and serve the additional tax assessment, which is assessed personally by the Commissioner or a Deputy Commissioner. The maximum additional tax is 300% of the tax undercharged : 300% × HK$300,000 = HK$900,000, so the HK$600,000 imposed is within the statutory cap. An appeal against an s.82A additional tax assessment lies to the Board of Review (not to the Court). After an s.82A assessment, no criminal charge may be brought on the same facts under s.80(2) or s.82(1). 【解題思路】 題眼係「唔夠嚴重去檢控／證據不足做刑事檢控」+「通知 + 書面申述」→ 呢個係 s.82A 行政罰嘅標準程序（21 天申述期）。 B 啱：上限 = 少徵稅款 × 300% = 300,000 × 3 = 900,000；600,000 係上限之內；s.82A 嘅上訴去 Board of Review。 A 錯：s.82(1) 係 刑事 wilful evasion 條文，由法院判刑（罰款 + 監禁），唔係由 IRD「raise additional tax」；而且刑事案舉證責任在控方、標準係 beyond reasonable doubt。 C 錯：s.80(2) 雖然涵蓋 incorrect return 連少徵稅款，但係 民事法庭程序 ，罰則由 法院 判（level 3 fine + 最高 300%），唔係 IRD 行政評定；納稅人舉證標準係 balance of probability，唔係 beyond reasonable doubt。 D 錯：s.80(1) 只涵蓋 無涉及少徵稅款 嘅一般違規（罰款 level 3）；呢度明明有 HK$300,000 少徵稅款，所以 s.80(1) 唔適用。 分類邊界總結：民事法庭 → s.80(1)/s.80(2)；刑事法庭 → s.82(1)；行政（無法庭程序、上訴去 BOR）→ s.82A。 Question 4 — Answer: HK$138,600 Model Answer / Working: Tax in default: HK$120,000, due 10 January 2024, paid 25 October 2024 → late for more than six months. Step 1 — 5% surcharge (delay not more than six months): 5% × HK$120,000 = HK$6,000 . Step 2 — 10% surcharge (delay over six months): added to the total tax in default including the 5% surcharge imposed earlier : 10% × (HK$120,000 + HK$6,000) = 10% × HK$126,000 = HK$12,600 . Step 3 — Total payable : HK$120,000 + HK$6,000 + HK$12,600 = HK$138,600 . 【解題思路】 逾期超過六個月，兩級附加費都要計：先 5%，再 10%。 最大陷阱：第二級 10% 嘅基數係「欠稅 + 之前已加嘅 5%」（即 126,000），唔係淨欠稅 120,000。如果錯用 120,000 × 10% = 12,000，就會得出 138,000 呢個錯答案。 另一常見錯誤：以為兩級係「二選一」（只加 10%：120,000 × 1.10 = 132,000）—— 唔係，係先加 5% 再喺總額上加 10%。 額外知識：如果 IRD 循法院追討，欠稅人仲要付 court fee HK$630、writ cost HK$300 同判決利息；IRD 亦可以向僱主/銀行/債務人發追稅通知書，甚至申請 Departure Prevention Direction 阻止離港。 Question 5 — Answer: 31 March 2026 (s.60(1) IRO — six year time limit) Model Answer / Working: The year of assessment 2019/20 ended on 31 March 2020 . Under s.60(1) IRO, an additional assessment must be made within six years of the end of the year of assessment to which it relates. Six years after 31 March 2020 → 31 March 2026 . The IRD's additional assessment in May 2025 is therefore within the time limit and valid . The extended ten year limit under s.60(1)(b) (i.e. until 31 March 2030) applies ONLY where the undercharge involves fraud or wilful evasion , which is expressly excluded here. Note: there is no time limit on the collection of tax once assessed. 【解題思路】 計時起點係「課稅年度 結束 日」（2019/20 → 31/3/2020），唔係首次評稅日期（15/3/2021），亦唔係發現少報嘅審計日期。由 31/3/2020 起計六年 → 31/3/2026。 題目特別講明「no fraud or wilful evasion」，目的係考你分唔分到 6 年同 10 年兩條時限：10 年 (s.60(1)(b)) 只限欺詐或蓄意逃稅。如果你答 31 March 2030，就係中咗呢個陷阱。 分類邊界：呢度係 additional assessment (s.60(1))，因為 2019/20 已經有過評稅、而家發現評少咗；唔好同 s.59(3) estimated assessment 撈亂。 相關對照：s.70A 納稅人更正 error/omission 都係「課稅年度結束後 6 年（或通知書送達後 6 個月，取較後）」；紀錄保存係交易後 7 年 (s.51C)；通知 chargeability 係基期結束後 4 個月 (s.51(2))。呢四個數字（1 個月 / 4 個月 / 6 年 / 7 年）係 OTQ 必考時限。

text: M9 Administration of the Tax System in Hong Kong — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Question 1 (MCQ) Mr Kwan carried on a sole proprietorship business in Hong Kong. He failed to file his profits tax return for the year of assessment 2022/23 despite receiving one from the IRD, and his business books were not kept in a satisfactory form. The assessor therefore raised an assessment on him based on an estimate of his profits. Which of the following correctly identifies this assessment and the section under which it was raised? A. Standard assessment under s.59(1), because every profits tax assessment is a standard assessment B. Estimated assessment under s.59(3), raised because no acceptable return was filed and the books were unsatisfactory C. Additional assessment under s.60(1), because the taxpayer had not been adequately taxed D. Additional tax assessment under s.82A, because failure to file a return always attracts a penalty assessment Question 2 (MCQ) Which of the following statements about time limits under the IRO is CORRECT? A. An objection to a notice of assessment must be lodged within six years after the end of the relevant year of assessment or six months after the date of the notice of assessment, whichever is the later. B. An application for holdover of provisional tax must be received by the Commissioner within one month after the date of the notice of assessment. C. An error or omission claim under s.70A must be lodged within six years after the end of the relevant year of assessment or six months after the relevant notice of assessment is served, whichever is the later. D. The Commissioner has discretion to extend the time limit for a holdover of provisional tax if the taxpayer was absent from Hong Kong or sick. Question 3 (MCQ) Ms Liu filed an incorrect tax return without reasonable excuse, resulting in tax undercharged of HK$300,000. The IRD considers that the offence is not serious enough to warrant prosecution and the evidence is insufficient for a criminal prosecution. The Commissioner gives Ms Liu a notice specifying the reasons and invites her written representations, which she submits within the required period. The IRD then raises an assessment of additional tax of HK$600,000 on her. Which of the following is CORRECT? A. The additional tax was raised under s.82(1) and Ms Liu may appeal to the Court. B. The additional tax was raised under s.82A; the maximum additional tax is HK$900,000; and Ms Liu may appeal to the Board of Review. C. The additional tax was raised under s.80(2); the penalty is assessed by the Court; and Ms Liu bears the burden of proof beyond reasonable doubt. D. The additional tax was raised under s.80(1) and the penalty is a fine at level 3 only, so no additional tax could have been imposed. Question 4 (Calculation) A taxpayer's salaries tax of HK$120,000 was due on 10 January 2024 but was not paid until 25 October 2024 (i.e. late for more than six months). The IRD imposes surcharges in accordance with the IRO. Compute the total amount payable by the taxpayer (tax + all surcharges). State your answer in HK$. Question 5 (Fill in) On 15 March 2021, the IRD issued a profits tax assessment to Bright Ltd for the year of assessment 2019/20 (year of assessment ended 31 March 2020). In May 2025, an IRD audit reveals that Bright Ltd's assessable profits for 2019/20 were understated. There is no fraud or wilful evasion involved. State the latest date by which the IRD may validly raise an additional assessment on Bright Ltd for the year of assessment 2019/20, and the section/time limit that governs it.

text: M9 Administration of the Tax System in Hong Kong — Study Pack (Week 2) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 稅務局架構與權力 (IRD structure and powers) ：稅務局 (IRD) 是香港的稅務機關，隸屬財經事務及庫務局 (Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau) 轄下九個部門之一，由稅務局局長 (Commissioner of Inland Revenue, CIR) 及兩名副局長領導，下設六個單位（Commissioner's Unit、Headquarters Unit、Units 1–4）。IRD 依據《稅務條例》(IRO Cap. 112) 有權要求報稅表、索取資料、約見問話 (s.51) 及申請搜查令 (s.51B)；稅務人員須遵守保密規定 (s.4)，但依 DTA/TIEA 交換資料不屬違規。 報稅責任 (Returns) ：香港不設「pay as you earn」制度，僱主與僱員各自獨立申報。個人報稅表 BIR60 每年五月首個工作天發出，一般須於一個月內遞交；利得稅報稅表（法團 BIR51、其他 BIR52）每年四月首個工作天發出。如未獲發報稅表但須課稅，須在有關課稅年度基期結束後四個月內通知局長 (s.51(2))。 評稅與反對 (Assessments and objection) ：三類評稅 —— 標準評稅 (standard assessment, s.59(1))、估計評稅 (estimated assessment, s.59(3))、補加評稅 (additional assessment, s.60(1))。IRD 對利得稅採「先評後查」(assess first, audit later, AFAL)。不滿評稅須於評稅通知書日期起一個月內書面反對 (s.64(1))；程序鏈為：Objection → CIR determination → Board of Review (s.66) → Court of First Instance (s.69) → Court of Appeal → Court of Final Appeal。 緩繳與更正 (Holdover and error/omission claim) ：反對期間稅款原則上仍須繳付 (s.71(2))，可申請有條件或無條件緩繳 (conditional/unconditional holdover)；暫繳稅緩繳申請有嚴格期限且不得延期。評稅若有錯誤或遺漏 (error or omission)，可依 s.70A 在六年內（或評稅通知書發出後六個月，以較後者為準）申請更正。 罰則與追稅 (Offences, penalties and payment) ：四大罰則條文 —— s.80(1)、s.80(2)（民事、法院判罰）、s.82(1)（刑事、舉證須 beyond reasonable doubt）、s.82A（行政罰，以補加稅形式處罰，上限為少徵稅款的 300%，向 Board of Review 上訴）。逾期繳稅加徵 5% 附加費（六個月內），超過六個月再加 10%。 2. 必背考點清單 IRD 架構與法定機構 IRD 六個單位：Commissioner's Unit（appeals、tax treaties）、Headquarters Unit、Unit 1（profits tax — corporations and partnerships）、Unit 2（salaries tax、profits tax — sole proprietorships、property tax — sole owners、personal assessment 之 processing）、Unit 3（collection、stamp duty、estate duty、business registration）、Unit 4（field audits and investigations）。 保密：s.4 IRO；法律要求披露時例外 (s.49(5))；按 DTA/TIEA 交換資料不違反保密條文。 Board of Inland Revenue：獨立於 IRD；主席為財政司司長 (Financial Secretary)；負責訂明報稅表格式及制訂 Inland Revenue Rules（須立法會批准）。 Board of Review (s.65)：獨立法定組織，審理稅務上訴的一審審裁處 (tax tribunal of first instance)；由主席、10 名副主席及不多於 150 名成員組成，全部由行政長官委任；每次聆訊由一名主席加兩名成員組成，多數決；閉門聆訊 (in camera)；無權判給訟費 (no costs order)；對瑣屑無聊上訴可徵收不超過 HK$25,000 費用；事實裁斷為最終 (facts found are final)。 Returns — 期限必背 s.51(1)：任何人須應要求遞交物業稅／薪俸稅／利得稅／綜合報稅表。 s.51(2)：無收到報稅表而須課稅者，須於基期結束後 4 個月 內通知 CIR。 個人報稅表 BIR60：每年五月首個工作天發出，一般 1 個月內交回；獨資業務東主延至八月首個工作天（電子報稅再自動延 1 個月）；由稅務代表代理一般多獲 1 個月延期。 利得稅報稅表（BIR51 法團／BIR52 非法團）：每年四月首個工作天發出，1 個月內交回（12 月年結通常延至八月中、3 月年結延至十一月中）。 物業稅報稅表 BIR57（聯權／分權共有人）；非居民利得稅報稅表 BIR54。 僱主責任 (s.52)：新僱員到職 3 個月內填報 IR56E (s.52(4))；僱員離職前 1 個月申報 (s.52(5))；僱員將離港逾 1 個月，須於離港前 1 個月申報 (s.52(6)) 並扣起應付款項 (s.52(7))；僱主報稅表須於收到後 1 個月內遞交 (s.52(2))；薪酬紀錄保存至少 7 年 (s.51C)。 Assessments 三類評稅：standard (s.59(1))；estimated（無報稅表、報稅表不被接受或帳簿不妥，s.59(3)）；additional（少評稅款，s.60(1)）。 補加評稅時限：有關課稅年度結束後 6 年 內 (s.60(1))；涉及 fraud 或 wilful evasion 延長至 10 年 (s.60(1)(b))。徵稅本身無時限。 評稅最終確定 (final and conclusive, s.70)：未依時提出有效反對或上訴；反對被撤回或駁回；雙方同意修訂評稅 (s.64(3))；BOR 裁定且拒絕轉介法院。 反對估計評稅（無報稅表情況下發出）時，必須連同有效報稅表一併於一個月反對期內遞交，否則反對無效。 業務紀錄保存期：不少於交易完成後 7 年 (s.51C)。 Objection / Holdover / Error or Omission Objection (s.64(1))：評稅通知書日期起 1 個月 內書面提出，述明反對理由；舉證責任在納稅人 (burden of proof on taxpayer, s.68(4))。逾期可因不在香港、患病或其他合理因由獲准延期 (s.64(1)(a))。CIR 裁定可 confirm / reduce / increase / annul 評稅 (s.64(2) 須在合理時間內裁定)。 Holdover of tax in dispute (s.71(2))：conditional holdover（須購買 Tax Reserve Certificates 或提供銀行擔保 banker's undertaking）；unconditional holdover（罕見，敗訴後須付稅加利息，利率由終審法院首席法官指定）。TRC 受 Tax Reserve Certificates Ordinance (Cap. 289) 規管。 暫繳稅緩繳 (holdover of provisional tax)：物業稅 s.63O、薪俸稅 s.63E、利得稅 s.63J；常見理由為應評稅值／入息／利潤 likely to be less than 90% of the provisional amount assessed。申請期限： 繳稅到期日前 28 天 或 暫繳稅繳稅通知書日期後 14 天 ，以較後者為準 —— 局長 無酌情權延期 。 Error or omission claim (s.70A)：課稅年度結束後 6 年 內，或有關評稅通知書送達後 6 個月 內（以較後者為準），可就更正報稅表中的錯誤或遺漏、或稅款計算的算術錯誤申請更正。若評稅是按當時通行慣例作出，則不得更正。案例： Extramoney Ltd v CIR （'error or omission' 包括 error of law）； Moulin Global Eyecare Trading Ltd v CIR (2014)（董事蓄意造假屬 deliberate act，非 error，s.70A 不適用）。 Offences and Penalties（Exhibit 2.1 對比必背） s.80(1)：無合理辯解的一般不遵從（不涉及少徵稅款），民事，罰款 level 3（HK$10,000），法院判罰，納稅人須以 balance of probability 舉證，向法院上訴。 s.80(2)：無合理辯解提交不正確報稅表並涉及少徵稅款，民事，罰款 level 3 + 最高少徵稅款 300%，法院判罰。 s.82(1)：wilful evasion，刑事，控方須證明 beyond reasonable doubt 及 dishonest intention (mens rea)；簡易程序定罪：level 3 + 300% + 監禁 6 個月；循公訴程序定罪：level 5（HK$50,000）+ 300% + 監禁 3 年。 s.82A：行政罰 —— 由 CIR 或副局長親自評定補加稅 (additional tax)，最高為少徵稅款的 300%，無法庭程序；程序：發通知述明理由 → 納稅人 21 天內書面申述 → 考慮後發出補加稅評稅；向 Board of Review 上訴；其後不得就同一事實再依 s.80(2) 或 s.82(1) 檢控。 CIR 可選擇：檢控 (prosecution)、以罰款代替檢控 (compound, s.80(5)/s.82(2)，見 DIPN 11 [Revised])、或評定補加稅 (s.82A)。 Reasonable excuse：IRO 無定義；BOR 接受 honest belief of non taxability、reasonable reliance on expert advice、simple slip of the mind；不接受 ignorance of law、low level of education、incompetent staff。 案例： Koo Ming Kown & Murakami Tadao v CIR [2021] HKCA 1037 —— 公司作為納稅人的罰則不能自動加諸董事身上。 罰則主要目的：commercial restitution（彌補延遲收稅的損失）、阻嚇、教育。 Appeals 向 BOR 上訴 (s.66)：CIR determination 後 1 個月 內書面提出，述明上訴理由並將副本送交 CIR；患病或不在港可獲延期。 繞過 BOR 直達 CFI (s.67)：雙方於向 BOR 遞交上訴後 21 天 內書面同意。 BOR → CFI (s.69)：BOR 裁決日期（或書面送達日期）起 1 個月 內，只限 point of law，須申請許可 (leave to appeal)，須證明有 reasonable prospect of success 或符合 interests of justice。 繞過 CFI 直達 CA (s.69A)：稅款重大、具公眾重要性、案件特別困難或有其他充分理由，經法院許可 leapfrog 至 Court of Appeal。 向 BOR 遞交上訴所需文件：Notice of Assessment、Commissioner's determination、taxpayer's representations、statement of grounds of appeal。 Payment of Taxes 逾期 ≤ 6 個月：加徵 5% 附加費；逾期 6 個月：再加徵 10% （以包括先前 5% 在內的欠稅總額計）。 薪俸稅一般分兩期繳付（付款日通常在一月至四月之間）；物業稅及利得稅通常只有一個繳款日。 追稅措施：法院訴訟（另付 court fee HK$630、writ cost HK$300 及判決利息）、向第三者（僱主、銀行、債務人）發追稅通知書、申請 Departure Prevention Direction 阻止欠稅人離港。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：Objection (s.64) vs Error or Omission Claim (s.70A) Objection：針對「評稅員的判斷」（例如某項扣除被拒絕），須在評稅通知書日期起 1 個月 內提出；逾期只有在「不在香港／患病／其他合理因由」下才可能獲接納 (s.64(1)(a))。 s.70A claim：針對報稅表中的 error or omission （無心之失，如算術錯誤、漏報免稅額），時限為課稅年度結束後 6 年 或評稅通知書送達後 6 個月 （以較後者為準）；即使是 final and conclusive 的評稅也可更正。 例子：納稅人在 2019/20 報稅表因 transposition error 多報了薪金 —— 這是 inadvertent error，應用 s.70A 更正（時限寬得多）；若納稅人只是不同意評稅員拒絕某扣除 claim，報稅表本身無錯 —— 只能依 s.64 在 1 個月內反對。考官常把兩條時限對調作為干擾選項：「objection 可在 6 年內提出」是錯的。 Pitfall 2：Estimated Assessment (s.59(3)) vs Additional Assessment (s.60(1)) Estimated assessment：納稅人 未交報稅表 、報稅表不被接受或帳簿不妥時，評稅員「估計」應評稅額；屬首次評稅，不是追加。反對此類評稅時必須連同填妥的報稅表一併遞交，否則反對無效。 Additional assessment：已經有評稅，但發現納稅人「未被充分評稅」(not adequately taxed)，就 追加 評稅；時限為課稅年度結束後 6 年（fraud/wilful evasion 為 10 年）。 例子：Chichi 沒有交利得稅報稅表，IRD 估算其利潤發出評稅 —— 這是 estimated assessment；其後審計發現已評稅的年度少報了版稅收入 —— 追加的是 additional assessment，受 6 年時限約束。切勿以為「估計評稅也要等 6 年時限」或「additional assessment 可以取代從未提交的報稅表」。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What are the requirements for a valid objection to an assessment under s.64(1) IRO, and what special rule applies when objecting to an estimated assessment raised in the absence of a return? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Must be in writing, stating precisely the grounds of objection; Must be lodged within ONE MONTH after the date of the notice of assessment; Late objection may be accepted only if the taxpayer was prevented by absence from Hong Kong, illness or other reasonable excuse (s.64(1)(a)); For an estimated assessment raised in the absence of a return, a valid completed return MUST be filed together with the notice of objection within the one month objection period, otherwise the objection is invalid; Burden of proof is on the taxpayer to show the assessment is incorrect or excessive. [中文白話解釋]：反對必須書面、講清楚理由、並且在評稅通知書日期起一個月內交到稅務局；過期只可以靠「離港、生病、其他合理因由」求情。如果係針對無報稅表情況下發出的估計評稅，一定要連同填妥嘅報稅表一齊交，否則反對無效。舉證責任在納稅人。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): A taxpayer discovered an error in her 2018/19 tax return (an inadvertent transposition error that overstated income). Under s.70A IRO, what is the deadline to apply for correction, and in what circumstances will NO correction be allowed? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Deadline: within SIX YEARS after the end of the relevant year of assessment, OR SIX MONTHS after the relevant notice of assessment is served, whichever is the LATER; For 2018/19 (year of assessment ended 31 March 2019): deadline = 31 March 2025 (or 6 months after the notice if later); 'Error or omission' includes arithmetical errors, omission to claim an expense/deduction/allowance, error or omission of fact, and even an error of law (Extramoney Ltd v CIR); NO correction if the assessment was made in accordance with the practice prevailing at the time the return/statement was made; NO correction for a deliberate act — fraudulent filing is not an 'error' (Moulin Global Eyecare Trading Ltd v CIR). [中文白話解釋]：s.70A 係用嚟更正「無心之失」，時限係課稅年度結束後六年、或者評稅通知書送達後六個月，兩者取較後。如果評稅係跟當時通行做法做嘅，就唔可以更改正；蓄意造假（如 Moulin Global 案）唔算 error，s.70A 幫唔到。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): Name the three types of tax assessments under the IRO, their authorising sections, and the time limit for raising an additional assessment. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Standard assessment — s.59(1): raised when an acceptable return is filed; Estimated assessment — s.59(3): raised when no return is filed, the return is unacceptable, or books are not kept in satisfactory form; Additional assessment — s.60(1): raised where the taxpayer has not been adequately taxed; Time limit for additional assessment: within 6 years after the end of the year of assessment concerned; extended to 10 years in cases of fraud or wilful evasion (s.60(1)(b)); There is NO time limit on the collection of tax once assessed. [中文白話解釋]：三種評稅要連條文一齊背：正常報稅後發出嘅係 standard（s.59(1)）；無交表或帳簿唔合格就用 estimated（s.59(3)）；評漏咗就用 additional（s.60(1)）。補加評稅一般六年內要發出，涉及欺詐或蓄意逃稅就十年；但稅一經評定，追收係無時限嘅。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): What is the deadline for applying for a holdover of provisional tax, and can the Commissioner extend it? Contrast this with the late objection rule. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Deadline: application must be received by the Commissioner not later than 28 days before the payment due date of the provisional tax, OR 14 days after the date of the notice for payment of provisional tax, whichever is the LATER; The Commissioner has NO discretionary power to extend this time limit; Contrast: a late objection under s.64(1)(a) MAY be accepted if the taxpayer was prevented by absence from Hong Kong, illness or other reasonable excuse; Typical holdover ground: assessable profits / net chargeable income / assessable value for the year is likely to be less than 90% of the provisional amount assessed (ss.63J / 63E / 63O). [中文白話解釋]：暫繳稅緩繳申請死線係「繳稅日前 28 天」同「通知書日期後 14 天」取較後，而且局長完全無權延期——同反對唔同，反對遲咗仲可以用合理因由求情。記住 90% 呢個門檻：預計今年應課稅額低過暫繳額九成係最常用理由。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): Compare the four penalty regimes: s.80(1), s.80(2), s.82(1) and s.82A IRO — nature of proceedings, burden of proof, who assesses the penalty, maximum penalty, and appeal route. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: s.80(1): civil; taxpayer proves reasonable excuse on balance of probability; Court assesses; fine at level 3 (HK$10,000); appeal to Court; s.80(2): civil; incorrect return with tax undercharged; Court assesses; level 3 fine + up to 300% of tax undercharged; appeal to Court; s.82(1): CRIMINAL (wilful evasion); prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt with mens rea (dishonesty); Court assesses; summary conviction: level 3 + up to 300% + 6 months' imprisonment; on indictment: level 5 (HK$50,000) + up to 300% + 3 years' imprisonment; appeal to Court; s.82A: ADMINISTRATIVE additional tax, no legal proceedings; raised personally by the CIR or a Deputy Commissioner; max 300% of tax undercharged; taxpayer must be given notice and 21 days to make written representations; appeal to the BOARD OF REVIEW (not the Court); bars later prosecution on the same facts under s.80(2)/s.82(1). [中文白話解釋]：s.82A 係行政罰，唔使上法庭，由局長或副局長親自出補加稅評稅，上限係少徵稅款三倍，上訴去 Board of Review 而唔係法院；s.82(1) 係刑事，控方要證到 beyond reasonable doubt 兼證明有欺詐意圖；s.80(1) 同 s.80(2) 係民事，納稅人以 balance of probability 證明自己有 reasonable excuse。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): A taxpayer's profits tax of HK$200,000 fell due on 5 January but remained unpaid until 20 September of the same year (over six months late). Compute the total amount payable under the surcharge rules. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Delay not more than 6 months: 5% surcharge on total tax in default → 5% × 200,000 = HK$10,000; Delay over 6 months: a further 10% surcharge on the total tax in default INCLUDING the 5% surcharge already imposed → 10% × (200,000 + 10,000) = HK$21,000; Total payable = 200,000 + 10,000 + 21,000 = HK$231,000 ; Note: the Commissioner may accept payment by instalments, but surcharge may still be added. [中文白話解釋]：遲交稅六個月內加 5%；超過六個月再加 10%，而呢 10% 嘅計算基數係「欠稅＋之前嗰 5%」。所以 200,000 先加 10,000，再用 210,000 乘 10% 得 21,000，總共要畀 231,000。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): State an employer's key notification obligations to the IRD under s.52 IRO (new employee, cessation of employment, employee leaving Hong Kong) with the relevant time limits and sections. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: New employee likely chargeable to salaries tax: notify within 3 months of commencement, on Form IR56E (s.52(4)); Cessation of employment (or death): notify not later than 1 month before the date of termination (s.52(5)); Employee leaving Hong Kong for more than 1 month (other than normal business trips): notify at least 1 month before expected departure (s.52(6)) and withhold all payments due to the employee from the date of filing the departure notice until departure (s.52(7)); Employer's return of all employees: file within 1 month of receipt (s.52(2)); Payroll records: retain for at least 7 years (s.51C); No general obligation to withhold salaries tax — Hong Kong has no PAYE system. [中文白話解釋]：僱主三大申報死線：新人到職 3 個月內報 IR56E；員工離職前 1 個月報；員工要離港超過 1 個月，離港前 1 個月報兼扣住佢應得嘅錢（由報離港通知到離港日）。香港無 PAYE，所以僱主一般唔使預扣薪俸稅，唯一例外係員工離港個案。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): Describe the tax appeal ladder after the CIR determines an objection, including the bypass provisions (ss.66, 67, 69, 69A IRO). Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: s.66: appeal to the Board of Review within 1 month after the CIR's determination, in writing with grounds, copy to the CIR (extension possible for illness/absence from HK); Board of Review: tax tribunal of first instance; panel of 3 (one chairman + two members); in camera; facts found are final; burden of proof on taxpayer (s.68(4)); may impose a fee up to HK$25,000 for vexatious appeals; no costs order; s.67: bypass BOR and go directly to the CFI if BOTH parties agree in writing within 21 days from the date the appeal was lodged with the BOR; s.69: appeal BOR decision to the CFI within 1 month, on a point of LAW only, with leave (reasonable prospect of success / interests of justice); s.69A: leapfrog from the BOR directly to the Court of Appeal with the court's permission where the tax in dispute is significant, the matter is of public importance, or the case is extraordinarily difficult. [中文白話解釋]：上訴階梯：反對 → CIR 裁定 → 一個月內上訴去 BOR → 一個月內（限法律觀點、要申請許可）上 CFI → CA → CFA。兩條「跳級」條文要分清楚：s.67 係雙方 21 天內書面同意繞過 BOR 直去 CFI；s.69A 係經法院許可由 BOR 直接跳去 CA。BOR 審事實同法律，法院只審法律觀點。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md

text: M9 Principles of Taxation — Chapter 3 Profits Tax — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） 🔄 Retest Answers（W2 錯題重測） Retest R1 — Answer: (i) 31 March 2027; (ii) Yes, in time; (iii) s.60(1) IRO Model Answer: Under s.60(1) IRO, an additional assessment must be raised within six years of the end of the year of assessment to which it relates. The year of assessment 2020/21 ended on 31 March 2021, so the latest date is 31 March 2027 . The audit discovery in September 2026 is therefore within time and the additional assessment may validly be raised. The extended ten year limit under s.60(1)(b) applies only where the undercharge involves fraud or wilful evasion , which is excluded here. 【解題思路】計時起點係 YA 結束日 （31/3/2021），唔係首次評稅日（10/6/2021）、唔係 audit 發現日。6 年 → 31/3/2027。10 年條款只限 fraud/wilful evasion。Fill in 電報式作答示範： 31 March 2027; yes, in time; s.60(1) — 6 years from end of YA 已經足夠攞滿分。 Question 1 — Correct Answer: B English Model Answer: Option B is a revenue receipt. Compensation received for the temporary loss of use of an asset is revenue in nature because it represents the trading profits which the owner would have earned had it had the use of the asset (London & Thames Haven Oil Wharves Ltd v Attwooll (1966) 43 TC 491). The sum takes the character of the trading profits it replaces (Lincolnshire Sugar v Smart (1937) AC 697). 【解題思路】 核心概念 ：賠償金的性質取決於它「取代了甚麼」——取代營業利潤 → revenue（應課稅）；取代資本資產或業務結構 → capital（s.14(1) 豁免）。 A 錯 ：取消構成企業整個業務框架（the very structure of the business）的總代理協議，賠償屬 capital receipt，不課稅（Van den Berghs Ltd v Clark (1935) AC 431）。結構性合約本身視同資本資產。 C 錯 ：Harbour Textiles 是成衣貿易商，寫字樓物業不是其 trading stock；自用八年、被動接受收購建議，按 badges of trade 整體評估屬出售資本資產，收益獲 s.14(1) 豁免。 D 錯 ：來自已課利得稅公司的股息按 s.26 豁免（避免雙重課稅）。 邊界陷阱 ：本題正是 capital / revenue 的分界線——「暫時失去使用權」的賠償是 revenue，「資產永久喪失或絕育（sterilisation）」的賠償才是 capital（Glenboig Union Fireclay Co Ltd v IRC (1921)）。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: B English Model Answer: Option B is deductible under s.16(1)(d). A trade debt is allowable where it (i) has been proved to the satisfaction of the assessor to have become bad during the year (commercially irrecoverable — recovery actions taken but in vain), and (ii) was previously included as a taxable trading receipt (or was money lent in the ordinary course of a money lending business carried on in Hong Kong). 【解題思路】 A 錯 ：一般撥備（general provision）憑粗略估計、無足夠文件證據，不被視為已「招致（incurred）」的開支（CIR v Lo & Lo (1984)），不可扣；只有具體撥備（specific provision）才可扣。 C 錯 ：購置營業處所的成本（包括相關印花稅及律師費）屬資本性開支，被 s.17(1)(c) 禁止扣除（可考慮 CBA 每年 4%，但不能直接扣除）。 D 錯 ：認可慈善捐款（s.16D）必須捐予按香港法律屬慈善、獲 s.88 豁免的機構；僅在內地運作的教育基金不符合資格，全數不可扣（亦不在 HK$100–35% 的扣除機制之內）。 答題順序口訣 ：先問 s.16(1)（是否為產生應課稅利潤而招致）→ 再問 s.17 有無禁止 → 最後看 ss.16A–16L 有無明訂扣除。 Question 3 — Correct Answer: A English Model Answer: Under DIPN 21, the locality of trading profits is generally determined by the place where the contracts of purchase and sale are effected, "effected" embracing the whole process of contract formation (solicitation of orders, negotiation, conclusion, trade financing, shipment and performance — CIR v Magna Industrial Co Ltd (1997) HKLRD 171). Where either contract is effected in Hong Kong, the IRD's initial presumption is that the profits are fully taxable , although in practice greater weight is usually attached to the contract of sale. Here, the purchase contract was effected in Hong Kong, so the profits are prima facie Hong Kong source and fully chargeable. 【解題思路】 B 錯 ：雖然實務上售貨合約（contract of sale）權重較大，但 DIPN 21 的初步推定是「買或賣其中一份在港洽訂 → 全部應課稅」，不能單憑售貨合約在倫敦就斷定離岸。 C 錯 ：50:50 分攤只適用於 contract processing （來料加工——港方參與內地製造工序且法律所有權不轉移）的製造業安排；本案是純貿易（trading），不適用，稅局實務上對貿易利潤採「全有或全無（all or nothing）」取態。 D 錯 ：客戶所在地及貨物交付地並非決定性因素；來源地看的是產生利潤的運作（operations test, CIR v Hang Seng Bank (1991)），即合約洽訂的實質過程在哪裡進行。 考試貼士 ：見到 trading profit 來源題，立即寫出「where the contracts of purchase and sale are effected」再逐步分析，切勿用居民身分或收付款地點作答。 Question 4 — Correct Answer: HK$228,000 English Model Answer & Working: Depreciation allowances for machinery and plant — pooling system (s.39B): 30% Pool (HK$) 20% Pool (HK$) Allowance (HK$) Cost 300,000 60,000 Less: Initial allowance (60%) (180,000) (36,000) 216,000 120,000 24,000 Less: Annual allowance (30% / 20%) (36,000) (4,800) 40,800 Reducing value c/f 84,000 19,200 Total depreciation allowances = HK$216,000 + HK$40,800 = HK$256,800 【解題思路】 第一步：按年度免稅額率分 pool——motor lorry 入 30% pool，photocopier 入 20% pool。 第二步：每項新購資產先有 IA = 成本 × 60% （s.39B(1)）：lorry 300,000 × 60% = 180,000；photocopier 60,000 × 60% = 36,000。 第三步：扣完 IA 後的 reducing value 再按 pool 率計 AA ：lorry 120,000 × 30% = 36,000；photocopier 24,000 × 20% = 4,800。 第四步：IA + AA 合計 = 216,000 + 40,800 = HK$256,800 。 常見錯誤 ：(i) 把 AA 按原成本而非 reducing value 計（AA 會錯計為 90,000 + 12,000 = 102,000，合計錯得 318,000）；(ii) 忘記 IA 是 60% 而非 100%（100% 只適用於 s.16G PFA 等明訂扣除，題目已表明不適用）；(iii) 把不同比率的資產放入同一 pool。 考試貼士 ：題目列明 “None of the assets qualifies under ss.16B, 16G or 16H–16K” 就是要排除 100% 即扣的誘惑——讀到這句要立刻確認走 s.39B pooling 路線。 Question 5 — Correct Answers: (i) HK$1,950,000; (ii) HK$160,875 English Model Answer & Working: Starbright Ltd — Profits Tax Computation HK$ Net profit before taxation 2,400,000 Less: Gain on disposal of office premises (capital asset, exempt under s.14(1)) (300,000) Less: Hong Kong bank deposit interest (exempt — Exemption from Profits Tax (Interest Income) Order; deposit not used to secure any borrowing) (40,000) Less: Dividend from Hong Kong subsidiary chargeable to profits tax (exempt under s.26) (60,000) Add: Accounting depreciation (non deductible, s.17(1)(c)) 120,000 Add: Fine for breach of law (non deductible, s.17) 30,000 2,150,000 Less: Depreciation allowances (Part VI / s.18F) (200,000) Net assessable profits 1,950,000 Profits tax payable (two tiered rates, corporation): HK$1,950,000 ≤ HK$2,000,000 → wholly at 8.25% Tax payable = 1,950,000 × 8.25% = HK$160,875 【解題思路】 按利得稅計算五部曲：(1) 扣非應評稅收入；(2) 加回不可扣開支；(3) 加 balancing charge（本題無）；(4) 扣折舊免稅額；(5) 扣結轉虧損（本題無）。 豁免收入三兄弟 ：資本收益（s.14(1)）、港銀行存款利息（存款無抵押可扣稅借款，Exemption Order 適用）、已課稅公司股息（s.26）——全部要從會計利潤剔除。 加回項目 ：會計折舊屬資本性攤分，s.17(1)(c) 不扣，由稅務折舊免稅額（HK$200,000）取代；罰款（penalties/fines for breaking the law）明確不可扣。 稅款計算 ：應評稅利潤 HK$1,950,000 未超過 HK$2M 門檻，全額按 8.25%，無須分段。HK$1,950,000 × 8.25% = HK$160,875。 常見錯誤 ：(i) 忘記剔除資本收益，把 HK$300,000 留低計稅；(ii) 誤以為銀行利息一律要課稅——留意題目關鍵句 “not used to secure any borrowing”，若存款用作抵押而借款利息獲扣，豁免即不適用；(iii) 兩級制下誤用 16.5% 全額計，或對首 HK$2M 誤用 15%/7.5%（非法團稅率）；(iv) 忘記扣除稅務折舊免稅額而直接以 HK$2,150,000 計稅。

text: M9 Principles of Taxation — Chapter 3 Profits Tax — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 「限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位）」 🔄 Retest Section — W2 錯題重測（先做呢 1 條，另計時 2.5 分鐘） 測返你 W2 Q5 嘅弱點：記住 rule 之外， 一定要答到日期 + 條文編號 。啱 → 剔除；錯 → 帶落 W4。 Retest R1 (Fill in) — from Ch2 Q5 (additional assessment time limit) On 10 June 2021, the IRD issued a profits tax assessment to Dragon Ltd for the year of assessment 2020/21 (year of assessment ended 31 March 2021). In September 2026, an IRD audit reveals that Dragon Ltd's assessable profits for 2020/21 were understated. There is no fraud or wilful evasion . State (i) the latest date by which the IRD may validly raise an additional assessment, (ii) whether the September 2026 discovery is still within time, and (iii) the governing section . Question 1 (MCQ) — Capital vs Revenue Receipts Harbour Textiles Ltd carries on the business of garment trading in Hong Kong. During the year, it received the following sums. Which one is a REVENUE receipt chargeable to profits tax? A. Compensation of HK$3,000,000 received from a supplier for the cancellation of a sole distributorship agreement that constituted the entire framework of the company's business. B. Compensation of HK$400,000 received from an insurer for the loss of use of a delivery truck during the three months in which it was being repaired after an accident. C. A gain of HK$2,000,000 from the disposal of the company's office premises in Central, which it had occupied for eight years, sold after an unsolicited offer from a developer. D. A dividend of HK$250,000 received from a Hong Kong company which is itself chargeable to profits tax. Question 2 (MCQ) — Deductibility (ss.16–17) Which of the following items of expenditure is DEDUCTIBLE in computing assessable profits? A. A general provision for doubtful debts of HK$80,000 made by a trading company, estimated at 2% of total trade receivables without debtor by debtor analysis or supporting documents. B. A trade debt of HK$120,000 written off during the year, which had previously been included as a taxable trading receipt, after repeated recovery actions proved unsuccessful. C. Legal and stamp duty costs of HK$95,000 incurred on the acquisition of new business premises occupied by the company for its own operations. D. A donation of HK$50,000 made to an education fund established and operating exclusively in Mainland China which is not exempt under s.88 of the IRO. Question 3 (MCQ) — Source of Trading Profits (DIPN 21) Pacific Merchandising Ltd, a Hong Kong company carrying on a merchandise trading business in Hong Kong, purchased goods from a supplier under a contract of purchase negotiated and concluded in Hong Kong, and resold the same goods to a customer under a contract of sale negotiated and concluded in London. Applying the IRD's assessing practice under DIPN 21, the trading profits are: A. Fully chargeable to profits tax in Hong Kong, because where either the contract of purchase or the contract of sale is effected in Hong Kong, the initial presumption is that the profits are fully taxable. B. Not chargeable to profits tax, because the contract of sale — the contract which in substance gives rise to the profits — was effected outside Hong Kong. C. Apportioned on a fifty fifty basis between Hong Kong and the United Kingdom, in the same way as contract processing arrangements. D. Not chargeable to profits tax, because the customer is located overseas and the goods were never delivered to Hong Kong. Question 4 (Objective Calculation) — Depreciation Allowances (Pooling System) Glory Ltd commenced business in Hong Kong and makes up accounts to 31 December each year. During its first year of trading, it purchased the following items of machinery and plant, all used wholly in the production of assessable profits: Asset Cost (HK$) Annual allowance rate Motor lorry 300,000 30% Photocopier 60,000 20% None of the assets qualifies under ss.16B, 16G or 16H–16K. Compute the TOTAL depreciation allowances (initial allowance + annual allowance) that Glory Ltd may claim for the year of assessment in which the expenditure was incurred. (State your answer in HK$.) Question 5 (Objective Calculation) — Assessable Profits and Profits Tax Payable Starbright Ltd is a Hong Kong corporation carrying on a trading business wholly in Hong Kong, and is the only entity in its group electing the two tiered profits tax rates. For the year of assessment, its profit and loss account shows a net profit before taxation of HK$2,400,000, after taking into account the following items: Income credited: gain on disposal of office premises held for ten years as a capital asset HK$300,000; interest on a Hong Kong bank deposit (not used to secure any borrowing) HK$40,000; dividend from a Hong Kong subsidiary chargeable to profits tax HK$60,000. Expenses charged: accounting depreciation HK$120,000; a fine for breach of Hong Kong law HK$30,000. Depreciation allowances agreed with the IRD for the year amount to HK$200,000. There are no losses brought forward and no approved charitable donations. Compute (i) Starbright Ltd's net assessable profits, and (ii) its profits tax payable for the year. (State both answers in HK$.) Answers: see M9_Ch3_Profits_Tax_Answers.md — complete the quiz under timed conditions first!

text: M9 Principles of Taxation — Chapter 3 Profits Tax — Study Pack (Weeks 3–4) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 三管齊下測試（three limbed test, s.14 IRO） ：利得稅（Profits Tax）只向「在香港經營行業、專業或業務（trade, profession or business）」的人士，就其「源自香港（arise in or derive from Hong Kong）」的應評稅利潤（assessable profits）徵收；三個條件缺一不可，出售資本資產的收益（gains from sale of capital assets）明確獲豁免（s.14(1)）。 來源地原則（source of profits） ：以 CIR v Hang Seng Bank (1991) 確立的「概括指導原則（broad guiding principle）」為核心——看納稅人「做了甚麼去賺取利潤、在哪裡做」（operations test），並剔除先行或附帶事項（antecedent or incidental matters）；屬事實與法律混合問題，須逐案判斷。 扣除制度（deductions regime） ：s.16 一般扣除規則（in the production of chargeable profits）配合 s.17 的禁止扣除項目；資本性開支原則上不可扣（s.17(1)(c)），但 ss.16A–16L 有明訂扣除（如 R&D、prescribed fixed assets、refurbishment），其餘靠折舊免稅額（depreciation allowances: 機器 P&M、工業建築 IBA、商業建築 CBA）。 視同應課稅收入（deemed trading receipts, s.15） ：即使不符合 s.14，特許權使用費（royalties, ss.15(1)(a)/(b)/(ba)/(bb)）及某些利息（ss.15(1)(f)/(g)/(i)）仍被視為應課稅，預扣機制（withholding, s.20B）由付款人負責。 稅率與虧損（rates & loss relief） ：兩級制稅率（two tiered rates）——法團首 HK$2M 按 8.25%、其後 16.5%；非法團 7.5% / 15%；集團內只有一個關連實體可享用兩級制。虧損可無限期結轉（carried forward indefinitely）抵銷未來應評稅利潤。 2. 必背考點清單 A. 徵收範圍與稅率（Scope & Rates） s.14(1) IRO ：profits tax charged on every person carrying on a trade, profession or business in HK in respect of assessable profits arising in or derived from HK — excluding profits from the sale of capital assets 。 s.2(1) ：“person” includes a corporation, partnership, trustee or body of persons；“trade” includes every adventure and concern in the nature of trade。 Rates（Schedules 1, 8, 8A, 8B） ：Corporations 16.5%（首 HK$2M：8.25%）；non corporations 15%（首 HK$2M：7.5%），自 2018/19 起生效；同組關連實體只有一個可用兩級制。 Exemptions ：capital gains（s.14(1)）；dividends from corporations chargeable to profits tax（s.26）；offshore funds（ss.20AC/20ACA）；HK bank deposit interest（非金融機構）—— Exemption from Profits Tax (Interest Income) Order， 但如存款用作抵押而相關借款利息可扣稅，則不獲豁免 。 B. Badges of Trade（ Marson v Morton (1986)） 1. Profit seeking motive（牟利動機） 2. Subject matter of the transaction（資產性質） 3. Number of transactions（交易次數／重複性） 4. Length of period of ownership（持有期長短） 5. Supplementary work on the property（增值加工） 6. Circumstances responsible for realisation（出售原因，如急需套現） 7. Manner of sale（出售方式） 8. Method of acquisition（取得方式，繼承／受贈傾向非營業） 9. Source of financing（融資方式，短期貸款指向轉售） 注意 ：badges of trade 不是 checklist，須整體評估（ CIR v Church Body of the HK Sheng Kung Hui (2016)）；個人買賣股票一般視為投資／投機而非交易（ Lee Yee Shing Jacky v CIR (2008)）。 C. 利潤來源地（Source of Profits — DIPN 21） Operations test ：納稅人（或代其行事者）產生該利潤的實質運作在哪裡進行。 Trading profits ：以買賣合約「洽訂地點（where contracts of purchase and sale are effected）」為主；effected 包括 solicitation of orders、negotiation、conclusion、trade financing、shipment、performance（ CIR v Magna Industrial (1997)）。如買或賣其中一份合約在港洽訂， 初步推定全部應課稅 ，通常較重視 sale contract。 Manufacturing profits ：以實際製造地為來源（ HK TVB International (1992)）； contract processing （港方提供 know how/品質控制/原料，法律所有權不轉移）可按 50:50 分攤； import processing （向關連內地廠買原料、售回製成品，title 有轉移）屬貿易利潤，按貿易規則，不可分攤（ CIR v Datatronic (2009)）。 Commissions / service fees ：以提供服務地點為準（ CIR v Indosuez WI Carr Securities (2002)； CIR v Li & Fung (Trading) (2012)——後台行政不算）。 Real estate ：物業所在地（ Rhodesia Metals (1940)）。 Listed securities ：證券買賣的交易所所在地；unlisted：買賣合約洽訂地。 Interest（非金融機構） ：provision of credit test——資金首次提供予借款人的地點（DIPN 13）；不考慮利息支付地、借款人用途、帳戶地、協議簽署地、居民身分、貨幣。金融機構／放貸業務用 operations test（ CIR v Orion Caribbean (1997)）。 Royalties（非 s.15(1)(a)/(b)/(ba) 涵蓋者） ：授權的取得及批出地點（DIPN 49）。 「Rare case」dictum（ HK TVB International , obiter, DIPN 21 para 17） ：主要營業地在港的納稅人，賺取非應課稅利潤屬罕見——但 Newfair Holdings v CIR [2022] 確認公司只就其「所做（what it does）」而非「所是（what it is）」課稅。 D. 視同應課稅收入（s.15）與預扣（s.20B / s.21A） s.15(1)(a) ：在港放映／使用電影、電視影片、錄音、相關廣告材料的版稅。 s.15(1)(b) ：在港使用（或有權使用）專利、設計、商標、版權材料、集成電路布圖設計、表演者權利、植物品種權、秘密配方等的版稅。 s.15(1)(ba) ：在港 以外 使用上述知識產權，但付款人的版稅開支在香港獲扣稅（tax symmetry，以扣除額為限）。 s.15(1)(bb) ：表演者／主辦方就在港表演轉讓表演者權利的款項。 s.21A 評稅基礎 ：一般 = 版稅總額 × 30% ；如 (i) 收自相聯人士（associated person） 且 (ii) 該知識產權曾由在港經營業務的人士全部或部分擁有 → 100% 。 預扣（s.20B） ：由香港付款人預扣並代繳；有效稅率 = 30% × 16.5% = 4.95% （或兩級制下 8.25% × 30% = 2.475%）；屬 100% 情況則按全額稅率。此為香港唯一的預扣稅。 s.15(1)(f)/(g)/(i) ：在港經營的法團／其他人／金融機構收取源自香港的利息。 s.15C ：停業時未售出的 trading stock 視為以市值出售。 s.15D ：停業後收取／支付的款項，如本應課稅／可扣，視為停業年度的應評稅利潤／可扣開支（停業後的撥備不可扣；已獲扣除的壞帳停業後收回，按 concession 不評稅）。 s.15BA ：trading stock 轉為資本資產時按公允市值視為出售課稅；反向則以市值作為存貨成本。 E. 扣除規則（ss.16–17） s.16(1) 一般規則 ：all outgoings and expenses, to the extent incurred in the production of chargeable profits（「to the extent」容許分攤， 不同於 薪俸稅的 “wholly and exclusively”；IRR Rule 2A）。 “Incurred” = 已付、到期應付、或已絕對承擔法律責任（ CIR v Lo & Lo (1984)）；contingent liabilities 不算。 s.16(1)(a)–(h) 明訂可扣 ：(a) 借款利息（另須符合 s.16(2) 條件及 ss.16(2A)–(2C) 限制）；(b) 付予租客配偶／合夥人的租金，以應評稅值（assessable value）為限；(c) 就收入已繳的外國稅（但 s.16(2J)：在 DTA 地區且可按 s.50 抵免者不適用）；(d) 壞帳——須證明真正無法收回，且債項曾作應課稅營業收入入帳，或屬在港放債業務的放款； specific provision 可扣、general provision 不可扣 ；其後收回須在收回年度課稅；(e) 修繕開支（repairs， 不包括 improvements ）；(f) 用具更換（replacement of implements/utensils）；(g) 商標／版權／專利註冊費。 ss.16A–16L 明訂扣除（不受 s.17 影響） ： s.16A ：認可退休計劃的 非經常性 供款／保費，分 5 年每年 20% 扣除（普通年度供款不在此列）。 s.16B R&D ：Type B 開支（付予指定本地研究機構的外判研發、直接參與研發的僱員（非董事）開支、直接耗用的消耗品）——首 HK$2M 扣 300% 、其餘 200% ；Type A（其他研發，如機器設備）扣 100%；只有在港進行的研發才有 super deduction。 s.16C ：技術教育付款（認可院校）。 s.16E ：購買專利權／know how—— 產生開支的基期一次過扣除 ；售出的話，以原扣除額為限課稅（tax symmetry）；向相聯人士購入 不可扣 。 s.16EA ：購買指明知識產權（registered trade mark、registered design、copyright、performer's economic right、layout design、plant variety right）——分 5 年每年 20% （保護期不足 5 年則按剩餘年期攤分）；未註冊商標不可扣；向相聯人士購入不可扣；出售時售價高於未扣除餘額的差額課稅（以已扣除額為限），低於則差額可扣。 s.16F ：非住宅建築物（non domestic，酒店／賓館除外）翻新／裝修資本開支——分 5 年 扣除； 不適用 於首次令樓宇產生應課稅利潤的裝修，或改變用途的翻新（該類歸 CBA/IBA）。 s.16G Prescribed Fixed Assets ：直接用於製造的機器、電腦軟硬件等—— 購入年度 100% 扣除 ；租出資產（leased asset）及分期付款（hire purchase）資產 不可 用 s.16G（改用折舊免稅額）。 ss.16H–16L ：環保機械（EPM）／環保車輛（EFV）100% 即扣；環保裝置（EPI）2018 年 4 月 1 日起 100% 即扣（之前 5 年攤分，可選擇就 residue 一次扣，s.16L）；租出資產限制同 PFA。 s.16D ：認可慈善捐款，HK$100 至應評稅利潤（扣減折舊免稅額及平衡調整後）的 35% ，受贈者須為 s.88 豁免慈善機構。 s.17 不可扣 ：(a) 私人／家庭開支；(c) 資本性開支、改善成本、資本損失（最重要）；(e) 可由保險／彌償合約收回的款項；(f) 非用於產生利潤的處所租金；(g) IRO 下的稅款（僱員薪俸稅除外）；(h) 超過僱員總薪酬 15% 的退休計劃經常性供款；(2) 付予合夥人或其配偶的薪金、資本／貸款利息（屬利潤分配，須加回再分配）。 利息扣除四重測試（s.16(1)(a) + s.16(2) + ss.16(2A)/(2B)/(2C)） ： 1. Production of profits test ：為產生應課稅利潤而借入（D68/87 公式：Interest disallowed = Average non assessable profits producing assets / Average total assets × Gross interest expense）。 2. Tax symmetry test ：放款人非金融機構／海外金融機構時，該利息須在放款人手中於香港課稅（s.16(2)）。 3. Secured loan test（s.16(2A)） ：以借款人／相聯人士的存款或貸款作抵押，且該存款利息在港不課稅 → 扣減相應利息扣除額。 4. Interest flow back test（ss.16(2B)/(2C)） ：利息經安排最終回流借款人或其關連人士且不在港課稅 → 不獲扣除（market maker 例外，s.16(2G)）。 F. Capital vs Revenue（區分準則） 口訣：「capital is the plant, revenue is the fruit」。Fixed capital（持久資產）vs circulating capital（周轉存貨）。 Atherton (1926)：once and for all 開支，為業務帶來持久利益（enduring benefit）→ capital。 賠償：補償損失的營業利潤 → revenue 應課稅（ Lincolnshire Sugar v Smart ）；補償業務完全終止／資本資產「絕育」→ capital（ Glenboig ）；暫時失去資產使用權 → revenue（ London & Thames Haven ）；取消影響業務結構的合約 → capital（ Van den Berghs v Clark ）；取消普通營業合約 → revenue（ Kelsall Parsons ）；限制營業的代價 → 非 revenue（ Higgs v Olivier ）。 Debt forgiveness 一般不課稅（ British Mexican Petroleum ），但 s.15(2)：已獲扣除的債務獲豁免須課稅。 G. 折舊免稅額（Depreciation Allowances, Part VI / s.18F） Machinery & Plant（pooling system, DIPN 7） ： Initial Allowance (IA) = 60% of cost（s.39B(1)）；不包括 s.16B R&D、s.16G PFA、ss.16H–K 環保設施（該等另有 100% 扣除）。 Annual Allowance (AA) = 10% / 20% / 30% （按資產類別分 pool）on reducing value（s.39B(2)）。 Balancing charge / allowance（s.39D） ：出售所得（以原成本為上限）超過 pool 的 reducing value → balancing charge（應課稅）；停業時 pool 餘額 → balancing allowance。 私用轉商用（s.37(2A)/s.39B(6)）：無 IA，AA 按名義折舊後價值入 pool。 Hire purchase（s.37A） ：IA = 60% × 基期內已付資本部分；AA 按 10/20/30% 於 reducing value（cash price − IA − AA）；繳清後 reducing value 轉入相應 pool（s.39C）。 Industrial Building Allowance (IBA) ：qualifying trade（製造、加工、運輸、貯存指定貨物等；零售店、陳列室、酒店、辦公室 不合資格 ，design office 除外）；非合資格部分 ≤10% 全幢仍可獲 IBA，超過則分攤。 IA = 20% （s.34(1)，未使用也可先享，其後不合資格可撤回）； AA = 4% of qualifying expenditure（s.34(2)，基期末須作工業用途）。 Qualifying expenditure = 建築成本（不包括土地、逐戶清遷、拆卸、平整土地；包括建築期內融資利息至入伙紙 date）。 出售 → balancing adjustment（s.35）；balancing charge 以已批出免稅額總額為上限。 買入 已用 工業樓宇：買方 AA = residue after sale × 1/(由出售年度至首次使用後第 25 年的年數)。買入 未用 樓宇（s.35B）：賣方為發展商 → deemed QE = 樓價；非發展商 → min(建築成本, 樓價)。 Commercial Building Allowance (CBA, s.33A) ： 只有 AA = 4% （無 IA）；qualifying expenditure 計法同 IBA；s.35B 不適用；出售有 balancing adjustment（s.35）。1998/99 前啟用者以 1998/99 為首次使用年。 口訣： P&M = IA 60% + AA 10/20/30%；IBA = IA 20% + AA 4%；CBA = AA 4% only 。 H. 利得稅計算五部曲（Profits Tax Computation） 1. 由會計稅前利潤出發， 扣減 非應評稅收入（離岸利潤、資本收益、已課稅股息、獲豁免銀行利息）。 2. 加回 不可扣開支（私人開支、資本開支、罰款、會計折舊等）。 3. 加 balancing charges。 4. 扣 折舊免稅額及 ss.16A–16L 特定資本開支扣除；慈善捐款先加回，再於此步後扣除（HK$100–35% 上限）。 5. 扣 結轉虧損（unrelieved losses b/f）→ Net assessable profits × 稅率。 會計原則不能凌駕 IRO（ CIR v Secan (2000)； Nice Cheer Investment v CIR (2013)：未實現利潤不入稅）。 I. 基期（Basis Period, ss.18–18E） 持續經營：會計年度終結日落在該課稅年度內的 12 個月（s.18B）。 開業（s.18C）：首份帳目 ≤12 個月且於開業年度內結束 → 開業日至首個結帳日；≤12 個月但於下一課稅年度結束 → 開業年度 Nil； 12 個月 → 第二年度取結帳日前 12 個月，開業年度取餘下期間。 停業（s.18D）：新業務（1974/4/1 後開業）= 上一基期完結翌日至停業日。 更改結帳日（s.18E）：新業務基期可超過 12 個月；原則為不令利潤「跌出」評稅範圍，有充份理由可接受短於 12 個月。 J. 合夥與虧損（Partnerships & Losses） 合夥（s.22(1)）：利潤以一筆總額計算，稅以合夥名義徵收（BIR52 由 precedent partner 提交）；合夥不是獨立法人，但屬 IRO 下的應課稅「person」。 需要分配利潤／虧損的情況：有合夥人選擇個人入息課稅（PA）、有法團合夥人、有合夥人承前虧損。分配原則：合夥有應評稅利潤時，任何合夥人不應有虧損（反之亦然），否則須重新分配（reallocation）。退夥個人合夥人的虧損份額即告失效（lapse），除非轉入 PA。 虧損（DIPN 8） ：必須是在港經營的貿易／業務虧損（離岸或資本虧損不可用）；個人獨資：只可用於 同一業務 的未來利潤（除非 PA），停業即失效；合夥：按份額分配予各合夥人處理； 法團：無限期結轉，可抵銷任何業務的應評稅利潤 。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：Capital Receipt vs Revenue Receipt（資本收益 vs 營業收益） 對比 ：同樣是「一筆過收到的錢」，補償失去的營業利潤（compensation for lost trading profits）是 revenue、要課稅；補償資本資產被毀或業務結構性合約被取消（sterilisation of a capital asset / cancellation of a structural contract）是 capital、s.14(1) 豁免。關鍵不是「金額大」或「一次性」，而是 賠償取代了甚麼 。 例子 ：GSHM 的洗衣機在維修期間不能使用，保險公司賠償 HK$200,000「不能使用期間的損失」→ 屬 revenue receipt，應課稅（ London & Thames Haven ），因為它取代的是該段期間本可賺取的營業利潤。相反，若供應商取消一份構成 GSHM 整個業務結構的長期總代理協議而賠償 HK$5M → 屬 capital receipt，不課稅（ Van den Berghs v Clark ）。 考官報告指出 ：考生常單憑「一次性付款 = capital」作答，忽略交易在納稅人業務中的功能，以致把應課稅的營業補償誤列為豁免項目——務必引用 badges of trade 及相關案例逐步推論。 Pitfall 2：Deductible under s.16 vs Express Capital Deductions ss.16A–16L vs Depreciation Allowance（三條扣稅路徑的邊界） 對比 ：s.16(1) 只涵蓋 非資本性 、為產生應課稅利潤而招致的開支；資本開支被 s.17(1)(c) 封殺後，要先看 ss.16A–16L 有沒有明訂扣除（如 s.16G PFA 100%、s.16EA 指明 IPR 分 5 年、s.16F 非住宅翻新分 5 年），都沒有才輪到 Part VI 折舊免稅額（P&M pooling、IBA、CBA）。同一開支 不可雙重扣除 （s.16G 明確排除已在其他條文扣除的開支）。 例子 ：GSHM 購入 (i) 收銀電腦系統 HK$300,000（自用的電腦硬件）→ s.16G 購入年度 100% 扣除；若 GSHM 把它 租給 另一公司使用 → s.16G 失效，只能入 30% pool 計 IA 60% + AA；(ii) 為全新旗艦店首次裝修 HK$2M → 因屬「首次令樓宇產生應課稅利潤」的裝修，s.16F 不適用 ，只可享 CBA 每年 4%；若是 現有 辦公室翻新 HK$1M → s.16F 分 5 年每年 HK$200,000。 考官報告指出 ：考生在計算題常把首次裝修誤用 s.16F 五年攤扣、或對 hire purchase 資產誤用 s.16G 全額即扣，導致整條計算鏈出錯——落筆前先問三條問題：「是否資本性？→ 有無 ss.16A–16L 明訂扣除？→ 有無租出／hire purchase 限制？」 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What are the three limbs of the charging provision under s.14(1) of the IRO, and what is expressly excluded from the charge? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Limb 1: a person carries on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong; Limb 2: there are profits arising in or derived from Hong Kong (Hong Kong source profits); Limb 3: those profits are the profits of that specific trade, profession or business carried on in Hong Kong. Express exclusion: profits arising from the sale of capital assets are not chargeable (s.14(1)). All three limbs must be satisfied; carrying on a business in Hong Kong alone is not sufficient (CIR v The Hong Kong & Whampoa Dock Co Ltd (1960)). [中文白話解釋]: 利得稅要同時滿足三個條件才成立：在港經營業務、利潤源自香港、而且該利潤來自該納稅人在港經營的那盤業務；賣資本資產的收益明確豁免。只在香港做生意不等於所有利潤都要課稅，來源地才是關鍵。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): State the broad guiding principle for determining the source of profits (CIR v Hang Seng Bank (1991)) and the IRD's initial presumption for trading profits where only one of the purchase/sale contracts is effected in Hong Kong (DIPN 21). Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Broad guiding principle (operations test): look to see what the taxpayer has done to earn the profits in question and where he has done it; focus on the proximate, profit producing operations and disregard antecedent or incidental matters (ING Baring Securities (HK) Ltd v CIR (2008)). Trading profits: locality is generally where the contracts of purchase and sale are effected; “effected” includes solicitation of orders, negotiation, conclusion, trade financing, shipment and performance (CIR v Magna Industrial (1997)). If either the purchase or the sale contract is effected in Hong Kong, the initial presumption is that the profits are fully taxable in Hong Kong; in practice greater weight is given to the contract of sale. [中文白話解釋]: 來源地的核心問題是「納稅人做了甚麼去賺這筆利潤、在哪裡做」，不要被前期的準備功夫或附帶事項分散注意。貿易利潤主要看買賣合約在哪裡洽訂；只要其中一份合約在港洽訂，稅局初步就當全部利潤要在港課稅。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): A non resident licensor charges a Hong Kong company a royalty of HK$5,000,000 for the use of a trade mark in Hong Kong. Under which IRO provision is the royalty deemed chargeable, what is the deemed assessable profit under s.21A, and who bears the withholding obligation? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Deemed chargeable under s.15(1)(b) — royalty for the use of, or the right to use, a trade mark in Hong Kong. Deemed assessable profit under s.21A: normally 30% of the gross royalty = HK$1,500,000; BUT if the licensor and payer are associated persons AND the IP was at any time wholly or partly owned by a person carrying on business in Hong Kong, it becomes 100% of the gross royalty. Effective tax at 16.5%: HK$247,500 (30% basis); withholding obligation rests on the Hong Kong payer under s.20B — the only withholding tax in Hong Kong. [中文白話解釋]: 就算收取版稅的離岸公司不在香港做生意，只要商標是在香港使用，s.15(1)(b) 也會把版稅視為應課稅。一般按總額 30% 計應評稅利潤；但如果雙方是相聯人士、而且知識產權曾經由在港營商的人擁有，就要按 100% 計。稅款由香港的付款方預扣代繳（s.20B）。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Distinguish a deductible bad debt under s.16(1)(d) from a non deductible provision, and state the two categories of debts that qualify. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Qualifying debts: (1) trade debts previously included as taxable trading receipts; or (2) money lent in the ordinary course of a money lending business carried on in Hong Kong. The debt must be proved to have become really bad (commercially irrecoverable) during the year — recovery actions taken but in vain. A specific provision for doubtful debts (ascertained with detailed rules and supporting documents) is “incurred” and deductible (CIR v Lo & Lo); a general provision based on rough estimation is NOT “incurred” and is not deductible. Subsequent recovery of a previously allowed bad debt is taxable in the year of recovery. [中文白話解釋]: 壞帳要扣稅，第一，那筆債本身要曾經當作應課稅營業收入入帳（或屬正牌放債業務的放款）；第二，要證明真的收不回來。具體撥備（specific provision）有文件支持可以扣；粗略估計的一般撥備（general provision）當未「招致」，不能扣。之後收返的壞帳要在收回年度課稅。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): A company borrows HK$10,000,000 from a Hong Kong bank at 5% p.a. to finance its (fully taxable) trading operations. The loan is secured by the company's overseas fixed deposit of HK$5,000,000 earning tax free interest of 4% p.a. Compute the deductible interest expense under the secured loan test (s.16(2A)). Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Loan interest paid: HK$10,000,000 × 5% = HK$500,000. Tax free deposit interest earned: HK$5,000,000 × 4% = HK$200,000. Secured loan test applies: the loan is secured by a deposit made by the borrower, and the deposit interest is not chargeable to profits tax in Hong Kong → deduction reduced by the tax free interest. Deductible interest = HK$500,000 − HK$200,000 = HK$300,000 . [中文白話解釋]: 借錢做生意的利息原本可以扣，但如果這筆貸款是用借款人自己（或相聯人士）的存款做抵押，而那筆存款的利息在香港不用課稅，s.16(2A) 就會把可扣利息減去那筆免稅存款利息——防止納稅人一邊扣利息開支、一邊收免稅利息。本題可扣 HK$300,000。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): In the year of assessment, a company purchases a delivery van for HK$200,000 (30% pool) and office furniture for HK$40,000 (20% pool). Compute the total depreciation allowances for the year. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: 30% pool: cost HK$200,000; Initial allowance 60% = HK$120,000; reducing value HK$80,000; Annual allowance 30% = HK$24,000; reducing value c/f HK$56,000. 20% pool: cost HK$40,000; Initial allowance 60% = HK$24,000; reducing value HK$16,000; Annual allowance 20% = HK$3,200; reducing value c/f HK$12,800. Total depreciation allowances = 120,000 + 24,000 + 24,000 + 3,200 = HK$171,200 (s.39B). [中文白話解釋]: 機器設備按相同的年度免稅額率放入同一個 pool。新購資產先有 60% 初期免稅額（IA），餘下的 reducing value 再按 pool 的比率（10%/20%/30%）計算年度免稅額（AA）。本題總免稅額為 HK$171,200。記住：IA 是成本 ×60%，AA 是 reducing value × 比率。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): State the rates of Industrial Building Allowance (IBA) and Commercial Building Allowance (CBA), and two key differences between them. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: IBA: Initial allowance 20% of qualifying construction expenditure (s.34(1)) + annual allowance 4% (s.34(2)); balancing adjustment on disposal (s.35). CBA: annual allowance 4% only — NO initial allowance (s.33A); balancing adjustment on disposal (s.35). Differences: (1) IBA has a 20% IA, CBA does not; (2) IBA requires a qualifying trade (manufacturing, processing, qualifying storage etc. — offices, retail shops, showrooms, hotels excluded, subject to the 10% rule), whereas CBA covers any building used for a trade/business that is not industrial; (3) s.35B (unused building purchase rules) applies to IBA but not CBA. [中文白話解釋]: IBA 有 20% 初期免稅額加每年 4%；CBA 只有每年 4%，沒有初期免稅額。IBA 只限合資格行業（製造、加工等），寫字樓、零售店、陳列室、酒店一般不合資格；CBA 則涵蓋其他商業用途樓宇。考試最常見陷阱是把寫字樓當工業樓宇計 IBA。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): A Hong Kong corporation has assessable profits of HK$1,950,000 for the year of assessment. Compute its profits tax payable under the two tiered profits tax regime, and state how the treatment would differ for (a) profits of HK$3,000,000 and (b) an unrelieved loss carried forward of HK$500,000. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: HK$1,950,000 ≤ HK$2,000,000 → all at 8.25%: tax payable = HK$1,950,000 × 8.25% = HK$160,875 . (a) HK$3,000,000: first HK$2,000,000 × 8.25% = HK$165,000; remaining HK$1,000,000 × 16.5% = HK$165,000; total = HK$330,000 . (b) Set off loss b/f first: net assessable profits = HK$1,950,000 − HK$500,000 = HK$1,450,000; tax = HK$1,450,000 × 8.25% = HK$119,625 . Corporate losses may be carried forward indefinitely and set off against assessable profits of any trade or business of the corporation. Reminder: only ONE entity within a group of connected entities may enjoy the two tiered rates. [中文白話解釋]: 法團首 HK$2M 應評稅利潤按 8.25%，超出部分按 16.5%。計稅前記得先扣結轉虧損——法團虧損可以無限期結轉，抵銷該法團任何業務的利潤。另外同一集團的關連實體之中，只有一間可以用兩級制稅率，這是常見陷阱。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案：M9_Ch3_Profits_Tax_Quiz.md / M9_Ch3_Profits_Tax_Answers.md

text: M9 Chapter 4 Salaries Tax — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: A — (I) and (III) only Model Answer (English): (I) Chargeable. Income from an office (director's fee) is Hong Kong sourced if the company paying the fee is centrally managed and controlled in Hong Kong. The source of an office does not depend on where the director performs his duties, and the employment related exemptions (ss.8(1A)(b), 8(1B)) do NOT apply to income from an office. Mr. A's absence from Hong Kong is irrelevant. (II) Not chargeable. Ms. B has a non Hong Kong employment. Her income is chargeable only in respect of services rendered in Hong Kong (s.8(1A)(a)), but services rendered during visits not exceeding a total of 60 days in the YA are disregarded (s.8(1B)). At exactly 58 days, the 60 day exemption applies. (III) Chargeable. A pension paid from a fund managed and controlled in Hong Kong is Hong Kong sourced. While a non government pension attributable to services rendered outside Hong Kong is exempt under s.8(2)(ca), government pensions are fully assessable irrespective of where the services were rendered . (IV) Not chargeable. Ms. D has a Hong Kong employment, but she rendered ALL her services outside Hong Kong and her visits did not exceed 60 days — exempt under ss.8(1A)(b)(ii) and 8(1B). 【解題思路】呢題考三種收入來源規則嘅邊界：(I) 董事酬金係 office 收入，只睇支付公司嘅 central management and control 所在地，僱傭收入嘅 60 日豁免 唔適用 於 office——選項 D 就係靠呢點引人犯錯。(III) 政府退休金無論服務地點都要課稅，s.8(2)(ca) 豁免只限非政府退休金——好多考生會誤以為「喺東京做嘢所以豁免」而漏咗 (III)。(II) 58 日 ≤ 60 日，豁免成立；(IV) 香港僱傭但全部服務境外 + 到訪 ≤ 60 日，s.8(1A)(b)(ii) 豁免。記住口訣：Employment 睇 Goepfert 三因素、Office 睇公司管理控制地、Pension 睇基金管理控制地（政府退休金除外）。 Question 2 — Answer: C Model Answer (English): Under s.8(2)(j), income of a crew member of a ship or aircraft is exempt only if BOTH limbs are satisfied: (i) present in Hong Kong for not more than 60 days in the YA concerned; AND (ii) present for not more than 120 days in total over two consecutive YAs, one of which is the YA concerned. Limb (i): 50 days ≤ 60 days — satisfied (transit days count as days of presence in Hong Kong: IRBRD D11/13 — "present" means "being here", even within the airport transit area). Limb (ii): 75 + 50 = 125 days 120 days — FAILED. Therefore the s.8(2)(j) exemption does not apply. His income is chargeable (fully if a Hong Kong employment; on a time apportionment basis if a non Hong Kong employment). 【解題思路】考官最鍾意考機組人員豁免嘅 雙重門檻 ：好多人記得 60 日就忘記咗「兩年合計 ≤ 120 日」呢第二關。選項 A 係典型半桶水答案——只過咗第一關。選項 B 測試 transit day：根據 IRBRD D11/13，即使無入境、只喺機場禁區轉機，都計作「在港出席」，所以唔可以扣返 12 日。選項 D 明顯錯，s.8(2)(j) 本身就係專為船員機組而設嘅豁免。答題時兩個條件要逐一驗證，缺一不可。 Question 3 — Answer: B Model Answer (English): B is NOT chargeable. Under the liability test in s.9(1)(a)(iv), a payment by an employer to a third party is not income of the employee if it discharges the employer's own sole and primary liability (and no person was surety for it). Since the utility accounts are in the employer's name, the employer is the only party liable, and the benefit cannot be converted into money — not assessable (consistent with DIPN 16 (Revised)). A is chargeable. Payments in connection with the education of a child of an employee are carved out of the liability test and are ALWAYS assessable — s.9(2A)(b); David Hardy Glynn v CIR (school fees paid by the employer directly to the school were taxable perquisites). C is chargeable. The employee joined the club and was personally liable for the subscription; the employer's reimbursement discharges the EMPLOYEE's personal liability — an assessable perquisite under s.9(1)(a). D is chargeable. A holiday passage allowance is a cash allowance fully assessable under s.9(1)(a); the amount actually spent is irrelevant. (Even an employer paid holiday journey would be chargeable under s.9(2A)(c).) 【解題思路】核心分辨：「僱主找自己嘅數」定「僱主幫僱員找數」。B 嘅關鍵係水電戶口登記喺僱主名下，法律上欠費嘅係僱主，僱員冇 personal liability 被解除，福利亦換唔到錢 → 不課稅。A 係 Glynn case 嘅經典案情，子女教育費係 s.9(2A)(b) 三大例外之一，即使僱主合約上要付都照課。C 係解除僱員個人債務，同私人信用卡簽賬一樣要課稅。D 係現金津貼 100% 課稅，用咗幾多無關——千祈唔好當佢係 holiday journey 福利去諗。 Question 4 — Answer: Net chargeable income = HK$424,000; Salaries tax payable = HK$54,080 Model Answer (English): HK$ Salary 600,000 Bonus 40,000 Subtotal for rental value base 640,000 Add: Rental value — s.9(2): 10% × HK$640,000 64,000 Assessable Income 704,000 Less: s.12 deductions — Net Assessable Income 704,000 Less: Concessionary deductions — Mandatory MPF contributions (s.26G, cap HK$18,000) (18,000) — Approved charitable donations (s.26C; 35% cap = 35% × 704,000 = 246,400 10,000, so fully deductible) (10,000) Net Income (NI) 676,000 Less: Personal allowances — Basic allowance (132,000) — Child allowance (120,000) Net Chargeable Income (NCI) 424,000 Tax at progressive rates on NCI: First HK$200,000: 1,000 + 3,000 + 5,000 + 7,000 = HK$16,000 Balance: (424,000 − 200,000) × 17% = 224,000 × 17% = HK$38,080 Total: HK$54,080 Tax at standard rate: 15% × NI 676,000 = HK$101,400. Salaries tax payable = lower of the two = HK$54,080. 【解題思路】逐步拆解： 1. Rental value ：僱主提供免費住所（非酒店），按 s.9(2) 以來自該僱主收入嘅 10% 計：10% × (600,000 + 40,000) = 64,000。冇 s.12(1)(a)/(b) 扣除，所以基數係 640,000。常見錯誤：漏咗花紅唔計入基數，或者誤用實際市值租金。 2. 捐款上限 ：35% × assessable income（只扣 s.12(1)(a)/(b) 後）= 246,400，捐款 10,000 全數可扣。注意個 cap 唔係用 NAI 或 NI 計。 3. NI 與 NCI 分別 ：NI = NAI − 特惠扣除 = 676,000；NCI = NI − 個人免稅額 = 424,000。單身有一名 8 歲子女同住 → basic 132,000 + child 120,000。 4. 兩個稅率比較 ：累進 = 16,000 + 224,000 × 17% = 54,080；標準 = 676,000 × 15% = 101,400。取低者 54,080。常見錯誤係用 15% 乘 NCI（應該乘 NI），或者累進稅率漏咗首 20 萬嘅固定 16,000。題目已註明忽略 s.100 稅務寬減。 Question 5 — Answer: HK$660,000 Model Answer (English): Step 1 — Leave days attributable to Hong Kong: Attributable leave days = (Business days in HK ÷ Total business days) × Leave days = (120 ÷ 330) × 33 = 12 days Step 2 — Total days in Hong Kong: 120 + 12 = 132 days Step 3 — Income attributable to services rendered in Hong Kong: = (Days in HK ÷ Total days in YA) × Annual income = (132 ÷ 365) × HK$1,825,000 = HK$660,000 【解題思路】時間分攤三部曲： 1. 歸屬香港嘅假期日 ：leave pay 歸屬在港服務部分都要課稅 (s.8(1A)(a))，公式係「在港工作日 ÷ 總工作日 × 假期日」= 120/330 × 33 = 12 日。常見錯誤：(a) 完全漏咗計假期日；(b) 分母用 365 而唔係總工作日 330（總工作日 + 假期 = 330 + 33 = 363... 呢題 330 已係題目所給總工作日，直接代入）。 2. 總在港日數 ：120 + 12 = 132 日。題目已註明 120 日係按 midnight rule 計好（到離兩日合計一日），唔好再自行加返到訪日數。 3. 分攤 ：132/365 × 1,825,000 = 660,000。1,825,000/365 = 5,000 一日，132 × 5,000 = 660,000。 提提你：因為 Ms. G 係非香港僱傭，境外服務收入已經自動排除，s.8(1A)(c) 嘅 foreign tax exclusion 喺時間分攤下係 冇作用 嘅——唔好再扣任何外地稅。60 日規則已 fail（題目註明），所以唔存在「首 60 日免稅」呢回事。

text: M9 Chapter 4 Salaries Tax — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 「限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位）」 Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following income items is/are chargeable to Hong Kong salaries tax for the year of assessment 2019/20? (I) A director's fee of HK$200,000 paid to Mr. A by a company which is centrally managed and controlled in Hong Kong. Mr. A resides in London and did not set foot in Hong Kong during the year. (II) A salary of HK$900,000 earned by Ms. B, who has a non Hong Kong employment and rendered services in Hong Kong during visits totalling exactly 58 days in the year of assessment. (III) A pension received by Mr. C, a retired Hong Kong civil servant, from the Hong Kong Government pension fund. His pension is wholly attributable to his past services rendered at the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Tokyo. (IV) A salary of HK$1,200,000 earned by Ms. D, who has a Hong Kong employment, rendered all her services outside Hong Kong during the year and visited Hong Kong for no more than 60 days in the year of assessment. A. (I) and (III) only B. (I), (III) and (IV) only C. (II) and (IV) only D. (I), (II), (III) and (IV) Question 2 (MCQ) Mr. E is a member of the crew of an aircraft. In the year of assessment 2019/20, he was present in Hong Kong for a total of 50 days, of which 12 days were days he spent inside the Hong Kong airport transit area between flights (he did not pass through immigration control on those days). In the immediately preceding year of assessment 2018/19, he was present in Hong Kong for a total of 75 days. Which of the following statements is correct? A. His income is exempt under s.8(2)(j) because he was present in Hong Kong for not more than 60 days in the year of assessment 2019/20. B. His income is exempt under s.8(2)(j) because the 12 transit days are excluded, leaving only 38 days of presence in the year of assessment 2019/20. C. His income is NOT exempt under s.8(2)(j) because his total presence in Hong Kong over the two consecutive years of assessment 2018/19 and 2019/20 (125 days) exceeds 120 days. D. His income is NOT exempt because aircraft crew members are never eligible for any salaries tax exemption. Question 3 (MCQ) Which of the following benefits provided by an employer is NOT chargeable to salaries tax in the hands of the employee? A. School fees for the employee's son paid by the employer directly to the school, where the employer was contractually liable to pay them under the employment contract. B. Electricity and water charges for the employee's residence paid by the employer, where the utility accounts are registered in the employer's own name and the benefit cannot be converted into money. C. Reimbursement by the employer of the annual subscription fee of a private recreational club which the employee joined and was personally liable to pay. D. A cash holiday passage allowance of HK$20,000 paid by the employer, of which the employee spent only HK$5,000 on an overseas trip. Question 4 (Calculation) Mr. F is single and has one son (aged 8) living with him. For the year of assessment 2019/20 (basis period 1 April 2019 to 31 March 2020): Salary: HK$600,000; Bonus: HK$40,000 His employer provided him with a rent free flat (NOT a hotel, hostel or boarding house) for the whole year He made mandatory MPF contributions of HK$18,000 He made cash donations of HK$10,000 to a charitable institution exempt from tax under s.88 of the IRO He has no deductible outgoings or expenses under s.12(1)(a) or (b), and no other income or allowances Applicable figures for YA 2019/20: basic allowance HK$132,000; child allowance HK$120,000; progressive rates — first HK$50,000 at 2%, next HK$50,000 at 6%, next HK$50,000 at 10%, next HK$50,000 at 14%, remainder at 17%; standard rate 15%. Compute Mr. F's net chargeable income and his salaries tax payable for YA 2019/20. (Ignore any tax reduction under s.100.) Question 5 (Calculation) Ms. G has a non Hong Kong employment. Her visits to Hong Kong during the year of assessment 2019/20 (365 days) exceeded 60 days for the purposes of s.8(1B), so the 60 day exemption does not apply and she is assessed on the time apportionment basis. The following data apply to the year of assessment: Annual remuneration: HK$1,825,000 Business days in Hong Kong (counted under the midnight rule): 120 days Total business days in the year of assessment: 330 days Leave days taken during the year (all taken outside Hong Kong): 33 days Compute Ms. G's income attributable to services rendered in Hong Kong chargeable to salaries tax for YA 2019/20. Show your answer in HK$ (round to the nearest dollar).
