text: M9 Chapter 4 Salaries Tax — Study Pack (Weeks 5–6) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 課稅範圍 (Scope of Charge — s.8(1)) ：薪俸稅只對「於香港產生或得自香港」(arising in or derived from Hong Kong) 的 職位 (Office) 、 受僱工作 (Employment) 及 退休金 (Pension) 收入徵稅，屬地域來源原則 (territorial basis)；非香港來源收入不徵稅。 來源地判定 (Source Rules) ：受僱收入來源看「僱傭所在地」(location of employment)，按 Goepfert case (CIR v George Andrew Goepfert, 2 HKTC 210) 三因素判斷；董事酬金 (director's fees) 看支付公司「中央管理及控制」(central management and control) 所在地；退休金看「退休金基金管理及控制地」(where the fund is managed and controlled)。 豁免與分攤 (Exemptions & Time Apportionment) ：香港僱傭原則上全數課稅，除非全部服務在境外提供 (s.8(1A)(b)(ii))、60 日豁免 (60 day rule, s.8(1B))、或非協定地區已繳類似稅項 (s.8(1A)(c))；非香港僱傭只就在港服務部分按「時間分攤基準」(time in time out basis, s.8(1A)(a)) 課稅。 應課稅收入與福利 (Chargeable Income & Benefits — s.9) ：包括工資、花紅、津貼、perquisite、房屋福利 (rental value)、股份認購權收益 (share option gains, s.9(1)(d))、子女教育費及度假旅程福利 (s.9(2A))；判斷關鍵是「liability test」(s.9(1)(a)(iv)) 及「convertible into money」原則。 扣除、免稅額與計算 (Deductions, Allowances & Computation) ：s.12 扣除（開支、折舊免稅額、虧損、進修開支）→ Net Assessable Income → 扣除 Part 4A 特惠扣除 (concessionary deductions) → Net Income → 扣除 Part 5 個人免稅額 (personal allowances) → Net Chargeable Income；稅款取「累進稅率 × NCI」與「標準稅率 15% × NI」兩者較低者 (s.13)。 2. 必背考點清單 A. 課稅範圍與來源 (Scope & Source) s.8(1) ：對每人在課稅年度 (YA) 內於香港產生或得自香港的 employment、office、pension 收入徵收薪俸稅。 Employment 來源 — Goepfert 三因素 ：(i) 僱傭合約洽談及訂立地點 (place where the contract was negotiated and concluded)；(ii) 僱主居所 (residence of the employer — 公司看 central management and control 實際所在地)；(iii) 薪酬支付地點 (place where the employee was paid，權重最低)。 提供服務地點無關 (place of services is irrelevant) 。IRD 按 DIPN 10 (Revised) 採「totality of facts / substance over form」。 Office 來源 ：董事酬金來源 = 支付公司 centrally managed and controlled 之地 (IRBRD D21/13)；董事局會議地點並非決定性。 Pension 來源 ：基金在香港管理及控制 → 香港來源；非政府退休金中歸屬於境外服務部分豁免 (s.8(2)(ca))； 政府退休金不論服務地點全數課稅 。 香港僱傭 ：全數課稅 (s.8(1)(a))，無分攤，三條出路：全部服務在境外 (s.8(1A)(b)(ii))；60 日規則 (s.8(1B))；境外服務收入已在 非 DTA 地區 繳納性質基本相同稅項 (s.8(1A)(c) — 須「chargeable」且「已實際繳付」，稅額多少無關；DTA 地區只可用 s.50 foreign tax credit, s.8(1C))。 非香港僱傭 ：只就在港服務收入課稅 (s.8(1A)(a))，按時間分攤；s.8(1A)(c) 在此不適用（境外收入已自動排除）。 60 日豁免 (s.8(1B)) ：在港提供服務的「到訪」(visits) 合計 不超過 60 日 → 豁免； 超過 60 日則全不豁免 （不是分攤！）。計日： 不足一日亦作一日計 （抵港及離港日均計入，IRBRD D20/00、D40/07）；「visits」指日到訪而非工作日 (CIR v So Chak Kwong)；培訓、開會、匯報工作進度均屬在港提供服務。60 日豁免 不適用 於政府僱員、船員及機組人員。 機組/船員豁免 (s.8(2)(j)) ：在港出席 ≤ 60 日（該 YA） 且 ≤ 120 日（兩個連續 YA，其中一個為該 YA）； transit days 過境日計算在內 (IRBRD D11/13)。 B. 時間分攤 (Time Apportionment — s.8(1A)(a)) Income attributable to HK services = Annual income × Days in HK in the YA ÷ Total days in the YA (365/366) 。 Days in HK = business days in HK + attributable leave days = (Business days in HK ÷ Total business days) × Leave days。 計日採 「midnight rule」 ：抵港日與離港日 合共只計一日 （與 60 日規則「部分日計一日」不同——常考陷阱！）。 若收入可清楚識別 (clearly identifiable, e.g. 合約訂明)，不用分攤 (IRBRD D106/89)；time in time out 只是「rebuttable presumption」(CIR v Lo Wa Ming Patrick [2022] HKCA 710)。 C. 應課稅收入與福利 (s.9) s.9(1)(a) ：wages, salary, leave pay, fee, commission, bonus, gratuity, perquisite, allowance — 不論來自僱主或他人。 Liability test — s.9(1)(a)(iv) ：僱主代支付給第三者的款項，如屬 僱主本身的 sole and primary liability （且非他人作擔保的債務）→ 不屬收入；反之，僱主代繳 僱員個人債務 （如私人信用卡簽賬、個人會所會費）→ 應課稅 perquisite (David Hardy Glynn v CIR)。 三大例外 — s.9(2A) （即使僱主負責付款亦必課稅）：(a) 可轉換為金錢的福利 (convertible into money)；(b) 僱員子女教育 (education of a child of an employee)；(c) 度假旅程 (holiday journey)。 房屋福利 ： 現金房屋/租金/按揭津貼 (housing allowance) → 100% 全數課稅 (s.9(1)(a))； Rent free residence → 按 rental value 課稅 (s.9(1)(b), s.9(2))； 部分補貼住所 → rental value − 僱員已付租金 (s.9(1)(c))； 僱主實付租金或退還租金 → 不視為收入 (s.9(1A))，避免雙重課稅。 Rental value = 10% × 來自該僱主的收入 （扣除 s.12(1)(a) 開支及 s.12(1)(b) 折舊免稅額後，但 不扣 self education expenses；share option gains 不計入）；hotel/hostel/boarding house：≤2 房 8% 、≤1 房 4% (s.9(2)(a))；共享宿舍按 4%。可選擇以 rateable value 替代（通常不利）。 股份認購權 (Share options — ss.9(1)(d), 9(4), 9(5)) ： 行使 (exercise)：Gain = OMV at exercise − consideration paid（股款 + 認購權成本） ； 轉讓/放棄 (assignment/release)：Gain = 轉讓/放棄所得代價 − 取得認購權所付代價； 於 行使/轉讓/放棄年度 課稅（notional gain，毋須實際出售）；相關日期一般為配股日 (date of allotment)；s.9(5) 防止重複課稅。 股份獎勵 (Share awards, DIPN 38) ：Upfront approach（授出時有全部經濟利益 → 授出時按 OMV 課稅；其後股息屬投資收入不課稅）vs Back end approach（設歸屬期、離職即沒收 → 歸屬時按 OMV 課稅；歸屬期內股息屬 perquisite 課稅, IRBRD D21/16）。離職後歸屬的股份視為於最後工作日累算 (s.11D(b)(ii))。 退休計劃利益 (ss.8(2)(c),(cb),(cc), 9(1)(aa)–(ae), DIPN 23) ： 退休、死亡、喪失工作能力 (incapacity)、患末期疾病 (terminal illness) 時收取 → 豁免； 終止服務 (termination of service)：服務 ≥ 10 年全免 ；< 10 年按 proportionate benefit (s.8(5)) = Accrued benefit × completed months of service ÷ 120 計算免稅上限，超出部分課稅 (s.9(1)(ab)(ii), 9(1)(ae))； 僱主非應課利得稅者 (e.g. 大學)：豁免上限 s.8(8) = Annual income × 15/100 × completed years of service + MPF 強制供款累算權益； 非認可計劃 (non recognised scheme) 中歸屬僱主供款部分 → 全數課稅 (s.9(1)(aa))。 收入累算時點 (ss.11B, 11C, 11D) ：s.11B 按累算 (accrue) 歸入 YA；s.11D(b) 有權申索付款時即累算；s.11D(a) 已累算未收取 → 收取時以補加評稅 (additional assessment) 課稅；已提供或按其指示處理 → 視為已收 (deemed received)； s.11D(b)(i) ：終止僱傭的整筆款項/延付薪酬可書面申請（付款 YA 完結後 2 年內 ）攤回服務期；服務期超過 3 年者按 最後 36 個月 平均攤分。 D. 扣除項目 (Deductions) s.12(1)(a) 開支 ：必須 (i) 非家庭/私人 (domestic or private)；(ii) 非資本性 (capital)；(iii) wholly, exclusively and necessarily incurred ；(iv) 已招致 (incurred — 已付款或有確定現存債務)；(v) in the production of assessable income （= 履行職務過程中, CIR v Humphrey；住所往返辦公室交通費不可扣）。嚴格解讀下幾乎無開支可扣；IRD 的 extra statutory concessions：一個專業團體會費（須為 full membership 且是任職先決條件）、指定制服僱員洗衣費定額 HK$2,400、佣金制僱員按佣金收入 10% 定額扣除。 s.12(1)(b) 折舊免稅額 ：機器/設備的資本開支，其使用須「essential to the production of assessable income」；Initial allowance 60% (s.39B(1A)(c))，annual allowance 30% reducing value；出售時 balancing charge 加回收入 (s.12(5))。 s.12(1)(c) / s.12A 虧損結轉 ：先用於產生虧損者本人的來年收入；聯合評稅 (joint assessment) 下餘額可抵配偶收入 (s.12A(4))。 s.12(1)(e) 進修開支 (Self education expenses) ：須為 gain or maintain qualifications for use in any employment 的 prescribed course； 在付款的 YA 申索 （非開課年度）；已獲僱主發還部分不可扣；上限 HK$100,000 (Schedule 3A, YAs 2019/20 & 2020/21)。 Part 4A 特惠扣除 (Concessionary Deductions) ： 項目 條文 上限/規則 Approved charitable donations s.26C 須為 金錢 捐贈、合計 ≥ HK$100、給予 s.88 豁免慈善機構或政府；上限 = 35% × (assessable income − s.12(1)(a)/(b) 扣除) Elderly residential care expenses s.26D, Sch 3C 父母/祖父母 ≥ 60 歲（或符合傷殘津貼）；院舍須在 香港 並持牌；上限 HK$100,000 /每名長者；同一長者只可由一人申索，且與 DPA/DGA 互斥 (ss.30(5), 30A(5)) Home loan interest (HLI) s.26E, Sch 3D 香港住宅、須為主要居所 (principal place of residence)、業主、按揭貸款用於購置該住宅；上限 HK$100,000 /年，最多 20 個 YA （不須連續）；共同業主按業權比例 (ss.26E(2)(b),(c))；無應課稅收入者可提名配偶申索 (s.26F) Recognised retirement scheme contributions s.26G, Sch 3B MPF 強制供款（或 ROR 供款以假設 MPF 供款額為限），上限 HK$18,000 VHIS qualifying premiums s.26K, Sch 3E 每名受保人 (specified relative) 上限 HK$8,000 ；多於一名保單持有人視為平均分攤 (s.26K(2))；保單/受保人數目無上限 Qualifying annuity premiums (QDAP) + TVC ss.26O, 26S, Sch 3F 合計上限 HK$60,000 ； TVC 先扣 ，年金保費後扣 (s.26U(2))；TVC 只限本人申索 E. 個人免稅額 (Personal Allowances — Part 5, Schedule 4；2019/20 及 2020/21 金額) 免稅額 條文 金額 (HK$) Basic allowance s.28 132,000 Personal disability allowance s.28A 75,000 Married person's allowance s.29 264,000（配偶無應課稅收入、或已選擇 joint assessment / 共同 personal assessment） Dependent parent / grandparent (DPA/DGA)：≥60 歲 ss.30, 30A 50,000 DPA/DGA：55–59 歲 ss.30(1A), 30A(1A) 25,000 Additional DPA/DGA（與納稅人全年同住、非 full valuable consideration） ss.30(3)(b), 30A(3)(b) 50,000 / 25,000 Dependent brother / sister s.30B 37,500 Child allowance（每名，上限 9 名） s.31 120,000 Additional child allowance（出生年度） s.31(1A) 120,000 Disabled dependant allowance s.31A 75,000 Single parent allowance（只限首名子女） s.32 132,000 DPA/DGA 要件：父母/祖父母須 ordinarily resident in HK （持香港永久身份證不足夠）、年齡達標、由納稅人或配偶「maintain」（同住 ≥ 6 個月或供養 ≥ HK$12,000/年, s.30(4), Sch 4）。 同一受養人只可由 一名納稅人 申索 (s.33)；已婚夫婦的 所有子女免稅額須由一方（經提名）統一申索 (s.31(3))。 個人免稅額 只適用於按累進稅率評稅者 ；特惠扣除則累進及標準稅率皆可用。 F. 稅款計算 (Computation — s.13) 步驟：Assessable Income →（減 s.12 扣除、加 balancing charge）→ Net Assessable Income (NAI) →（減 Part 4A 特惠扣除）→ Net Income (NI) →（減 Part 5 個人免稅額）→ Net Chargeable Income (NCI) 。 Salaries tax payable = lower of ：(i) 累進稅率 (Schedule 2) × NCI： 首 4 個 HK$50,000 分別 2% / 6% / 10% / 14%，餘額 17% ；或 (ii) 15% (Schedule 1) × NI。 稅務寬減：YA 2019/20 為 100% 寬減上限 HK$20,000 (s.100(4))；YA 2020/21 為 100% 上限 HK$10,000 (s.100(1), Sch 43)。 PST 計算不適用稅務寬減 。 夫婦各自評稅 (separate taxation) 為原則；如聯合評稅更有利可選 joint assessment (s.10) ；同性婚姻有效 (Leung Chun Kwong v Secretary for the Civil Service (2019) 22 HKCFAR 127)。 Provisional Salaries Tax (PST, s.63B) ：按上一 YA 的 NCI/NI 以 本年度 稅率及免稅額計算 (ss.63C, 63CA)；預期收入大跌可申請緩繳 (holdover, s.63E：繳款到期前 28 日或繳款通知書日期後 14 日，以較後者為準；理由包括 NCI 預計低於上年 90% 等, s.63E(2))。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall Pair 1: Hong Kong employment vs Non Hong Kong employment（來源判定 vs 服務地點） 對比 ：香港僱傭 → 全數課稅， 沒有分攤 （「once s.8(1) applies, there is no apportionment」），只有三條豁免出路；非香港僱傭 → 只就在港服務日數分攤課稅 (s.8(1A)(a))。判定用 Goepfert 三因素（合約訂立地、僱主居所、支薪地）， 在何處上班完全無關 。 例子 ：Tom 與新加坡公司訂約、薪酬存入新加坡戶口，但被派駐香港分行全年在港工作——他屬 non Hong Kong employment ，全年 365 日均在港 → 時間分攤後全部收入照樣課稅。反之，Peter 與香港公司訂約、僱主居所在港，但被派到深圳廠房全年工作、週末回港（在港到訪 60 日）——他屬 Hong Kong employment ，但因週末在港沒有提供服務可主張全部服務在境外 (s.8(1A)(b)(ii))；若到訪 ≤ 60 日則 s.8(1B) 豁免。 千萬不要因「人在香港工作」就說是香港僱傭，或因「人在內地工作」就說收入不用課稅。 Pitfall Pair 2: Housing allowance（現金津貼）vs Rent refund / rent free accommodation（房屋福利） 對比 ：現金 housing/rental/mortgage allowance → 100% 全數課稅 (s.9(1)(a))；真正的「退還租金」(refund of rent) 或僱主提供住所 → 只按 rental value（收入的 10% / 8% / 4%） 課稅 (s.9(1)(b)/(c), s.9(2))，實付租金不屬收入 (s.9(1A))。分別關鍵：(i) 必須 先有實際租金支出 才有「退款」可言 (IRBRD D92/95)；(ii) 僱主須設有 實際監控 （租約、收據）確保款項只用作交租 (IRBRD D33/97, D149/00)；(iii) 看「付款時實際發生甚麼事」('what transpired at the time of payment' test, CIR v Peter Leslie Page)。 例子 ：合約寫明「housing benefit 每月上限 HK$38,000，以退租形式發放」，但僱員從不交租單、僱主亦從不查核，僱員不租屋也照收全額 → 這其實是 現金津貼，100% 課稅 （CIR v Peter Leslie Page 正是此案情）。反之，僱員簽真租約、每月交租單給僱主核銷 → 屬 rent refund，只按 10% rental value 課稅，稅負大減。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What are the three Goepfert factors for determining the location (source) of an employment, and which factor is expressly irrelevant? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: (1) The place where the employment contract was negotiated and concluded; (2) The residence of the employer (for a company — where its central management and control actually abide); (3) The place where the employee was paid (carries the least weight). The place where the services are performed is IRRELEVANT (CIR v George Andrew Goepfert, 2 HKTC 210; DIPN 10 (Revised) adopts a totality of facts / substance over form approach). [中文白話解釋]：判斷一份僱傭是否「香港僱傭」，不是看你在哪裡上班，而是看合約在哪裡簽、僱主是哪裡人（公司看中央管理控制地）、在哪裡出糧，三件事整體衡量。「人在深圳工作所以不用交香港稅」是錯的——如果僱傭在香港，收入原則上全數課稅。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): An employee with a non Hong Kong employment visited Hong Kong on business for exactly 60 days in the YA (counting the arrival day and departure day as 2 separate days). Is his employment income exempt? What if it were 61 days? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: 60 days or less: EXEMPT under s.8(1B) — services rendered in Hong Kong during visits not exceeding a total of 60 days in the YA are disregarded. 61 days: the exemption FAILS entirely; income attributable to services rendered in Hong Kong is chargeable under s.8(1A)(a) on the time apportionment basis — there is NO "first 60 days free" allowance. Counting rule: part of a day counts as one day; both arrival and departure days are included (IRBRD D20/00, D40/07); training, attending conferences or reporting work progress in HK count as rendering services. [中文白話解釋]：60 日規則是「全有或全無」：60 日或以下全免，第 61 日就連前面 60 日都不保，要按在港日數分攤課稅。計日方法好重要：抵港日同離港日各計一日，朝到夜走都計一日，所以凌晨航班離開會白送一日。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): Mr. K has a non Hong Kong employment with annual income of HK$1,825,000 for the YA (365 days). Under the midnight rule he spent 80 business days in Hong Kong; total business days were 335 and he took 30 days' leave. Compute his income attributable to Hong Kong services under time apportionment. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Attributable leave days = 80 ÷ 335 × 30 = 7.16 days. Days in HK = 80 + 7.16 = 87.16 days. Income attributable to HK = 87.16 ÷ 365 × HK$1,825,000 = HK$435,800 . Midnight rule: arrival day + departure day together count as ONE day (contrast: part day = one day under the 60 day rule). [中文白話解釋]：時間分攤三步走：先按「在港工作日 ÷ 總工作日 × 假期日」算出歸屬香港的假期日，加回在港日數，再除以全年日數乘年薪。記住分攤計日用 midnight rule（到離兩日只計一日），同 60 日規則的計法剛好相反，考試最鍾意混你。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Ms. L received a salary of HK$800,000 and a bonus of HK$100,000 from her HK employer, who also provided her with a rent free flat. She paid HK$5,000 of deductible expenses under s.12(1)(a). Compute the assessable rental value. What if she were given a one room serviced hotel suite instead? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Rental value (flat) = 10% × (HK$800,000 + HK$100,000 − HK$5,000) = 10% × HK$895,000 = HK$89,500 (ss.9(1)(b), 9(2)). Only s.12(1)(a) outgoings and s.12(1)(b) depreciation allowances are deducted in the 10% base; self education expenses and share option gains are EXCLUDED. One room hotel/hostel/boarding house accommodation: 4% × HK$895,000 = HK$35,800 (s.9(2)(a)); two rooms: 8%. Actual rent paid or refunded by the employer is NOT income (s.9(1A)). [中文白話解釋]：僱主免費俾屋住，不是按市值租金課稅，而是按「收入 × 10%」這個折扣價（酒店一房 4%、兩房 8%），所以房屋福利通常是香港最著數的薪酬包裝。計 10% 基數時只扣 s.12(1)(a)/(b)，進修開支同認股權收益唔好計落去。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): Under the s.9(1)(a)(iv) "liability test", when is a payment made by an employer to a third party NOT assessable to the employee? Name the three statutory exceptions in s.9(2A) that are ALWAYS chargeable. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Not chargeable if the payment discharges the EMPLOYER's own sole and primary liability to that person, and it is not a liability for which any person was surety (e.g. utilities contracts signed in the employer's name). Always chargeable (s.9(2A)): (a) benefits convertible into money by the recipient (other than holiday journey); (b) payments in connection with the education of a child of an employee; (c) payments in connection with a holiday journey. Employer discharging the EMPLOYEE's personal liability (e.g. private credit card bills, personal club subscription) = assessable perquisite (David Hardy Glynn v CIR). [中文白話解釋]：核心問題係「邊個先係真正欠債嗰個」：僱主自己欠水電公司（單據寫公司名）→ 僱員無得益、不課稅；僱主幫你找私人卡數 → 當出糧課稅。三樣野無論點都課：可以換錢的福利、仔女教育費、度假旅行。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): In YA 2019/20, an employee exercised an option (granted under his HK employment, cost of option HK$4,000) to acquire 10,000 shares at a strike price of HK$8 each when the open market value was HK$15 per share. He sold the shares two months later at HK$20 each. Compute the chargeable gain and state the year of assessment. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Gain under ss.9(1)(d), 9(4)(a) = OMV at exercise − consideration = (10,000 × HK$15) − (10,000 × HK$8) − HK$4,000 = 150,000 − 80,000 − 4,000 = HK$66,000 , chargeable in YA 2019/20 (year of exercise). The gain is NOTIONAL — no sale is required; the later sale at HK$20 is irrelevant for salaries tax (not a further taxable event under s.9). Assignment/release: gain = consideration for assignment/release − consideration paid for the grant. [中文白話解釋]：認股權係行使嗰年就要交稅，用行使日市值減行使價同買 option 的成本，唔使你真係賣出股票。之後股價升跌同薪俸稅無關，千祈唔好用賣出價去計。呢個係最常見的計算陷阱。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): List the six concessionary deductions under Part 4A with their caps/limits, and state which of them are also available to a taxpayer assessed at the standard rate. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Approved charitable donations (s.26C): money donations ≥ HK$100 in aggregate to s.88 charities/government; cap = 35% of assessable income after s.12(1)(a)/(b) deductions. Elderly residential care expenses (s.26D): up to HK$100,000 per parent/grandparent; HK licensed care home; mutually exclusive with DPA/DGA. Home loan interest (s.26E): up to HK$100,000 per YA for a maximum of 20 YAs; principal HK residence. Mandatory contributions to recognised retirement schemes (s.26G): up to HK$18,000. VHIS qualifying premiums (s.26K): up to HK$8,000 per insured person. QDAP qualifying annuity premiums + TVC (ss.26O, 26S): aggregate cap HK$60,000; TVC deducted first. ALL concessionary deductions are available to both progressive rate AND standard rate taxpayers (unlike personal allowances — progressive rate only). [中文白話解釋]：六項特惠扣除連上限背到滾瓜爛熟：捐款 35%、安老院 10 萬、供樓利息 10 萬（最多 20 年）、強積金 1.8 萬、自願醫保每人 8 千、年金加 TVC 合共 6 萬。記住特惠扣除用標準稅率計稅的人都扣得，但個人免稅額就只係累進稅率先用到。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): Mr. T's net assessable income for YA 2019/20 is HK$600,000. He made mandatory MPF contributions of HK$18,000 and donated HK$30,000 cash to an approved charity. He is single with no dependants. Compute his salaries tax payable (before any tax reduction). Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Net income = 600,000 − 18,000 − 30,000 = HK$552,000 (donation within 35% cap: 35% × 600,000 = 210,000 ✓). NCI = 552,000 − basic allowance 132,000 = HK$420,000. Progressive rates: 50,000×2% + 50,000×6% + 50,000×10% + 50,000×14% = 16,000; balance 220,000×17% = 37,400 → HK$53,400. Standard rate: 15% × 552,000 = HK$82,800. Tax payable = lower of the two = HK$53,400 (s.13). [中文白話解釋]：計稅四步：NAI → 扣特惠扣除得 NI → 扣免稅額得 NCI → 累進稅率乘 NCI 同 15% 乘 NI 比較取低。累進稅率記住首 20 萬係 2/6/10/14% 各五萬，固定稅額 HK$16,000，之後全部 17%。 「Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案：M9_Ch4_Salaries_Tax_Quiz.md / M9_Ch4_Salaries_Tax_Answers.md」

text: M9 Property Tax — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: Under s.5(2)(a) of the IRO, only a corporation carrying on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong may apply in writing to the CIR for an exemption from property tax, where the property is occupied or used by it for the purpose of producing profits chargeable to profits tax. The exemption is not available to individuals, sole proprietors, partnerships or other persons. "Corporation" is defined in s.2(1) to mean any company incorporated or registered under any enactment or charter in force in Hong Kong or elsewhere, but excludes a co operative society or a trade union. The application is made for each property and, once granted, continues in subsequent years until the circumstances change (any change must be notified within 30 days under s.5(2)(c)). 【解題思路】 1. 第一步認住 s.5(2)(a) 豁免的 唯一受惠對象係「corporation」 ，而且要「carrying on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong」，租金收入已計入應課利得稅利潤 — C 完全吻合。 2. A 錯：個人（不論是否香港永久居民） 絕對不能 申請物業稅豁免，residence status 無關。 3. B 錯：係常見陷阱 — 獨資東主 (sole proprietor) 就算租金收入課緊利得稅，都唔係 corporation，冇資格申請豁免。 4. D 錯：合夥 (partnership) 同樣唔係 s.2(1) 定義下的 corporation，不能申請。 5. 記憶口訣：「exemption for corporations only；個人想享此待遇，要成立公司並將物業轉名畀公司」。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: Property tax is charged on the owner of land/buildings situated in Hong Kong (s.5(1)); the occupier or tenant is never chargeable to property tax. A person who sub lets a property is not the owner , so property tax cannot be charged on sub letting income. Under DIPN 14, sub letting by any person other than a corporation (and letting/sub letting by a corporation) amounts to a business , and the rental receipts are chargeable to profits tax under s.14 of the IRO. Mr Chan remains chargeable to property tax only on the consideration payable to him by Company X — not on Company X's sub letting income. 【解題思路】 1. 核心概念：物業稅徵稅對象係 業主 ，唔係佔用人 (occupier)、租客或二房東。所以先排除 B（佔用人 Company Y 唔使交物業稅）。 2. A 錯：Company X 雖然收租，但佢 唔係業主 （佢只係租客再分租），物業稅徵唔到佢。 3. D 錯：Mr Chan 只係就自己應收嘅代價（即 Company X 付畀佢嘅租金）交物業稅；Company X 向 Company Y 收取嘅分租租金與 Mr Chan 無關。 4. C 啱：DIPN 14 講明任何非公司人士分租 (sub letting) 都構成業務，收入課 利得稅 (s.14) 而唔係物業稅 — 呢個正正係 property tax 與 profits tax 嘅接口位。 5. 考官報告指出：考生常混淆「邊個係納稅人」，記住物業稅永遠跟 業主身份 走，唔跟「邊個收錢」走。 Question 3 — Correct Answer: A Model Answer: The assessable value is the consideration in money or money's worth payable to the owner for the right of use of the property (s.5B(2)). It includes: rent received and receivable; payments for the right of use of premises under licence (e.g. advertisement signs on a wall or roof); payment for the use of furniture; management fees paid to the owner (s.5B(6)); non refundable deposits (treated as premiums per DIPN 4); owner's expenditure borne by the tenant; lump sum premiums; and rent recovered. A refundable rental deposit , which is repayable to the tenant in full upon expiry of the lease if no default occurs, is not consideration for the right of use and is not included in the assessable value. 【解題思路】 1. 逐個選項用「係咪就使用權應付畀業主嘅代價」嚟測試。 2. A 啱（即係唔計入）：可退還按金只係擔保性質，期滿要還，唔係代價；只有 不可退還 按金先當 premium 課稅（DIPN 4）。呢個係 money's worth 概念最容易考倒人嘅位。 3. B 錯（要計入）：許可證費用（licence fee，例如喺外牆/天台放廣告牌、車位費）屬 right of use 嘅代價，要計入應評稅值。 4. C 錯（要計入）：管理費 付畀業主本人 （而非第三方管理公司）屬 s.5B(6) 下與使用權相關嘅服務代價，要計入。 5. D 錯（要計入）：業主開支（維修）由租客承擔而業主拒絕償還，視作 assessable value。 6. 考官報告指出：考生經常將「按金」同「頂手費」混為一談 — 分辨關鍵係 期滿可唔可以退還 。 Question 4 — Correct Answer: HK$18,840 Model Answer / Working: Grace — Property Tax Computation for the year of assessment 2018/19 Item Working HK$ Rent HK$18,000 × 8 months (9 months in YA 2018/19 from 1 Jul 2018 to 31 Mar 2019, less 1 rent free month; no rent accrues in a rent free period) 144,000 Lump sum premium HK$72,000 × 9/36 (3 year lease → spread over the shorter of 36 months or 3 years = 36 months; 9 months fall in YA 2018/19 including the rent free month ) 18,000 Owner's expenditure borne by tenant Repair paid by tenant and not repaid by owner 4,000 Assessable value 166,000 Less: Rates paid by owner HK$3,000 × 3 quarters (s.5(1A)(b)(i)) (9,000) 157,000 Less: 20% statutory deduction HK$157,000 × 20% (s.5(1)(b)(ii)) (31,400) Net assessable value 125,600 Property tax payable HK$125,600 × 15% 18,840 Note: The building management fees paid by Grace to the management company are not deductible — all repairs and outgoings are deemed covered by the 20% statutory deduction. 【解題思路】 1. 租金月份數 ：租約 2018 年 7 月 1 日開始，2018/19 課稅年度覆蓋 9 個月（7 月至翌年 3 月），扣除 1 個月免租期 → 8 個月 × $18,000 = $144,000。常見錯誤係計 9 個月租金 — 免租期冇租金應收，唔計。 2. 頂手費攤分 ：s.5B(4) 規定按租期或三年取較短者 — 3 年租 = 36 個月。 注意 ：攤分基期 包括免租期 ，所以 2018/19 佔 9 個月，$72,000 × 9/36 = $18,000。常見錯誤係用 8 個月（跟租金）或分 3 年直接除 3。 3. 租客代付維修費 ：業主拒絕償還 → $4,000 屬 assessable value；若業主有償還則唔計。 4. 差餉 ：業主自己同意並繳付的差餉先扣得（$3,000 × 3 = $9,000）；次序係扣咗差餉 之後 先計 20%。 5. 20% 法定扣除 ：按 $157,000（扣差餉後餘額）計，唔係按總租金 — 呢個係考官常抓嘅錯。 6. 管理費 ：業主付畀管理公司嘅管理費屬實際開支，畀 20% 扣除額覆蓋， 不得另扣 ；按揭利息、政府地租都係同一道理。 Question 5 — Correct Answer: HK$30,000 Model Answer / Working: Item Working HK$ Final property tax for YA 2018/19 HK$180,000 × 15% 27,000 Less: Provisional property tax charged for 2018/19 (paid) (24,000) Balance of final tax payable 3,000 Add: Provisional property tax for 2019/20 Standard rate on the NAV of the preceding year : HK$180,000 × 15% (s.63L) 27,000 Total property tax payable under the 2018/19 notice of assessment 30,000 The provisional property tax is payable in two instalments — normally the first instalment falls in November of the year of issue and the second in April of the following year. 【解題思路】 1. 第一步用公式：應評稅淨值 × 15% = 最終稅款（final tax）= $180,000 × 15% = $27,000。 2. 第二步扣減 已繳的本年度暫繳稅 $24,000 → 尾數 $3,000。呢步最易漏 — 暫繳稅係「預繳」，final tax 要對銷。 3. 第三步加返 下一年度 (2019/20) 暫繳稅 ：按 s.63L 用 上一年度 嘅 NAV 按標準稅率計 → 同樣係 $27,000。 4. 總應繳 = $3,000 + $27,000 = $30,000 ，分兩期繳交（通常 11 月及翌年 4 月）。 5. 常見錯誤：(i) 忘記扣已繳暫繳稅，答 $54,000；(ii) 忘記加下年暫繳稅，只答 $3,000。記住評稅通知書上嘅總額 = 尾數 + 新一年暫繳。

text: M9 Property Tax — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following persons may apply in writing to the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for an exemption from property tax under s.5(2)(a) of the IRO? A. An individual who is a permanent resident of Hong Kong and lets out a residential flat in Hong Kong. B. A sole proprietor carrying on a business in Hong Kong whose rental income from a shop he owns is chargeable to profits tax. C. A corporation carrying on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong, where the rental income from the property is included in its profits chargeable to profits tax. D. A partnership carrying on a business in Hong Kong which owns and lets out an office unit in Hong Kong. Question 2 (MCQ) Mr Chan owns an office in Hong Kong. He leases it to Company X, which then sub lets the whole office to Company Y at a higher rent without Mr Chan's consent being relevant to tax. Which of the following statements is correct ? A. Company X is chargeable to property tax on the sub letting rental income because it receives the rent. B. Company Y is chargeable to property tax as the occupier of the office. C. Company X's sub letting rental income is chargeable to profits tax because Company X is not the owner of the property, and sub letting amounts to a business under DIPN 14. D. Mr Chan is chargeable to property tax on Company X's sub letting rental income received from Company Y. Question 3 (MCQ) For the year of assessment 2018/19, which of the following receipts by the owner of a Hong Kong property should NOT be included in the assessable value for property tax purposes? A. A refundable rental deposit which will be repaid to the tenant in full upon expiry of the lease. B. A licence fee received for allowing a telecom company to place an advertisement sign on the roof of the building. C. A management fee paid by the tenant directly to the owner for cleaning services provided by the owner. D. The cost of repairing a broken window which was borne by the tenant and not repaid by the owner. Question 4 (Calculation) Grace solely owns a flat in Hong Kong and let it out under a 3 year lease commencing on 1 July 2018. The terms and events are as follows: Monthly rent of HK$18,000, payable in advance on the first day of each month. A rent free period of one month was granted at the beginning of the lease (July 2018). A lump sum premium of HK$72,000 was paid by the tenant on 1 July 2018. Rates of HK$3,000 per quarter were agreed and paid by Grace for the three quarters falling within the lease period during the year of assessment 2018/19. On 1 December 2018, the tenant paid HK$4,000 to repair a window broken by a typhoon. Grace refused to repay the tenant. Grace also paid building management fees of HK$1,200 per month to the management company. Calculate Grace's property tax payable for the year of assessment 2018/19. (Ignore provisional property tax and tax reduction.) Question 5 (Calculation) The net assessable value of Mr Lee's Hong Kong property for the year of assessment 2018/19 has been agreed at HK$180,000. Provisional property tax of HK$24,000 was charged for the year of assessment 2018/19 (based on the preceding year) and has been paid. Calculate the total property tax payable under the 2018/19 notice of assessment (i.e. the balance of final tax for 2018/19 plus the provisional property tax for 2019/20).

text: M9 Property Tax — Study Pack (Week 7) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 徵稅範圍 (Scope of charge, s.5(1) IRO) ：物業稅按「標準稅率」(standard rate, 15%，自 2011/12 課稅年度起）就座落香港的土地及/或建築物之「應評稅淨值」(Net Assessable Value, NAV) 向每位「業主」(owner) 徵收；業主的「居留身份」(residence status) 完全無關，非居民業主同樣要交稅。 逐項物業獨立評稅 (Separate assessment per property) ：每個在《差餉條例》(Rating Ordinance) 下獨立評定差餉的物業分開計稅，不可合併；只有「聯名業權」(joint ownership) 才聯合評稅（例如夫婦聯名物業按 50/50 分攤）。 應評稅值的組成 (Assessable Value, s.5B) ：以「權責發生制」(accruals basis) 計算業主就「使用權」(right of use) 應收的金錢或金錢等值代價 (consideration in money or money's worth)，包括租金（未收亦計）、許可使用費（如車位費）、傢俬使用費、付予業主的管理費、不可退還按金、租客承擔的業主開支、整筆頂手費 (lump sum premium, s.5B(4)) 及追回租金 (rent recovered, s.7C(2))。 可扣減項目 (Allowable deductions) ：只有三項 — (i) 無法收回的租金 (irrecoverable rent, s.7C(1))；(ii) 業主繳付的差餉 (rates, s.5(1A)(b)(i))；(iii) 20% 法定扣除額 (20% statutory deduction, s.5(1)(b)(ii))。實際開支（維修、管理費、按揭利息、地稅）一律不另扣。 公司與利得稅的互動 (Corporation–profits tax interface) ：公司出租香港物業屬經營業務 (DIPN 14)，租金須課利得稅 (s.14)；為免雙重徵稅，公司可書面申請豁免物業稅 (s.5(2)(a))，否則已繳物業稅可抵銷利得稅 (s.25)。 2. 必背考點清單 考點 規則（英文術語＋法例依據） 徵稅基礎 Property tax is charged on every owner of any land or buildings, or land and buildings, situated in Hong Kong, at the standard rate of 15% on the net assessable value (s.5(1)). 課稅年度基期 Basis period: 1 April – 31 March of the following year (e.g. YA 2018/19 = 1/4/2018–31/3/2019). 「Owner」定義 (s.2(1)) Includes: person holding land/buildings directly from the Government; beneficial owner; tenant for life; mortgagor ; mortgagee in possession ; person with adverse title receiving rent; person paying a co operative society to purchase property; holder subject to a ground rent/annual charge; corporation registered under s.8 of the Building Management Ordinance (Cap.344) (common parts); executor of an owner's estate. 非居民業主 Residence status is irrelevant ; a non resident owner of HK property is chargeable. Property outside HK is not within scope. Assessable Value (s.5B(2)) Consideration, in money or money's worth, payable to the owner for the right of use; accounted for on the accruals basis — outstanding (unpaid) rent is still assessable; s.5B(6) includes sums payable for services/benefits connected with the right of use (e.g. management fee paid to the owner ). Lump Sum Premium (s.5B(4); DIPNs 4 & 14) Premium for a right of use exceeding one year of assessment is deemed paid in equal monthly instalments over the lease period or three years, whichever is shorter ; spread includes any rent free period. Non refundable Deposit A refundable rental deposit is not assessable; a contractually non returnable deposit is treated as a premium on lease (DIPN 4) and is taxable. Owner's Expenditure Borne by Tenant Owner's expenses (e.g. repairs) actually borne by the tenant (owner does not repay) are assessable; if the owner repays directly or by agreed rent adjustment, not assessable. Rent Recovered (s.7C(2)) Recovery of rent previously deducted as irrecoverable is assessable in the year of recovery . Irrecoverable Rent (s.7C(1)) Deductible in the year the rent is proved to the satisfaction of the assessor to be irrecoverable (e.g. tenant bankrupt or untraceable) with documentary evidence; merely unpaid rent is not deductible. Any excess is carried backward to the immediate preceding year (s.7C(3)). Rates (s.5(1A)(b)(i)) Deductible only if agreed and paid by the owner during the lease period. Government rent is never deductible. 20% Statutory Deduction (s.5(1)(b)(ii)) 20% × (assessable value − rates paid by owner); deemed to cover all repairs and outgoings — actual repairs, management fees, mortgage loan interest are disregarded. Corporation exemption (s.5(2)(a)) Only corporations (not individuals, sole proprietors or partnerships) carrying on a trade, profession or business in HK may apply in writing to the CIR for exemption from property tax, per property; once granted, continues until circumstances change (notify change within 30 days, s.5(2)(c)). Set off (s.25) If no exemption is applied, property tax paid is set off against the corporation's profits tax for the same YA, and any excess is refunded , provided the property income forms part of chargeable business profits or the property is used to produce chargeable profits. Sub letting (DIPN 14) Letting and sub letting by a corporation, and sub letting by any non corporate person, amounts to a business — rental receipts are chargeable to profits tax (s.14) , not property tax (a sub lessor is not the owner). Provisional Property Tax (s.63L) Payable at the standard rate on the NAV of the preceding year , in two instalments (normally November and the following April). Total payable = (final tax − provisional tax charged) + provisional tax for the next year. Owner's Obligations (DIPN 14) s.51(1): file return (normally within 1 month); s.51(2): notify chargeability within 4 months after year end if no return received; s.51(6): notify cessation of ownership within 1 month ; s.51(8): notify change of address within 1 month ; s.51D: keep rental records in English or Chinese for not less than 7 years ; s.5(2)(c): notify change in exemption status within 30 days ; s.56A: each joint/co owner is fully responsible as if sole owner. 計算公式 (Property tax computation template per DIPN 14): 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) 對比一：Refundable Rental Deposit vs Lump Sum Premium（可退還按金 vs 頂手費） Refundable Rental Deposit Lump Sum Premium 租約期滿時一般全數退還，只用作抵銷欠租或賠償損毁 租約終止時 不可退還 (non refundable) 給租客 不屬 assessable value 屬 assessable value，按 s.5B(4) 在租期或三年（取較短者）內按月平均攤分 例子：租約訂明 HK$30,000 按金期滿退還 → 不計稅 例子：簽 4 年租約收 HK$90,000 premium → 分 36 個月攤，2017/18 佔 6 個月 = HK$90,000 × 6/36 = HK$15,000 對比二：Outstanding (Unpaid) Rent vs Irrecoverable Rent（欠租 vs 壞賬租金） Outstanding / Unpaid Rent Irrecoverable Rent 只是延遲付款，假設租客最終會繳付 已「令評稅主任信納」(proved to the satisfaction of the assessor) 無法收回（如租客破產或失蹤） 按 accruals basis 仍須計入 assessable value，不得扣減 在 證實無法收回的課稅年度 扣減 (s.7C(1))；若超出當年應評稅值，餘額 回撥上一個年度 扣減 (s.7C(3)) 例子：租客欠 2018 年 1–3 月租金，承諾數月內清還 → 2017/18 照計租金收入，無扣減 例子：租客 2018 年 7 月 31 日宣佈破產 → 全部欠租在 2018/19 年度才可扣，不是在欠租發生的 2017/18 考官報告指出 ：考生常犯錯誤是把「未收租金」當作壞賬即時扣減，以及把 20% 法定扣除額錯誤地按「總租金收入」而非「扣減差餉及壞賬後的餘額」計算 — 計算題落筆前務必分清扣除次序：先 irrecoverable rent → 再 rates → 最後 20%。 考試貼士 ：見到管理費 (management fee) 題目，先問「錢付給誰」— 付予 業主 的管理費屬 assessable value；付予 第三方管理公司 （即使經業主轉交）則不計入。見到差餉 (rates) 先問「誰付」— 只有 業主繳付 的差餉才可扣。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): Who is chargeable to property tax, and at what rate and on what base is property tax computed? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Charged for each year of assessment on every owner of any land or buildings, or land and buildings situated in Hong Kong (s.5(1) IRO). Computed at the standard rate of 15% on the net assessable value (NAV) of the property. Residence status of the owner is irrelevant ; each separately rated property is assessed separately. "Owner" (s.2(1)) includes beneficial owner, mortgagor, mortgagee in possession, tenant for life, executor, etc. [中文白話解釋]：只要你是香港物業的業主，不論你住哪裏、是否香港居民，都要就該物業的應評稅淨值按 15% 標準稅率交物業稅；而且每個獨立評差餉的物業分開計算，不能合併報稅。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): Which items must be included in the assessable value of a property for property tax purposes? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Rent received and receivable (accruals basis — outstanding rent is still assessable). Payments for the right of use of premises under licence (e.g. car park fee, advertisement on wall/roof). Payment for the right of use of furniture in the premises. Management fee paid to the owner (s.5B(6)); but not fees payable by the tenant to a third party management company. Non refundable deposit (treated as premium per DIPN 4). Owner's expenditure borne by the tenant (e.g. repairs paid by tenant and not repaid by owner). Lump sum premium (s.5B(4)) and rent recovered (s.7C(2)). [中文白話解釋]：應評稅值用權責發生制計算，凡因「使用權」而應付給業主的代價（不論金錢或實物利益）都要計入，包括欠租在內；口訣是「付給業主的都計，付給第三方的（如管理公司）不計，可退還按金不計」。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): A tenant pays a lump sum premium of HK$144,000 for a 2 year lease commencing 1 June 2018. How much premium is assessable in the year of assessment 2018/19? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Under s.5B(4), the premium is deemed paid in equal monthly instalments over the lease period (24 months) or three years, whichever is shorter → spread over 24 months . Months falling in YA 2018/19: 1 June 2018 – 31 March 2019 = 10 months (including any rent free period). Assessable premium = HK$144,000 × 10/24 = HK$60,000 . [中文白話解釋]：頂手費唔係一次過喺收錢嗰年計晒，而係按租期或三年（取較短者）逐月攤分。兩年租約就分 24 個月；2018/19 課稅年度覆蓋租約起計 10 個月，所以該年計 60,000 元，剩餘 84,000 元落入之後兩個課稅年度。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): When is irrecoverable rent deductible, and what happens if the amount exceeds the assessable value of that year? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Deductible in the year of assessment in which the rent is proved to the satisfaction of the assessor to be irrecoverable (s.7C(1)) — e.g. tenant bankrupt or untraceable; documentary evidence required. Merely unpaid/outstanding rent is NOT deductible. Any excess is carried backward and deducted from the assessable value of that property in the immediate preceding year (s.7C(3)). If previously deducted rent is later recovered, the recovery is assessable in the year of recovery (s.7C(2)). [中文白話解釋]：欠租唔等於壞賬 — 一定要有證據（例如租客破產或失聯）令評稅主任信納先可以扣，扣嘅年度係「證實收唔返」嗰年，唔係欠租發生嗰年。如果壞賬多過當年收入，多出嚟嘅部分回撥上一個年度扣；之後如果真係收返，就喺收返嗰年重新計返落應評稅值。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): What are the only three deductions allowed in arriving at the net assessable value, and in what order are they applied? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: 1. Irrecoverable rent proved irrecoverable in the year (s.7C(1)) — deducted from consideration to arrive at the assessable value. 2. Rates agreed and paid by the owner during the lease period (s.5(1A)(b)(i)) — government rent is NOT deductible. 3. 20% statutory deduction (s.5(1)(b)(ii)) on the reduced balance (after deducting irrecoverable rent and rates), deemed to cover all repairs and outgoings. Actual repairs, management fees and mortgage loan interest are never separately deductible . Property tax = NAV × 15% . [中文白話解釋]：淨值計算只有三級扣減：先扣證實收唔返嘅租金，再扣業主自己找嘅差餉（地稅唔扣得！），最後先喺餘額上打八折（20% 法定扣除）。呢 20% 當晒係維修同雜費補貼，所以業主實際使咗幾多錢裝修、供樓利息、管理費，一律唔再另扣。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): Mr Wu let his Wanchai property at HK$25,000 per month. The tenant failed to pay rent from 1 February 2018 and settled all arrears on 15 May 2018. Rates are paid by Mr Wu. What is the assessable value for YA 2017/18? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Consideration is accounted for on the accruals basis : rent receivable for the full 12 months is assessable even though 2 months' rent was only received in May 2018. Assessable value = HK$25,000 × 12 = HK$300,000 for YA 2017/18. The arrears are merely outstanding, not proved irrecoverable, so no deduction is allowed; and they are not taxed again in 2018/19 when received. [中文白話解釋]：物業稅用權責發生制，唔係收付實現制。雖然有兩個月租金遲咗至 2018 年 5 月先收到，但只要租約涵蓋嗰段期間，2017/18 年度就照計足 12 個月租金，即 300,000 元；而遲收嘅租金在 2018/19 唔會再計一次。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): How can a corporation avoid double taxation on Hong Kong rental income that is chargeable to both property tax and profits tax? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Letting by a corporation amounts to a business (DIPN 14), so rental receipts are chargeable to profits tax under s.14 . Option 1 — s.5(2)(a) exemption : the corporation may apply in writing to the CIR for exemption from property tax (per property); available to corporations only (not individuals, sole proprietors or partnerships); once granted it continues until circumstances change (notify change within 30 days, s.5(2)(c)). Option 2 — s.25 set off : if no exemption is applied, the property tax paid is set off against the profits tax liability for the same year of assessment, and any excess is refunded . [中文白話解釋]：公司收租會同時跌入物業稅（因為係業主）同利得稅（因為 DIPN 14 當公司收租係做生意）兩個稅網，所以法例提供兩條出路：一係書面申請豁免物業稅（只有公司先申請得，個人同獨資東主冇份），一係照交物業稅之後喺利得稅度扣返，扣唔晒仲可以退稅，確保同一筆租金只係實際課一次稅。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): What are the key filing, notification and record keeping obligations of a property owner under the IRO? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: s.51(1) : file the property tax return within the time limit (normally 1 month from issue). s.51(2) : if chargeable but no return received, notify the CIR in writing within 4 months after the end of the year of assessment. s.51(6) : notify cessation of ownership (sale/transfer) within 1 month . s.51(8) : notify change of address within 1 month . s.51D : keep sufficient rental records (lease agreements, duplicate rent receipts) in English or Chinese for not less than 7 years . s.5(2)(c) : an exempted corporation must notify changes in ownership/use within 30 days . s.56A : every joint owner/co owner is fully responsible for all obligations as if sole owner. [中文白話解釋]：業主義務記住幾個時限：交報稅表 1 個月內；收唔到報稅表要自己主動喺課稅年度結束後 4 個月內申報；賣樓或搬地址 1 個月內通知；租務紀錄保留至少 7 年（中文或英文均可，唔使兩份）；聯名業主每個人都要當自己係唯一業主咁承擔全部責任。 「Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md」

excerpt: M9 Personal Assessment — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: C Full Model Answer (English) Under IRO s.41, personal assessment may be elected by an in…
text: M9 Personal Assessment — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Answer: C Full Model Answer (English) Under IRO s.41, personal assessment may be elected by an individual who is (i) aged 18 or above (permitted under that age only if both parents are dead), and (ii) either a permanent resident (one who ordinarily resides in Hong Kong — s.41(4)) or a temporary resident (stays in Hong Kong for more than 180 days during the year of assessment, or more than 300 days over two consecutive years of assessment, one of which is the election year). Up to and including 2017/18, a married individual who is himself/herself neither a permanent nor a temporary resident may nevertheless elect if his/her spouse is a permanent or temporary resident of Hong Kong. Option C satisfies this spousal route (assuming the age requirement is met — he is 30). A is wrong: an individual below 18 may elect only if both parents are dead; here they are alive. B is wrong: 150 days in the election year fails the 180 day test, and 150 + 120 = 270 days fails the 300 day two year test; the individual is neither a permanent nor a temporary resident and has no spouse to rely on. D is wrong: holding a Hong Kong permanent identity card (right of abode) does not necessarily mean the individual "ordinarily resides" in Hong Kong (Board of Review case D11/15). 【解題思路】呢題考「邊個有資格選擇」嘅概念分辨。記住三個條件：個人、18 歲以上（父母雙亡例外）、通常居港或通過 180/300 天測試。干擾項設計全部圍繞常見謬誤：A 係年齡例外搞錯（父母要雙亡先可以未滿 18 歲選擇）；B 係日數測試計錯（150 日唔夠 180，兩年加埋 270 日又唔夠 300）；D 係 D11/15 案例嘅重點 — 有居留權／永久身份證 ≠ 通常居住。C 係已婚人士靠配偶居民身份取得資格（適用至 2017/18），所以正確。 Question 2 — Answer: B Full Model Answer (English) Under personal assessment, current year business losses from a sole proprietorship business (and any share of partnership losses) may be offset against the individual's other income (net assessable income, net assessable value, assessable profits of other businesses). Where the aggregate of concessionary deductions and business losses exceeds total income, only the excess representing business losses is carried forward to set off against future total income. A is wrong: offshore business losses are NOT deductible under personal assessment. C is wrong: mortgage interest on a rental property is capped at that property's net assessable value; the excess can neither create a loss nor be carried forward (D51/04). D is wrong: any excess over total income that represents concessionary deductions (not business losses) lapses permanently — it cannot be carried forward. 【解題思路】呢題考「PA 下邊啲虧損／扣除可以抵銷」。B 係正確嘅完整描述：本年業務虧損可跨收入類別抵銷，用唔晒嘅部分（只限業務虧損）結轉。A 係 offshore loss，明確不可扣；C 係 NAV 上限陷阱 — 超額利息永久作廢；D 係結轉規則陷阱 — concessionary deductions 超額部分唔可以結轉（只有 business loss 部分可以），呢點源自 Illustrative Example 13，係最易中嘅伏。 Question 3 — Answer: B Full Model Answer (English) For a married couple electing personal assessment, the reduced total incomes are first computed individually and then aggregated; tax is computed on the joint total, and the tax payable is apportioned between the husband and wife in the proportion that each spouse's reduced total income bears to the joint reduced total income. Separate notices of assessment are issued to each spouse for the apportioned tax. A is wrong: up to and including 2017/18 there is a joint election requirement — where both spouses have assessable income and both are eligible, BOTH must elect; separate election by one spouse is only possible from 2018/19 onwards (or where only one spouse has assessable income / is eligible). C is wrong: under s.42(5) IRO, where personal assessment is elected, a spouse's business loss IS set off against the total income of both spouses before any residue is carried forward (inter spouse loss set off). D is wrong: a couple who marry during a year of assessment are deemed to be married at the commencement of that year. 【解題思路】呢題考夫婦規則。B 係正確：稅款合併計、按 reduced total income 比例分攤、各自收評稅通知書（唔可以由一方代收）。A 係年份陷阱 — 2017/18 或之前必須共同選擇，2018/19 起先可以單獨選；C 同 s.42(5) 講法剛好相反 — PA 正正就係容許配偶間虧損抵銷；D 違反「年中結婚視為年初已結婚」嘅 deemed 規則。 Question 4 — Answer: HK$1,250 Full Model Answer (English) Personal Assessment Computation — Mr Kwan, year of assessment 2017/18 HK$ Net assessable income (employment) 400,000 Net assessable value (HK$300,000 × 80%) 240,000 Total income 640,000 Less: Mortgage interest on rental property (limited to NAV of HK$240,000) (240,000) 400,000 Less: Approved charitable donations [cap: 35% × (640,000 − 240,000) = HK$140,000; actual HK$50,000 fully deductible] (50,000) Less: MPF contributions (18,000) 332,000 Less: Current year business loss (150,000) Reduced total income 182,000 Less: Basic allowance (132,000) Total chargeable income 50,000 Tax at progressive rates: HK$45,000 × 2% + HK$5,000 × 7% = HK$900 + HK$350 = HK$1,250 Tax at standard rate: HK$182,000 × 15% = HK$27,300 Tax payable = the lower amount = HK$1,250 (before any one off tax reduction). The excess mortgage interest of HK$20,000 (HK$260,000 − HK$240,000) is permanently lost — it cannot create a loss, be carried forward, or offset any other property's NAV. 【解題思路】一步步嚟： 1. 先將租金轉做 NAV：HK$300,000 × 80% = HK$240,000（唔好直接用租金入賬）。 2. 利息扣除 封頂 喺 NAV — 實付 HK$260,000 只扣 HK$240,000，多咗嘅 HK$20,000 作廢。呢度係第一個陷阱。 3. 捐款檢查 35% 上限：base = 總入息減利息 = HK$400,000，35% = HK$140,000，實捐 HK$50,000 可以全扣。 4. 扣埋 MPF HK$18,000、業務虧損 HK$150,000，得出 reduced total income HK$182,000。 5. 再扣 basic allowance HK$132,000 得 chargeable income HK$50,000。 6. 兩條數取低：累進 = 900 + 350 = HK$1,250；標準稅率 = 182,000 × 15% = HK$27,300（記住標準稅率嗰邊 唔扣 免稅額）。答案 HK$1,250。 常見錯誤：利息唔封頂（會令虧損結轉計錯）、標準稅率邊扣埋免稅額、忘記捐款 35% 上限檢查。 Question 5 — Answer: HK$26,620 Full Model Answer (English) Personal Assessment Computation — Mr and Mrs Ho, year of assessment 2017/18 Mr Ho HK$ Mrs Ho HK$ Total HK$ Net assessable income 418,000 – Net assessable value (HK$300,000 × 80%) – 240,000 Total income 418,000 240,000 Less: Mortgage interest (≤ NAV, fully deductible) – (120,000) Less: MPF contributions (18,000) – Less: Approved charitable donations [Mrs Ho cap: 35% × (240,000 − 120,000) = HK$42,000; actual HK$10,000 fully deductible] – (10,000) Less: Business loss – (10,000) Reduced total income 400,000 100,000 500,000 Less: Married person's allowance (264,000) Total chargeable income 236,000 Tax at progressive rates: HK$9,450 + (HK$236,000 − HK$135,000) × 17% = HK$9,450 + HK$17,170 = HK$26,620 Tax at standard rate: HK$500,000 × 15% = HK$75,300 Tax payable = the lower amount = HK$26,620 (before any one off tax reduction). Apportionment (for information): Mr Ho: HK$26,620 × 400,000/500,000 = HK$21,296 Mrs Ho: HK$26,620 × 100,000/500,000 = HK$5,324 【解題思路】夫婦題三步走： 1. 各自計 reduced total income ：Mr Ho = 418,000 − 18,000 (MPF) = 400,000；Mrs Ho 先將租金轉 NAV（300,000 × 80% = 240,000），再扣利息 120,000（低過 NAV 240,000，全扣）、捐款 10,000（35% 上限 = 42,000，通過）、業務虧損 10,000，得出 100,000。 2. 合併 = 500,000，扣 married person's allowance 264,000（注意：共同評稅係用已婚人士免稅額，唔係兩個基本免稅額），chargeable income = 236,000。 3. 兩條數取低 ：累進 = 9,450 + (236,000 − 135,000) × 17% = 26,620；標準稅率 = 500,000 × 15% = 75,300。答案 HK$26,620。 常見錯誤：直接用租金 300,000 而唔轉 NAV；用兩個 basic allowance 而唔係 married person's allowance；忘記做標準稅率比較。考試貼士：如題目問 demand note 分攤，就按各自 reduced total income 比例（400:100）拆 — Mr Ho 21,296、Mrs Ho 5,324。

text: M9 Personal Assessment — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Reference data for ALL questions (year of assessment 2017/18): progressive rates — first HK$45,000 @ 2%, next HK$45,000 @ 7%, next HK$45,000 @ 12%, remainder @ 17% (i.e. tax on the first HK$135,000 = HK$9,450); standard rate 15%; basic allowance HK$132,000; married person's allowance HK$264,000; maximum mandatory contribution to recognised retirement scheme deductible: HK$18,000. Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following individuals MAY elect for personal assessment for the year of assessment 2017/18? A. A 17 year old individual who ordinarily resides in Hong Kong and whose parents are both alive. B. An individual who is not ordinarily resident in Hong Kong, is not married, and stayed in Hong Kong for 150 days during the year of assessment 2017/18 and 120 days during 2016/17. C. A 30 year old individual who is neither a permanent nor a temporary resident of Hong Kong, but whose spouse is a temporary resident of Hong Kong. D. An individual holding a Hong Kong permanent identity card who neither ordinarily resides in Hong Kong nor satisfies the temporary resident day tests. Question 2 (MCQ) Which of the following can be deducted or offset in a personal assessment computation? A. A loss sustained in a business carried on wholly outside Hong Kong (offshore business loss). B. A current year loss from a sole proprietorship business, offset against the individual's net assessable income and net assessable value, with any unused balance (limited to the business loss) carried forward. C. Mortgage interest on a rental property in excess of that property's net assessable value, carried forward to set off against future rental income. D. The excess of concessionary deductions over total income, carried forward to future years of assessment. Question 3 (MCQ) Which of the following statements concerning married couples and personal assessment is CORRECT? A. For the year of assessment 2017/18, where both spouses have income assessable to tax and both are eligible, either spouse may elect for personal assessment alone. B. The tax payable under personal assessment is computed on the couple's aggregated reduced total income, then apportioned between the spouses in the ratio of their individual reduced total incomes, with separate notices of assessment issued to each spouse. C. Under s.42(5) of the IRO, a business loss incurred by one spouse can never be set off against the income of the other spouse. D. A couple who married during the year of assessment are treated as married only from the date of their marriage for personal assessment purposes. Question 4 (Calculation) Mr Kwan, a single Hong Kong permanent resident, elected for personal assessment for the year of assessment 2017/18. His details: Net assessable income from employment (after self education expenses): HK$400,000 Rental income from a Hong Kong property: HK$300,000 (no rates paid by him) Mortgage interest paid on the loan used to purchase that rental property: HK$260,000 Loss from his sole proprietorship business for the year: HK$150,000 Approved charitable donations (cash): HK$50,000 Mandatory MPF contributions: HK$18,000 Compute Mr Kwan's tax payable under personal assessment for 2017/18. Ignore the one off tax reduction. (State a single amount in HK$.) Question 5 (Calculation) Mr and Mrs Ho jointly elected for personal assessment for the year of assessment 2017/18. Their details: Mr Ho: net assessable income from employment HK$418,000; mandatory MPF contributions HK$18,000. Mrs Ho: rental income from a Hong Kong property HK$300,000 (no rates paid by her); mortgage interest paid on the loan used to purchase that property HK$120,000; loss from her sole proprietorship business HK$10,000; approved charitable donations HK$10,000. The couple have no children and no other dependants. Compute the couple's total tax payable under personal assessment for 2017/18. Ignore the one off tax reduction. (State a single amount in HK$.)

excerpt: M9 Personal Assessment — Study Pack (Week 7) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 Personal Assessment (PA) 的性質 ：個人入息課稅是一種 稅務寬減 (a rel…
text: M9 Personal Assessment — Study Pack (Week 7) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 Personal Assessment (PA) 的性質 ：個人入息課稅是一種 稅務寬減 (a relief from tax) ，而 不是 一項獨立稅種 (not a separate charge of tax)。它把個人來自物業 (Net Assessable Value, NAV)、僱傭 (Net Assessable Income, NAI) 及業務 (Assessable Profits, AP) 的收入 合併 (aggregation) 計稅，讓納稅人享有物業稅／利得稅下沒有的扣除與免稅額。 選擇資格 (Eligibility, IRO s.41) ：必須是 個人 (individual) 、年滿 18 歲 （父母雙亡者除外）、並為香港 永久性居民 (permanent resident, s.41(4) — ordinarily resides) 或 暫時性居民 (temporary resident — 課稅年度內留港超過 180 天，或連續兩個課稅年度（其中一年為選擇年度）合計超過 300 天) 。至 2017/18 年度止，已婚人士如配偶為香港永久或暫時性居民，即使本人非居民亦可選擇。已故納稅人可由 遺囑執行人 (executor) 代為選擇。 夫婦規則 (Husband and Wife) ：2017/18 或之前，如夫婦雙方均有應評稅入息且均符合資格，必須 共同選擇 (joint election) ；2018/19 起可 各自單獨選擇 。稅款按夫婦 合併入息 計算，再按各自 reduced total income 比例 分攤 (apportionment) ，並分別發出評稅通知書。 計算三步驟 ：(1) 合併 NAV + NAI + AP；(2) 扣除出租物業利息（上限為該物業 NAV）、concessionary deductions（ACD、ERCE、HLI、RRS/MPF contributions）、本年業務虧損及承前 PA 虧損，得出 reduced total income ，再扣 personal allowances 得 total chargeable income ；(3) 稅款取 累進稅率 (progressive rates) 計於 total chargeable income 與 標準稅率 (standard rate 15%) 計於 reduced total income（未扣免稅額） 兩者之 較低者 。 選擇期限 (Time Limit) ：以較後者為準 — 有關課稅年度結束後 2 年 內；或構成總入息的評稅按 s.70 成為最終及決定性後 1 個月 （實際即評稅發出後 2 個月）；或局長酌情容許的較長期限。須以 書面 （稅表有關部分或 Form IR76C ）提出。 2. 必背考點清單 A. 選擇個人入息課稅的五大好處（Key Learning Point） 1. Deduction of interest expense on rental property（物業稅下不可扣；PA 下可扣，但 上限為該物業的 NAV ，超出部分既不能製造虧損、不可結轉，亦不可抵銷其他物業的 NAV — Board of Review case D51/04 ）。 2. Concessionary deductions ：Approved Charitable Donations (ACD)、Elderly Residential Care Expenses (ERCE)、Home Loan Interest (HLI)、Mandatory Contributions to Recognised Retirement Schemes (MPF/RRS)。只有租金收入者在物業稅下 完全不能 扣任何 concessionary deductions；只有業務收入者在利得稅下只能扣 ACD。 3. Offset of business losses ：獨資或合夥業務的本年虧損可抵銷個人（及其配偶 — s.42(5) inter spouse loss set off）的其他應稅收入。 注意：offshore business losses 不可在 PA 下扣除。 4. Deduction of personal allowances （basic allowance、married person's allowance、child allowance 等）— 物業稅／利得稅下沒有。 5. Application of progressive tax rates 。 B. PA 計算格式（Individual, 2017/18 年度數字按來源） 項目 內容 NAV – property Rental income + recovered bad rent − irrecoverable rent − rates paid by landlord − 20% statutory deduction NAI – employment Assessable income − outgoings/expenses (s.12(1)(a)) − depreciation allowance (s.12(1)(b)) − self education expenses (s.12(1)(e)) + balancing charge (s.12(5))； before concessionary deductions AP – business 已扣除承前業務虧損及 ACD 後的應評稅利潤 Total income NAV + NAI + AP Less: Interest on rental property（上限 = 該物業 NAV）；ACD；ERCE；HLI；RRS/MPF contributions；current year business losses；PA loss brought forward Reduced total income Less: Personal allowances（Basic HK$132,000；Married person's HK$264,000；Child HK$100,000/名） Total chargeable income Tax payable Lower of : progressive rates × total chargeable income OR standard rate (15%) × reduced total income PA loss carried forward 只有超出部分中屬於 business loss 的部分可結轉（上限為本年業務虧損）；concessionary deductions 超出部分 不可 結轉 C. 累進稅率（2017/18，來源章節所用） First HK$45,000 @ 2% = HK$900 Next HK$45,000 @ 7% = HK$3,150 Next HK$45,000 @ 12% = HK$5,400 （首 HK$135,000 合共稅款 = HK$9,450 ） Remainder @ 17% Standard rate = 15% D. ACD 上限公式（35% rule） 最高可扣 ACD = 35% ×（PA total income before business losses − mortgage interest on rental property + ACD already allowed under profits tax + self education expenses allowed under salaries tax） ，再減去已在利得稅下扣除的 ACD，得出 PA 下尚可扣除的 ACD。 配偶一方未用盡的 ACD 可 轉移 (transfer) 給另一方在 PA 下扣除。 E. 一次性稅務寬減 (One off Tax Reduction) 課稅年度 寬減百分比 每份評稅上限 2012/13–2013/14 75% HK$10,000 2014/15–2016/17 75% HK$20,000 2017/18 75% HK$30,000 注意：PA 只有 一份 評稅即只有一次寬減；分開評稅則薪俸稅及利得稅各有一次寬減，可能削弱 PA 的好處。 F. 何時不宜選擇 PA 高收入納稅人：累進稅率的邊際稅率 (17%) 高於標準稅率 (15%)，合併入息後物業收入可能被推到 17% 稅階（見 Illustrative Example 8 — Miss Chan）。若誤作選擇，IRD 會分別發出薪俸稅及物業稅評稅，並以 Assessor's note 提示選擇不利。 只有薪俸收入者選擇 PA 沒有任何好處 （concessionary deductions 數額與薪俸稅下相同）。 G. 其他考點 選擇須 書面 作出：稅表相關部分或 Form IR76C 。 2017/18 年度選擇 PA 的最後期限（無評稅發出的情況）為 31 March 2020 。 年中結婚的夫婦，就 PA 而言 被視為在該課稅年度開始時已結婚 。 「Ordinarily resides」案例： Lysaght v CIR （regular visits of substantial period year to year）； Cooper v Cadwalader （maintaining a place of abode）；BoR case D11/15 （保留居所／居留權／與港密切聯繫 ≠ ordinarily resident；23–40 天短暫留港不構成通常居住）。 Self education expenses 只可在薪俸稅下計算 NAI 時扣除， 不能 在 PA 下對租金或業務收入扣除。 DIPN 18 適用於個人入息課稅（LO 2.23.03）。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：Mortgage Interest on Rental Property vs Home Loan Interest (HLI) Interest on loan for income producing property ：只有選擇 PA 才可扣；上限為 該出租物業的 NAV ；超出部分 不可結轉、不可製造虧損、不可抵銷另一物業的 NAV （D51/04）。 Home Loan Interest (HLI) ：屬 concessionary deduction，針對 自住居所 (residence) 的按揭利息；薪俸稅下及 PA 下均可扣， 無 NAV 上限概念 。 例子：陳先生有出租物業（NAV HK$160,000，按揭利息 HK$200,000）及自住物業（按揭利息 HK$100,000）。PA 下：出租物業利息只扣 HK$160,000（多出的 HK$40,000 永遠作廢）；自住 HLI HK$100,000 則可全數作為 concessionary deduction 扣除。考試最常見錯誤是把兩者混淆，以為出租物業利息可全數扣或 HLI 受 NAV 限制。 Pitfall 2：可分開評稅 (Schedular Taxes) 下的虧損處理 vs PA 下的虧損抵銷 分開評稅 ：同一納稅人 Business A 的虧損 不可 抵銷 Business B 的利潤（每盤生意獨立評稅）；業務虧損 不可 抵銷薪俸收入；配偶之間的虧損 不可 互相抵銷。 PA 下 ：本年獨資／合夥業務虧損可抵銷 NAI、NAV 等其他收入，更可透過 s.42(5) 抵銷配偶收入 (inter spouse loss set off)，未用盡餘額才結轉。 但謹記兩個限制： offshore business loss 不可扣 ；當 concessionary deductions 與業務虧損合計超過總入息時， 只有業務虧損部分 可結轉，concessionary deductions 的超出部分會永久作廢（見 Illustrative Example 13）。 例子：李先生 Business A 虧損 HK$500,000、薪俸收入 HK$500,000。分開評稅：薪俸稅照交、虧損只能留待抵銷將來 Business A 利潤；選擇 PA：虧損直接抵銷薪俸收入，該年稅款變為 Nil。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What is the nature of personal assessment, and who may elect for it under IRO s.41? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: PA is a relief from tax, not a separate charge of tax ; it is an alternative assessment on an individual's aggregated total income. Eligible person: an individual , aged 18 or above (under 18 permitted only if both parents are dead), who is either a permanent resident (ordinarily resides in HK — s.41(4)) or a temporary resident (stays in HK 180 days in the year of assessment, or 300 days over two consecutive years of assessment, one being the election year). Up to 2017/18, a married non resident may elect if his/her spouse is a permanent or temporary resident; an executor may elect on behalf of an eligible deceased taxpayer. [中文白話解釋]: 個人入息課稅唔係一種稅，而係一種「計稅寬免方法」，將物業、薪俸、業務收入合併計稅。資格要記三點：個人、滿 18 歲（父母雙亡例外）、通常居港或符合 180/300 天留港測試；已婚者可靠配偶的居民身份取得資格，遺囑執行人亦可代已故者選擇。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): State the FIVE benefits of electing for personal assessment, and one situation where election is NOT advantageous. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: (1) Deduction of interest expense on rental property (capped at the property's NAV); (2) concessionary deductions (ACD, ERCE, HLI, MPF/RRS contributions); (3) offset of business losses (including inter spouse set off under s.42(5)); (4) deduction of personal allowances; (5) application of progressive tax rates. NOT advantageous: high income earners — the top progressive marginal rate (17%) exceeds the standard rate (15%), so aggregating property/business income with salaries taxed at 17% increases total tax; also no benefit for a taxpayer whose only income is from employment. [中文白話解釋]: 五大好處口诀：「息、扣、損、免、累」— 出租物業利息、concessionary deductions、業務虧損抵銷、個人免稅額、累進稅率。反過來，高收入人士因為累進稅率最高 17% 高過標準稅率 15%，合併後可能交更多稅，所以唔應該選擇。 [Flashcard 3] （計算卡） Front (Question in English): Mr X let out a property at an annual rent of HK$240,000 (no rates paid by landlord) and paid mortgage interest of HK$200,000 on the loan used to purchase it. He has elected for personal assessment. How much interest is deductible, and what happens to any excess? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: NAV = HK$240,000 × 80% = HK$192,000 (after 20% statutory deduction). Interest deductible is limited to the NAV → HK$192,000 ; total chargeable income from the property = Nil . The excess interest of HK$8,000 (HK$200,000 − HK$192,000) cannot create a loss, cannot be carried forward, and cannot be offset against the NAV of any other property (D51/04). [中文白話解釋]: 先計 NAV（租金 × 80%），利息扣除以 NAV 為上限，封頂後多出嚟嘅利息（呢度係 HK$8,000）就永遠作廢 — 唔可以結轉、唔可以製造虧損、唔可以搬去另一個物業扣。呢個係考試最常考嘅陷阱。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): How is the maximum deduction for approved charitable donations (ACD) determined under personal assessment? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Maximum ACD = 35% × (PA total income before business losses − mortgage interest on rental property + ACD already allowed under profits tax + self education expenses allowed under salaries tax) , then less ACD already allowed under profits tax . PA total income before business losses = NAV + NAI + AP. ACD not fully used by one spouse may be transferred to the other spouse for deduction under PA. ACD is deductible under salaries tax, profits tax and PA — but NOT under property tax . [中文白話解釋]: 捐款上限係合併總入息嘅 35%，但計個 base 時要加返已在利得稅扣咗嘅捐款同自修費用，再扣返已扣嘅利得稅捐款，先得出 PA 下仲可以扣幾多。記住物業稅下係完全唔可以扣捐款，所以得租金收入嘅人可以靠 PA 嚟扣捐款。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): How are business losses treated under personal assessment, including the carry forward rule and inter spouse set off? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Current year losses from sole proprietorship and share of partnership losses may be offset against the individual's other income (NAI, NAV, AP of other businesses) — impossible under separate schedular assessments. Under s.42(5) , when PA is elected, a loss is set off against the total income of both the loss making spouse and the other spouse before any residue is carried forward (inter spouse loss set off). If concessionary deductions + business losses exceed total income, only the excess representing business losses (max = current year business loss) is carried forward; excess concessionary deductions lapse. Offshore business losses are NOT deductible under PA. [中文白話解釋]: PA 最大賣點之一就係虧損可以「跨界」抵銷：抵自己其他收入、再經 s.42(5) 抵配偶收入，用唔晒先結轉。但結轉額只限業務虧損部分 — 如果係因為捐款、供款等 concessionary deductions 扣到變負數，嗰部分係會作廢嘅。海外業務虧損一律唔扣得。 [Flashcard 6] （計算卡） Front (Question in English): For 2017/18, a single Hong Kong permanent resident has NAV of HK$384,000 (no other income, no deductions). Compute his tax payable under personal assessment (before any tax reduction) using both bases, and state which applies. (Basic allowance HK$132,000; progressive rates: first HK$45,000 @2%, next HK$45,000 @7%, next HK$45,000 @12%, remainder @17%; standard rate 15%.) Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Progressive basis: Net chargeable income = HK$384,000 − HK$132,000 = HK$252,000 . Tax = (HK$252,000 − HK$135,000) × 17% + HK$9,450 = HK$19,890 + HK$9,450 = HK$29,340 . Standard rate basis: HK$384,000 × 15% = HK$57,600 (applied on reduced total income before personal allowances). Tax payable = the lower → HK$29,340 (progressive basis). Key rule: standard rate applies to reduced total income without deducting personal allowances. [中文白話解釋]: PA 稅款永遠係「兩條數取其低」：累進稅率乘（扣咗免稅額嘅 chargeable income），同標準稅率 15% 乘（未扣免稅額嘅 reduced total income）。最常犯錯係用標準稅率嗰邊都扣埋免稅額 — 記住標準稅率邊係 before deduction of personal allowances 。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): What are the rules for married couples electing personal assessment (up to 2017/18 vs from 2018/19), and how is the joint tax apportioned? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Up to and including 2017/18: joint election required where both spouses have assessable income and both are eligible. Relaxed if only one spouse has assessable income, or only one spouse is eligible. From 2018/19 onwards: a married person may elect separately or jointly; joint election requires both spouses to have assessable income; if jointly assessed under salaries tax, PA election must be made by both. Tax is computed on the aggregated reduced total income , then apportioned between the spouses in the ratio of their individual reduced total incomes ; separate notices of assessment are issued to each spouse. A couple marrying during the year of assessment are deemed married at the commencement of that year . [中文白話解釋]: 2017/18 或之前兩公婆都有收入又都合資格就一定要一齊選；2018/19 起可以分開選。稅係合併計，但交係按各自 reduced total income 比例分攤，每人收自己嘅 demand note — 唔可以由其中一方代收。年尾先結婚都當成年頭已結婚。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): What is the time limit and procedure for electing personal assessment? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Election must be made in writing — via the relevant section of the tax return or Form IR76C lodged with the Commissioner. Deadline: the later of — (a) two years after the end of the year of assessment (e.g. 2017/18 election by 31 March 2020); (b) one month after an assessment forming part of total income becomes final and conclusive under s.70 (in effect, two months after the date of issue of the assessment); or (c) such further period as the Commissioner may allow. [中文白話解釋]: 選擇一定要書面（稅表或 IR76C 表格）。期限取「較後者」：課稅年度完結後兩年，或者相關評稅成為最終後一個月（實際等於評稅發出後兩個月），局長亦可酌情延長。考試鍾意出日子題：例如 2015/16 評稅喺 31 March 2018 發出，期限就係 31 May 2018 而唔係 31 March 2018。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案：M9_Ch6_Personal_Assessment_Quiz.md / M9_Ch6_Personal_Assessment_Answers.md

title: M9 Stamp Duty — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！）
headings: M9 Stamp Duty — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！）
excerpt: M9 Stamp Duty — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: A mortgage over immovable property in Hong Kong is NOT chargeable with sta…
text: M9 Stamp Duty — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: A mortgage over immovable property in Hong Kong is NOT chargeable with stamp duty. A conveyance or transfer made for nominal consideration for the purpose of securing the repayment of an advance or loan is a transaction under which no beneficial interest passes (s.27(5) SDO), so mortgages are not dutiable. The other instruments are all chargeable: A: a lease of Hong Kong immovable property is chargeable under Head 1(2) of the First Schedule. B: an agreement for sale of Hong Kong immovable property is chargeable to AVD under Head 1(1A). D: the issue of a Hong Kong bearer instrument is chargeable under Head 3 at 3% ad valorem. 【解題思路】呢題考「Heads of Charge 概念分辨」。印花稅係 schedular tax：唔喺 First Schedule Heads 1–4 入面嘅文書一律唔使交稅。按揭（mortgage）只係為擔保還款而作嘅名義轉讓，無實益權益轉移（s.27(5)），所以唔課稅。選項 A 租約屬 Head 1(2)；選項 B 售賣協議屬 Head 1(1A)（住宅嘅 agreement for sale 自 1992 年起已可課稅）；選項 D 不記名文書發行屬 Head 3。常見陷阱：以為「option to purchase」唔使交——其實 s.29A(1) 將 option/right of pre emption 視作 chargeable agreement for sale。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: AVD: Scale 1 Part 1 (flat 15%) applies. Although Ms Wong is an HKPR acting on her own behalf, Scale 2 is only available to an HKPR who does NOT own any other residential property in Hong Kong at the time of acquisition (first home / home switchers, s.29BD). As she co owns the Ho Man Tin property, she fails that condition → AVD = HK$8,000,000 × 15% = HK$1,200,000. BSD: NOT payable. BSD is not chargeable where the purchaser is an HKPR acting on his/her own behalf, regardless of whether he/she already owns other residential property. SSD: NOT payable. SSD is charged on the vendor's disposal within 36 months of acquisition; the vendor held the property for 10 years. 【解題思路】呢題專門考 AVD Scale 2 同 BSD 嘅「雙重標準」——呢個係考生最易混淆嘅位： 選項 A 錯：Scale 2 唔係「係 HKPR 就用得」，仲要名下無其他香港住宅（首置/換樓）或屬近親轉讓等先可以。佢已聯名持有何文田住宅，所以要用 Scale 1 Part 1 嘅 15%。 選項 B 錯：BSD 嘅豁免只問「買方係咪以本人身份行事嘅 HKPR」，完全唔理佢有幾多層樓。HKPR 買第二、第三層樓一樣免 BSD。 選項 D 錯：SSD 係針對「賣方」喺取得後 36 個月內轉售而徵收，同買方擁有幾多物業無關；而且賣方已持有 10 年，遠超 36 個月。 記口訣：「AVD Scale 2 睇首置，BSD 只睇 HKPR 身份」。 Question 3 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer: C is correct. Under s.19 SDO, contract notes must be made and stamped for every sale and purchase of Hong Kong stock (Head 2(1)). Where ad valorem duty has been paid on the contract notes, the instrument of transfer (IoT) bears only a nominal fixed duty of HK$5. 【解題思路】逐個選項拆： A 錯：發行新股（issue of shares）唔屬任何 Head of Charge，完全唔課稅——印花稅只對「轉讓」（transfer）香港證券徵稅。 B 錯：饋贈香港證券屬 Head 2(3)「轉讓實益權益非以買賣方式」，一樣按市值課從價稅；s.27 亦將無代價轉讓視作按市值計稅。 D 錯：外幣（如日圓）計值嘅債券屬 loan capital，除非以港元計值或唔屬 commercial paper，否則唔算 Hong Kong stock，轉讓免稅。「要喺香港登記」本身唔足以令外幣債券變成 Hong Kong stock。 C 啱：contract notes 交咗從價稅之後，IoT 只收 HK$5 固定稅（對照物業做法：agreement for sale 交咗 AVD，assignment 收 HK$100）。 Question 4 — Correct Answer: AVD HK$975,000; SSD HK$650,000; BSD HK$975,000; Total HK$2,600,000 Model Answer (working): Step 1 — Dutiable value: ad valorem duties are charged on the higher of the stated consideration or the market value of the property (s.27(4) SDO; Heads 1–3). Higher of HK$6,000,000 (consideration) and HK$6,500,000 (market value) = HK$6,500,000 . Step 2 — AVD (Head 1(1A)): the purchaser is not an HKPR, so Scale 2 is unavailable; Scale 1 Part 1 flat 15% applies (residential property, instrument executed on/after 5 November 2016): HK$6,500,000 × 15% = HK$975,000 Step 3 — SSD (Head 1AA/1B): the vendor acquired the flat on 1 June 2022 (on/after 27 October 2012) and disposed of it by chargeable agreement on 1 December 2023. Holding period = 18 months, i.e. more than 12 months but not more than 36 months → rate 10%: HK$6,500,000 × 10% = HK$650,000 Step 4 — BSD: the purchaser is not an HKPR acting on his own behalf → 15% (ss.29CB/29DB), payable by the buyer alone: HK$6,500,000 × 15% = HK$975,000 Step 5 — Total stamp duty on the agreement for sale and purchase: 975,000 + 650,000 + 975,000 = HK$2,600,000 (The subsequent assignment, conforming to the stamped agreement, would bear only the fixed duty of HK$100.) 【解題思路】呢類「三稅合一」計算題嘅標準步驟： 1. 先定計稅基礎——永遠取「代價 vs 市值」較高者。呢度市值 650 萬高過作價 600 萬，所以用 650 萬。考生常犯錯誤係直接用作價。 2. AVD：問「買方係咪名下無其他住宅嘅 HKPR？係咪近親轉讓/法庭命令？」全部唔係 → Scale 1 Part 1 劃一 15%。 3. SSD：計持有期用「chargeable agreement for sale」日期對日期——2022 年 6 月 1 日至 2023 年 12 月 1 日 = 18 個月，落喺「 12 個月 ≤36 個月」→ 10%。常見錯誤：誤用 assignment 日期、或者計錯檔次用 15%。 4. BSD：買方非 HKPR → 15%，冇豁免（唔係近親聯名、無 s.45、無法庭命令）。 5. 三稅分開列、分開計、最後先加總。記住三者係獨立嘅稅，可以同時全部適用。 Question 5 — Correct Answer: HK$27,210 Model Answer (working): Step 1 — Rent component: the term is 2 years, i.e. "exceeds 1 year but does not exceed 3 years" → rate is 0.5% of the yearly rent (Head 1(2)). Yearly rent = HK$28,500 × 12 = HK$342,000 Round up to the nearest HK$100 → HK$342,000 (already a multiple of 100) Duty on rent = 342,000 × 0.5% = HK$1,710 Step 2 — Premium (key money) component: key money is mentioned in the lease and rent is also payable → 4.25% of the consideration: HK$600,000 × 4.25% = HK$25,500 Step 3 — Deposit: any deposit mentioned in the lease is NOT taken into account in assessing stamp duty → HK$57,000 is ignored. Step 4 — Total stamp duty on the lease: 1,710 + 25,500 = HK$27,210 【解題思路】租約印花稅口訣：「租金、頂手費，分開計；按金唔計」。 1. 租期檔次：唔確定或 ≤1 年 → 0.25%（≤1 年用租期內總租金）； 1 年 ≤3 年 → 0.5%； 3 年 → 1%。2 年租期用 0.5% × 年租。注意邊界：「does not exceed 3 years」即係 3 年整都仲係 0.5%，超過 3 年先用 1%。 2. 年租要 round up to the nearest HK$100——呢題 342,000 啱啱係 100 嘅倍數所以唔使進位，但考試時要記得檢查呢步。 3. Key money/premium：因為租約同時要交租，所以用 4.25%；如果係「免租、純付頂手費」，就要當賣樓咁按售賣不動產稅率計。 4. 按金（deposit）係常見干擾數據（distractor），法例講明唔計入。好多考生會錯誤咁將按金加落去計稅。

text: M9 Stamp Duty — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位） Question 1 (MCQ) Which of the following instruments is NOT chargeable with stamp duty under the Stamp Duty Ordinance (Cap. 117)? A. A lease of a commercial property in Sha Tin for a term of 10 years at a rent of HK$200,000 per annum. B. An agreement for sale and purchase of a residential property in Lai Chi Kok. C. A mortgage over a residential property in Repulse Bay. D. The issue of a Hong Kong bearer instrument. Question 2 (MCQ) Ms Wong, a Hong Kong permanent resident acting on her own behalf, is the co owner (with her husband) of a residential property in Ho Man Tin. In June 2024, she signs an agreement for sale to buy a second residential property in Happy Valley for HK$8,000,000 (equal to its market value). The vendor acquired that property 10 years ago. Which of the following statements correctly describes the stamp duty payable on the agreement for sale? A. AVD is chargeable at Scale 2 rates because Ms Wong is a Hong Kong permanent resident. B. BSD at 15% is payable because Ms Wong already owns another residential property in Hong Kong. C. AVD is chargeable at 15% under Scale 1 Part 1, and no BSD is payable. D. SSD is payable by Ms Wong because this is her second residential property. Question 3 (MCQ) Which of the following statements concerning the stamping of transactions in Hong Kong stock is CORRECT? A. The issue of new shares by a company incorporated in Hong Kong attracts ad valorem stamp duty at 0.26%. B. A gift of shares listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange is not dutiable because there is no consideration. C. Where contract notes for the sale and purchase of Hong Kong stock are duly stamped with ad valorem duty, the instrument of transfer bears a fixed duty of HK$5. D. The transfer of a bond denominated in Japanese Yen, the transfer of which is required to be registered in Hong Kong, is chargeable to stamp duty as a transfer of Hong Kong stock. Question 4 (Calculation) On 1 December 2023, Mr Kwan, a Singapore citizen who is not a Hong Kong permanent resident, enters into an agreement for sale and purchase to acquire a residential flat in Mid Levels for HK$6,000,000. The market value of the flat on that date is HK$6,500,000. The vendor acquired the flat on 1 June 2022. Compute the TOTAL stamp duty (AVD + SSD + BSD, as applicable) payable on the agreement for sale and purchase. State the amount of each duty separately and the total. (State your answers in HK$.) Question 5 (Calculation) On 1 March 2024, a tenant signs a lease of a shop in Mongkok for a term of 2 years at a monthly rent of HK$28,500. The lease also provides for key money (premium) of HK$600,000 and a refundable deposit of HK$57,000. Compute the total ad valorem stamp duty payable on the lease. (State your answer in HK$.)
