text: M9 Stamp Duty — Study Pack (Week 8) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 印花稅（Stamp Duty）係對「文書」（instruments）徵稅，而唔係對「交易」（transactions）徵稅——主要法例係《印花稅條例》Stamp Duty Ordinance (SDO) (Cap. 117)，s.4 為一般徵稅條文，First Schedule 列明四大應課稅文書類別（Heads 1–4）。 四大徵稅類別（Heads of Charge）：Head 1 香港不動產（immovable property in Hong Kong）之售賣轉易契（conveyance on sale / assignment，Head 1(1)）、售賣協議（agreement for sale，Head 1(1A)）及租約（lease，Head 1(2)）；Head 2 香港證券（Hong Kong stock）之買賣或實益權益轉讓；Head 3 香港不記名文書（Hong Kong bearer instruments）之發行；Head 4 複本及對應本（duplicates and counterparts）。凡不屬任何 Head 之文書，一律毋須繳稅（schedular tax）。 不動產交易有三種稅：從價印花稅（Ad Valorem Stamp Duty, AVD）、額外印花稅（Special Stamp Duty, SSD）、買家印花稅（Buyer's Stamp Duty, BSD）——三者分開計算、可同時適用；AVD 係「gateway tax」，無 AVD 即無 SSD/BSD。 計稅基礎：ad valorem duty 按「代價（consideration）或物業/證券價值（value）兩者較高者」計算（s.27(4)）；低於市值轉讓或饋贈屬「自願生前處置」（voluntary disposition inter vivos），按市值計稅（s.27）。 集團寬免（s.45 group relief）：關聯公司（associated companies，實益擁有 ≥90% 已發行股本）之間轉讓香港證券或不動產，可全免 AVD、SSD、BSD，但須通過裁定（adjudication）申請，並受兩年關聯期（two year rule）所限。 2. 必背考點清單 A. 一般規則與文書（Chargeable Instruments） 印花稅屬 schedular tax 及 territorial tax：只對 First Schedule Heads 1–4 所列、涉及香港不動產或香港證券之文書徵稅。 Substance over form：按文書實質而非標籤徵稅（Limmer Asphalte Paving Co v IRC (1872)）；徵稅以簽立時（time of execution）之情況為準（William Cory & Son Ltd v IRC (1965)）。 s.2：未加蓋正確印花之文書不屬「duly stamped」；s.15：未妥為加蓋印花之文書不得在民事法律程序中接納為證據。 一般情況下轉讓人及受讓人對印花稅負 joint and several liability；BSD 例外——僅由買方（buyer）承擔；Head 3 不記名文書由發行人（issuer）承擔。 計算結果如有不足 HK$1 之零數，round up to the nearest HK$1。 Contingency principle：若代價「無法確定」（unascertainable）則不能徵稅；若僅屬「不確定」（uncertain），則按可能支付之最高額（maximum payable）計稅。 非現金代價：以股票作代價按轉易日股票價值計（s.22(1)）；以非股票證券作代價按到期本息計（s.22(2)）；以豁免債務作代價按豁免債務額計（s.24(1)）；如豁免債務超過物業價值，可經 Collector 裁定按物業價值計稅（s.24(2) relief，須 adjudication）。 交換物業（exchange）：按「差價」（equality money）計稅（s.29C(10)）。 B. 不動產 — AVD（Head 1(1) / 1(1A)） Conveyance on sale（assignment）按 Head 1(1) 課 AVD；agreement for sale（包括 provisional / conditional / temporary agreement，SOIPN 1）按 Head 1(1A) 課 AVD。若 agreement for sale 已繳 AVD，其後 conforming assignment 只收固定 HK$100（Note 3(b) to Head 1(1A)）。 AVD 一般須於文書簽立後 30 天內加蓋印花（s.29B(3)）。 Agreement for sale 經取消、廢止或撤銷（cancelled, annulled or rescinded）則不屬 chargeable agreement（s.29C(5A)(a)）。 Scale 1 Part 1 ：住宅物業，文書於 5 November 2016 或之後簽立——劃一 15% （flat rate）。適用於公司、非 HKPR、或已擁有其他香港住宅物業之 HKPR。 Scale 1 Part 2 （累進 1.5% → 8.5%，含邊際寬減公式）：住宅物業於 23 February 2013 至 5 November 2016 前簽立；非住宅物業於 23 February 2013 至 26 November 2020 前簽立。 Scale 2 （累進 HK$100 / 1.5% → 4.25%，含邊際寬減公式）：HKPR 首次置業或換樓（名下無其他香港住宅）、近親（close relatives）間轉讓、按法庭命令（court order）歸屬等；非住宅物業於 26 November 2020 或之後 簽立亦適用 Scale 2。 以 agent 或 trustee 身份行事者不屬「acting on his own behalf」→ 須用 Scale 1；body corporate 一律按 Scale 1 較高稅率。 C. 不動產 — SSD（Heads 1AA / 1B；ss.29CA、29DA） 住宅物業於 27 October 2012 或之後取得，並於取得後 36 個月內 轉售/處置，須額外繳 SSD；按代價或市值（較高者）計： 持有期 ≤ 6 個月： 20% 6 個月但 ≤ 12 個月： 15% 12 個月但 ≤ 36 個月： 10% SSD 與 AVD 就同一文書、同一時間徵收。豁免：提名近親（close relatives — spouse, parents, children, brothers or sisters）承受；加名/除名而該人為原買家近親；按法庭命令出售或轉讓。 取得/處置日期 = chargeable agreement for sale 日期（無協議則為 conveyance 日期）。 D. 不動產 — BSD（ss.29CB、29DB） 凡購入住宅物業之買方 並非以本人身份行事之 HKPR ，按代價或市值（較高者）劃一 15% 徵收 BSD，僅由買方承擔，與 AVD 同文書同時間徵收。 不適用情況：文書毋須課 AVD；買方（每位）為以本人身份行事之 HKPR（不論其是否已擁有其他住宅）；s.45 寬免適用；按法庭命令（包括 mortgagee 之 foreclosure order）；聯名購入而其中一名買方為 HKPR 且與另一買方為近親。 近親間住宅轉讓：AVD 可按 Scale 2；HKPR 轉予非 HKPR 近親可免 BSD。 E. 租約 Lease（Head 1(2)；s.16(2)） 租約 / agreement for a lease 均須課稅；已課稅之 agreement for a lease 其後正式簽立之 lease 只收固定 HK$3（Head 1(2)(c)）。 稅率（年租/平均年租/總租金須 round up to the nearest HK$100；按金 deposit 不計）： 租期不確定（not defined or uncertain）：年租或平均年租之 0.25% 租期 ≤ 1 年：租期內總租金之 0.25% 1 年但 ≤ 3 年：年租或平均年租之 0.5% 3 年：年租或平均年租之 1% 頂手費/建築費等（key money, construction fee）：如同時須付租金，按代價之 4.25% ；否則按售賣不動產之相同稅率。 Lease 與 licence 之別：lease 賦予獨有使用權（exclusive possession），屬 estate in land，須課稅；licence 僅屬合約性佔用權。 F. 香港證券 Hong Kong Stock（Head 2；s.19） 「Hong Kong stock」= 其轉讓須在香港登記（required to be registered in Hong Kong）之證券（s.2）：包括香港註冊公司股份及於 HKSE 上市之股份。外幣計值之 loan capital（bonds/debentures）非 Hong Kong stock，轉讓免稅。 Head 2(1)：買賣香港證券，按代價或價值（較高者）合計 0.2% （買賣雙方各 0.1%）； 自 1 August 2021 起稅率為 0.26% 。須製備及加蓋印花之成交單據（contract notes，s.19）；contract notes 已課從價稅後，instrument of transfer (IoT) 只收固定 HK$5 。 Head 2(3)：非以買賣方式轉讓實益權益（如饋贈），同樣按從價稅率就市值課稅。 發行新股（issue of shares）不課稅。未上市公司股份以最近期經審計帳目之資產淨值（net asset value）估值；上市股份按買賣日上市價估值。 加蓋印花期限：contract note 於買賣後 2 天 內（在香港以外達成之買賣為 30 天）；Head 2(3) 自願處置為 7 天 （香港簽立）/ 30 天（外地簽立）。 G. 不記名文書與複本（Heads 3 & 4） Head 3：發行（issue）香港不記名文書（Hong Kong bearer instrument）按發行額課 3% 從價稅，須於發行前加蓋印花；其後之買賣/轉讓不課稅。 Head 4：duplicates / counterparts 每份固定 HK$5 ；如正本稅款不超過 HK$5，則複本稅款與正本相同。期限為正本期限後 7 天內。 H. 自願生前處置 Voluntary Disposition Inter Vivos（s.27） s.27(1)/(4)：無代價或明顯低於市值之轉讓，視作按市值（market value）課稅（anti avoidance）。 s.27(5) 例外（無實益權益轉移，不課稅）：委任新受託人（appointment of new trustee）；清盤/解散時依法分派（Ayerst v C & K (Construction) Ltd）；受託人轉予受益人（trustee to beneficiary）；為擔保貸款償還而作名義代價之轉讓（故按揭 mortgage 不課稅）；因合併依法歸屬（Nomura Funds Ireland v CSR）。 注意：設立信託（settlement on trust，settlor → trustee）屬實益權益轉讓，須按正常稅率課稅；其後由信託分派予受益人則獲 s.27(5) 豁免。 I. 豁免與寬免（Exemptions and Reliefs） s.45 集團寬免 ：轉讓人與受讓人須為「associated」——一方實益擁有另一方 ≥90% 已發行股本，或第三法人實益擁有雙方各 ≥90%；可透過多層公司追溯（tracing through corporate layers）。全免 AVD、SSD、BSD。須以 adjudication 方式申請。 兩年規則（two year rule） ：轉讓後兩年內關聯關係終止，已豁免稅款須補繳。 s.39：售予政府或法人公職人員之轉易契、政府批地/官契及其退還、房屋委員會為《房屋條例》簽立之文書、破產/清盤有關文書（Bankruptcy Ordinance s.125；CWUMPO s.281）。 s.43：領事館舍及若干國際組織處所；s.44：贈予認可慈善機構之饋贈（不包括與慈善機構之買賣）；s.47A：強積金計劃成分基金之單位信託轉讓。 案例 CSR v Arrowtown Assets Ltd (2004) ：發行無經濟價值之「B」股以形式上符合 s.45 之 90% 測試——終審法院按目的解釋（purposive construction）否決寬免，確立 Ramsay principle（WT Ramsay Ltd v IRC）適用於印花稅。 J. 行政管理（Administration） 逾期加蓋印花罰款（s.9）：逾期 ≤ 1 個月 = 稅款 2 倍 ； 1 至 2 個月 = 4 倍 ； 2 個月 = 10 倍 。Collector 可酌情減免（remit）。逾期印花本身非刑事罪行。 刑事罪行：s.11(2)(a)/(b) 意圖詐騙政府而未如實披露事實；罰則統一見 s.60 — 第 6 級罰款（現為 HK$100,000）及監禁 1 年；法團犯罪時失職高級人員亦屬犯罪（s.53）。刑事檢控舉證標準為 beyond reasonable doubt。 裁定（Adjudication, s.13）：已簽立文書呈交 Collector 裁定應課稅款；費用 HK$50。必須裁定之文書包括：以債務作代價（s.24(2)）、饋贈（s.27(3)/s.29F(2)）、s.45 集團寬免（s.29H(3)/s.45(3)）、慈善饋贈（s.44(3)）、foreclosure orders。 上訴（s.14）：不服裁定者可於評稅日期起 1 個月內 向區域法院（District Court）上訴；一般須「pay first, argue later」，除非提供 Collector 滿意之擔保（s.14(1A)）或證明繳款造成 hardship（s.14(1B)）；收到 Collector 之 case stated 後僅 7 天 呈交聆訊（送達律政司司長後），屬嚴格法定時限，無酌情寬免（Bangkok Capital Antique Co Ltd v CSR）。 未加蓋印花之後果（s.15）：不得在民事程序中作證據；惟律師親自承諾補加印花及繳付稅款罰款則可接納（s.15(1A)）；未妥為加蓋印花之文書不得由公職人員或法團登記/存檔（s.15(2)）——公司秘書及土地註冊處不得登記業權變更。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：AVD Scale 1（15%）vs AVD Scale 2 vs BSD —— 買家身份與物業類型決定一切 對比：BSD 只問「買方是否以本人身份行事之 HKPR」（不論是否首置）；AVD Scale 2 卻要求 HKPR 兼且 名下無其他香港住宅物業（首置/換樓）或屬近親轉讓等。因此「HKPR 買第二層樓」= 免 BSD，但 AVD 仍按 Scale 1 Part 1 之 15% 計。非住宅物業永遠不會有 SSD/BSD，且 26 November 2020 後簽立者 AVD 只按 Scale 2。 例：Ms Wong（HKPR）與丈夫共同擁有何文田住宅，現以 HK$30 million 購入跑馬地住宅，賣方自 1973 年持有 → AVD = 30M × 15% = HK$4.5M（Scale 1 Part 1）；BSD = 0（HKPR）；SSD = 0（賣方持有逾 36 個月）；assignment 固定 HK$100。總計 HK$4,500,100。 Pitfall 2：Lease 之「rent」部分 vs「premium / key money」部分 —— 兩部分分開計稅 對比：租金部分按租期長短以 0.25%/0.5%/1% 乘以「年租或平均年租（≤1 年租期用總租金）」計；頂手費（key money / premium）部分在仍需付租之情況下按 4.25% 計（不付租則視同售賣物業）。按金（deposit）完全不計。考生常誤將 premium 與租金合併後用單一稅率，或忘記租金須 round up to the nearest HK$100。 例：3 年租約，月租 HK$20,000，另付 key money HK$300,000 → 年租 = 240,000（無需進位）；租金稅 = 240,000 × 1%（ 3 年？不，「does not exceed 3 years」屬 0.5%）…… 注意：租期「exceeds 3 years」先用 1%；3 年整屬 0.5%：240,000 × 0.5% = HK$1,200；premium 稅 = 300,000 × 4.25% = HK$12,750；合共 HK$13,950。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What are the four heads of charge under the First Schedule to the SDO, and what key principle determines whether a document is stampable? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Head 1: conveyance on sale / agreement for sale / lease of immovable property in Hong Kong (Heads 1(1), 1(1A), 1(2)) Head 2: sale and purchase or other transfer of beneficial interest in Hong Kong stock Head 3: issue of Hong Kong bearer instruments (3% ad valorem) Head 4: duplicates and counterparts of Heads 1–3 instruments (HK$5) Stamp duty is a schedular tax on instruments (not transactions); substance over form applies (Limmer Asphalte Paving Co v IRC) [中文白話解釋]: 印花稅只對 First Schedule 四大類文書徵稅，唔係對交易本身徵稅；判斷一份文件要唔要交稅，係睇文件嘅實質內容（例如實質係租約就唔可以改名叫 licence 避稅），而唔係睇佢個名或者標籤。唔屬四大類嘅文書（例如按揭）就完全唔使交印花稅。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): A company purchases a residential flat in Hong Kong for HK$20 million on 1 February 2024 (market value HK$20 million). What stamp duties are payable and how much? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: AVD: Scale 1 Part 1 flat 15% applies (a body corporate is always chargeable at Scale 1) → HK$20M × 15% = HK$3,000,000 BSD: purchaser is not an HKPR acting on his own behalf → HK$20M × 15% = HK$3,000,000 (payable by the buyer alone) SSD: depends on the vendor's holding period (only if vendor acquired on/after 27 Oct 2012 and disposes within 36 months) Assignment: HK$100 fixed duty if AVD paid on the agreement for sale Total (excluding any SSD): HK$6,000,100 [中文白話解釋]: 公司買住宅係最「重稅」嘅情況：AVD 用 Scale 1 Part 1 劃一 15%，再加 BSD 15%，合共 30%。記住公司永遠唔可以用 Scale 2，亦唔會被視為 HKPR。SSD 係咪要交就要睇賣方持有期。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): State the SSD rates and holding periods for residential property acquired on or after 27 October 2012, and three situations where SSD is not payable. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: ≤ 6 months: 20%; 6 and ≤ 12 months: 15%; 12 and ≤ 36 months: 10% — on the higher of consideration or market value Not payable on: nomination of close relative(s) (spouse, parents, children, brothers or sisters); addition/deletion of names of close relatives; sale/transfer pursuant to a court order Acquisition/disposal date = date of the chargeable agreement for sale (or conveyance if none) [中文白話解釋]: SSD 係針對短炒住宅嘅額外稅：36 個月內轉售就要交，持有期越短稅率越高（20/15/10%）。記住三個豁免情況都同「近親」或「法庭命令」有關。取得同處置日期一律以簽訂具約束力售賣協議嗰日計，唔係以 assignment 日計。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Calculate the stamp duty on a 2 year lease of a Hong Kong shop: monthly rent HK$30,000, plus key money of HK$400,000. A refundable deposit of HK$60,000 is also stated in the lease. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Rent component: term 1 year but ≤ 3 years → 0.5% of yearly rent; yearly rent = 30,000 × 12 = HK$360,000 (round up to nearest HK$100 — already a multiple) → 360,000 × 0.5% = HK$1,800 Premium component: key money with rent also payable → 4.25% × 400,000 = HK$17,000 Deposit: not taken into account Total stamp duty = 1,800 + 17,000 = HK$18,800 [中文白話解釋]: 租約印花稅要拆兩部分計：租金部分按租期用 0.25%/0.5%/1%，2 年租期屬「 1 年 ≤3 年」所以係 0.5% 乘年租；頂手費部分因為有租要交所以用 4.25%。按金（deposit）完全唔計。兩部分加埋就係總稅款。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): What is "Hong Kong stock" for stamp duty purposes, what duty applies on its sale and purchase, and which stock related transactions are NOT dutiable? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Hong Kong stock = stock the transfer of which is required to be registered in Hong Kong (s.2) — e.g. shares in HK incorporated companies; shares listed on the HKSE Head 2(1): ad valorem duty on contract notes at aggregate 0.2% (0.1% each on buyer and seller) of the higher of consideration or value; rate 0.26% effective from 1 August 2021; instrument of transfer then bears HK$5 fixed duty Not dutiable: issue of new shares; transfer of loan capital denominated in foreign currency (not Hong Kong stock); sale/transfer of bearer bonds (duty is on issue only, Head 3) Gifts of Hong Kong stock ARE dutiable under Head 2(3) at market value [中文白話解釋]: 香港證券嘅關鍵係「轉讓要喺香港登記」——所以港資公司股份同港股都中招，但外幣債券唔算。買賣要製備 contract notes 交 0.2%（雙方各 0.1%，2021 年 8 月起 0.26%），instrument of transfer 只收 HK$5。發行新股唔使交，但送贈股票一樣要按市值交。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): How does s.27 of the SDO deal with gifts and transfers at undervalue, and what are the key s.27(5) exceptions? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Voluntary disposition inter vivos: transfer for no consideration or at a consideration materially below market value → stamp duty charged on full market value (s.27(1) and (4)) S.27(5) exceptions (no beneficial interest passes): appointment of a new trustee; distribution by operation of law on liquidation/dissolution (Ayerst v C&K (Construction) Ltd); transfer from trustee to beneficiary; transfer for nominal consideration to secure repayment of a loan (hence mortgages are not dutiable); vesting by operation of law on merger (Nomura Funds Ireland v CSR) Note: settlement on trust (settlor → trustee) IS dutiable; distribution out of trust to beneficiaries is exempt [中文白話解釋]: 送樓送股避唔到印花稅——s.27 會當你按市值賣出嚟計稅。但係有啲「無實益權益轉移」嘅轉讓例外：換受託人、清盤分派、受託人俾返受益人、做按揭擔保等。特別要分清：將資產放入信託（settlor→trustee）係要交稅嘅，由信託分派出嚟先免稅。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): Explain the conditions for s.45 group relief, the two year rule, and the significance of the Arrowtown case. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Association condition: one body corporate is beneficial owner of ≥ 90% of the issued share capital of the other, OR a third body corporate beneficially owns ≥ 90% of each; tracing through multiple corporate layers is permitted Relief = total exemption from AVD, SSD and BSD; claimed via adjudication (s.13; HK$50 fee) Two year rule: if the association condition ceases within 2 years of the transfer, the exempted duty becomes payable CSR v Arrowtown Assets Ltd (2004): issue of worthless 'B' shares to achieve formal 90% compliance failed — the CFA applied purposive construction (Ramsay principle) and confirmed it applies to stamp duty [中文白話解釋]: s.45 係最重要嘅印花稅寬免：關聯公司（90% 實益持股，可以跨層追溯）之間轉讓香港股票或物業全免三種稅，但要經裁定申請，而且兩年內唔可以斷咗關聯關係，否則要補稅。Arrowtown 案話畀你知：形式上符號 90% 測試（發行無價值 B 股）係冇用嘅，法庭會按立法目的睇實質。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): State the late stamping penalties under s.9 SDO, the stamping time limits for key instruments, and the effect of non stamping under s.15. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Penalties (s.9): up to 1 month late = 2× duty; 1 month to 2 months = 4× duty; 2 months = 10× duty; Collector may remit Time limits: agreement for sale / conveyance — 30 days after execution; contract notes (Head 2(1)) — 2 days (30 days if effected outside HK); Head 2(3) voluntary disposition — 7 days in HK / 30 days abroad; bearer instruments — before issue; duplicates — within 7 days after the original's time limit S.15(1): unstamped instrument inadmissible in civil proceedings (subject to solicitor's undertaking under s.15(1A)); s.15(2): cannot be registered/filed — company secretary and Land Registry cannot register ownership change [中文白話解釋]: 逾期印花罰款係 2 倍、4 倍、10 倍三級制，記住時間界線「1 個月、2 個月」。各類文書期限：物業 30 天、股票成交單據 2 天（海外 30 天）、送贈股票 7 天。唔加印花嘅文件上法庭唔用得，公司秘書同土地註冊處都唔會幫你登記。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案： _Quiz.md / _Answers.md

excerpt: M9 Chapter 8: Profits Tax Liabilities for Cross border Transactions — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer (English): Under Inla…
text: M9 Chapter 8: Profits Tax Liabilities for Cross border Transactions — Model Answers（完成測驗後先好睇！） Question 1 — Correct Answer: C Model Answer (English): Under Inland Revenue Rules Rule 5, a PE is "a branch, management or other place of business, but does not include an agent unless the agent has, and habitually exercises, a general authority to negotiate and conclude contracts on behalf of his principal or has a stock of merchandise from which he regularly fills orders on his behalf". Option C satisfies this agency PE limb. For a non CDTA territory resident, the PE definition in the IRO (Schedule 17G, which largely follows the 2017 OECD Model Tax Convention) applies. Option A is wrong: a place used solely for the storage, display or delivery of goods is expressly on the IRD's list of activities NOT constituting a PE. Option B is wrong: purchasing, advertising or collecting information for the enterprise are preparatory or auxiliary activities and do not create a PE. Option D is wrong: mere use of the same hotel room is not a fixed place of business within the PE definition (cf. Knowledge Check Q1 of the chapter). 【解題思路】PE 題目第一步：判斷有冇 CDTA（冇 → 用 IRO/Schedule 17G 定義）；第二步：逐項對照「唔構成 PE 清單」——儲存／展示／交付、採購／廣告／收集資料、輔助性質，全部唔算。代理人要構成 PE，關鍵字係 habitually negotiates and concludes contracts（慣常性、有權簽約）；一次半次或者只係 promotion 唔夠。酒店房只係個人逗留地方，唔係 fixed place of business。呢類題目考官最鍾意用「聽落好似做生意但其實係 preparatory/auxiliary」嘅選項做干擾。 Question 2 — Correct Answer: B Model Answer (English): Following CIR v Asia Television Ltd (1987) 2 HKTC 198 , where a Hong Kong person deals with a non resident on a principal to principal basis (the non resident receives income directly from , not "through", the Hong Kong person), the Hong Kong payer is not an "agent" under s.2 and s.20A cannot apply . To close this gap, the Inland Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance 1989 enacted s.20B (effective 1 April 1989), under which a non resident entertainer or sportsman performing in Hong Kong in connection with a commercial occasion or event is chargeable to tax in the name of any person in Hong Kong who pays or credits the relevant sums. Under s.20B(2), ShowTime HK Ltd must withhold a sum sufficient to meet the tax liability, and it is indemnified under s.20B(3). Option A is wrong: payment alone does not create agency; the ATV case decided exactly the opposite. Option C is wrong: although s.20A fails, s.20B was specifically introduced so that an assessment CAN be raised in the payer's name. Option D is wrong: there is no 183 day rule for profits tax chargeability of entertainers under the IRO; performing even for one day in HK gives rise to HK sourced profits under s.14/s.20B. (The 183 day concept belongs to certain CDTA articles, not the domestic charging provisions.) 【解題思路】見到「principal to principal」呢個關鍵詞就要即刻諗起 ATV 案同 s.20B 嘅立法背景。s.20A 只適用於真正嘅 agent（s.2 定義：透過佢收取香港收入嘅人）。考試常見陷阱：考生以為「香港公司付款俾非居民＝自動係 agent」（A 選項），或者將 salaries tax／DTA 嘅 183 日概念錯誤移植到利得稅（D 選項）。記住：香港利得稅係 territorial source principle，一日表演賺嘅錢都係香港來源，照課。 Question 3 — Correct Answer: B Model Answer (English): Under s.20A(3), where a non resident sells goods in Hong Kong through a Hong Kong agent, the agent must withhold and pay consignment tax = 1% of the gross sale proceeds from sales in Hong Kong (a 0.5% rate is possible only with the Commissioner's approval, which has not been obtained here). Consignment tax applies notwithstanding that the non resident has no PE and does not carry on a business in Hong Kong. Consignment tax = HK$8,000,000 × 1% = HK$80,000 The agent (DairyLink HK Ltd) must also file quarterly returns (Form BIR52B) disclosing the gross HK sales proceeds, retain sufficient funds for the tax, and is indemnified under s.20A(2). Alpen Foods AG may alternatively elect to be assessed on actual profits supported by financial statements. Option A is wrong: Mainland China sales must NOT be included — Hong Kong and Mainland China are separate and distinct tax jurisdictions; only gross proceeds from HK customers count. Option C is wrong: it applies the ordinary corporate profits tax rate of 16.5% to gross proceeds ; consignment tax is a special 1% of proceeds regime, not the standard rate on gross sales. Option D is wrong: absence of a PE/business in HK does not exempt the non resident; s.20A(3) specifically catches sales of goods in HK through a HK agent. 【解題思路】Consignment tax 三大考點：(1) 稅率係 1% of gross sale proceeds （經批准先可以 0.5%），唔係 16.5%；(2) 稅基只計 香港客戶 嘅銷售——內地同香港係獨立稅區，千祈唔好加埋；(3) 冇 PE／冇喺香港做生意 唔係豁免理由 ——s.20A(3) 正正就係為呢種情況而設。呢題同教科書 Knowledge Check Q3 係同一考點，屬高頻題型。 Question 4 — Model Answer Correct Answer: Tax to be withheld = HK$120,000 (deemed assessable profits = HK$1,600,000) Full Working (English): 1. RacketStar is a non resident individual performing in Hong Kong in connection with a commercial event; the sum is caught by s.20B, and the HK promoter must withhold under s.20B(2). 2. Deemed profit method (s.21; DIPN 17 (Revised) para. 14): one third of the gross fee is treated as allowable expenses; two thirds is deemed assessable profits: Deemed assessable profits = HK$2,400,000 × 2/3 = HK$1,600,000 3. Applicable rate: the recipient is an individual (unincorporated person) ; under the two tiered profits tax regime (effective from YA 2018/19), the first HK$2,000,000 of assessable profits is taxed at 7.5% . Since HK$1,600,000 ≤ HK$2,000,000, the whole amount is at 7.5%: Tax withheld = HK$1,600,000 × 7.5% = HK$120,000 4. RacketStar may instead elect the actual profit method by filing a return with documentary support for actual expenses; any tax overpaid is refundable under s.79(3) (either the promoter or RacketStar may claim, but not both). 【解題思路】四步曲：(1) 認人——非居民、個人、商業表演 → s.20B；(2) 視作利潤—— 2/3 做利潤、1/3 做開支（2,400,000 × 2/3 = 1,600,000）；(3) 揀稅率—— 個人 用 unincorporated rate 7.5%（首 200 萬），唔好用公司嘅 8.25% 或者全額 15%；1,600,000 未過 200 萬上限，所以全段 7.5%；(4) 扣繳人係香港 promoter，唔理佢係咪 agent。常見錯誤：唔記得乘 2/3 直接 2,400,000 × 7.5% = 180,000；或者用錯 15%；或者誤以為表演日數太少唔使課稅。 Question 5 — Model Answer Correct Answer: Tax to be withheld = HK$74,250 (deemed assessable profits = HK$900,000) Full Working (English): 1. The licence fee is paid for the right to use copyright material in Hong Kong — it is a deemed trading receipt under s.15(1)(b) , even though CloudWare Ltd has no business or PE in Hong Kong. (s.15 deeming provisions apply precisely where s.14 does not catch the receipt.) 2. Under s.21A , because TechSoft HK Ltd and CloudWare Ltd are unrelated parties, the deemed assessable profits = 30% of the sum paid: Deemed assessable profits = HK$3,000,000 × 30% = HK$900,000 3. CloudWare Ltd is a corporation ; under the two tiered profits tax regime, the first HK$2,000,000 is taxed at 8.25% : Tax withheld = HK$900,000 × 8.25% = HK$74,250 4. TechSoft HK Ltd must withhold this sum at the time of payment/credit under s.20B(2), retain it until the IRD issues a demand note, and is indemnified by s.20B(3). 【解題思路】同表演費題目分清楚：呢題係 royalty / licence fee ，用嘅視作比率係 s.21A 嘅 30% （非關聯方）， 唔係 2/3 ——2/3 只適用於藝人／運動員表演。稅率方面，收款人係 公司 ，用 8.25%（首 200 萬）。常見錯誤：(1) 用 2/3 代替 30%；(2) 用全額 3,000,000 計稅（唔記得 30%）；(3) 如果雙方係關聯公司兼且個 IP 之前由香港業務人士持有，就要用 100% ——本題明言 unrelated，所以唔適用；(4) 以為冇 PE 就唔使課稅——s.15(1)(b) 係 deeming provision，正正捕捉呢類收入。

text: M9 Chapter 8: Profits Tax Liabilities for Cross border Transactions — Phase 3 Quiz (100% OTQ, ALL IN ENGLISH) 「限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷・請用英文作答（MCQ 寫選項字母；計算題寫數值及單位）」 Question 1 (MCQ) Nordwind GmbH is a company incorporated and tax resident in a jurisdiction which has NO comprehensive double tax agreement (CDTA) with Hong Kong. It manufactures ski equipment overseas. Which of the following Hong Kong activities, standing alone, would constitute a permanent establishment (PE) of Nordwind GmbH in Hong Kong? A. Maintaining a showroom in Tsim Sha Tsui used solely for the storage, display and delivery of its ski equipment. B. Maintaining a liaison office in Hong Kong which only collects market information and conducts advertising for Nordwind GmbH. C. Appointing a Hong Kong representative who habitually negotiates and concludes sales contracts with Hong Kong customers on behalf of Nordwind GmbH. D. A Nordwind GmbH director staying in the same Hong Kong hotel room for three weeks while attending trade fairs and meeting potential customers. Question 2 (MCQ) ShowTime HK Ltd, a Hong Kong resident company, enters into a contract directly with Golden Voice Inc., a company incorporated in the US, to procure a one night concert performance in Hong Kong by its non resident US singer. ShowTime HK Ltd pays the performance fee directly to Golden Voice Inc. The two companies deal with each other on a principal to principal basis, and ShowTime HK Ltd is not an agent of Golden Voice Inc. or the singer. Under which IRO provision may the non resident be charged to Hong Kong profits tax in the name of ShowTime HK Ltd? A. Section 20A, because any Hong Kong person making a payment to a non resident is automatically an agent of that non resident. B. Section 20B, because it applies to Hong Kong resident persons who pay or credit sums to non resident entertainers or sportsmen performing in Hong Kong, even on a principal to principal basis. C. Section 14 only, and no assessment can be raised on ShowTime HK Ltd at all because it is not an agent. D. No Hong Kong tax is payable because the singer performed in Hong Kong for one night only, which is below the 183 day threshold. Question 3 (MCQ) Alpen Foods AG, a company incorporated and tax resident in Switzerland, manufactures cheese overseas. It has no permanent establishment in Hong Kong and does not carry on a business in Hong Kong. It appoints DairyLink HK Ltd, an unrelated Hong Kong company, as its consignment agent to sell cheese to customers in Hong Kong and Mainland China. For the year, gross sale proceeds are: Hong Kong customers HK$8,000,000; Mainland China customers HK$12,000,000. The Commissioner has not approved any reduced rate. What is the consignment tax payable to the IRD under s.20A(3)? A. HK$20,000,000 × 1% = HK$200,000 B. HK$8,000,000 × 1% = HK$80,000 C. HK$8,000,000 × 16.5% = HK$1,320,000 D. Nil, because Alpen Foods AG has no permanent establishment in Hong Kong and does not carry on a business there. Question 4 (Objective Calculation) RacketStar, a world famous tennis player, is a non resident individual of Hong Kong. He performs in a two day commercial exhibition match in Hong Kong organised by a Hong Kong resident promoter, who pays a gross performance fee of HK$2,400,000 directly to RacketStar (principal to principal). Using the IRD's deemed profit method under s.21 and DIPN 17 (Revised) paragraph 14, and the applicable two tiered profits tax rate, calculate the amount of Hong Kong tax (in HK$) that the promoter must withhold under s.20B. State the amount and the deemed assessable profits used. Question 5 (Objective Calculation) TechSoft HK Ltd, a Hong Kong resident company, pays an annual software licence fee of HK$3,000,000 to CloudWare Ltd, an unrelated company incorporated and tax resident overseas, for the right to use its copyrighted software in Hong Kong. CloudWare Ltd does not carry on a business in Hong Kong and has no permanent establishment in Hong Kong. Applying s.15(1)(b) and s.21A of the IRO, calculate the Hong Kong profits tax to be withheld by TechSoft HK Ltd (in HK$), assuming CloudWare Ltd is entitled to the two tiered profits tax rates and has no connected entity. State the deemed assessable profits and the tax withheld. (END OF QUIZ — Do NOT look at the Answers file until you have finished!)

text: M9 Chapter 8: Profits Tax Liabilities for Cross border Transactions — Study Pack (Week 9) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 地域來源徵稅原則 (Territorial Source Principle) ：香港利得稅只對「arising in or derived from Hong Kong」的利潤徵稅（IRO s.14(1)）。稅務居民身分 (tax residency) 不是 決定課稅與否的因素——IRO 對 resident 與 non resident 一視同仁；residence 概念只在引用 CDTA/DTA 時才有意義。 非居民的課稅 (Taxation of Non residents) ：只要非居民 (i) 在香港經營行業、專業或業務，或 (ii) 有源自香港的利潤，或在香港設有 Permanent Establishment (PE) ，即須課稅；稅率與居民完全相同。即使沒有 PE，s.15(1) 的 deemed trading receipts （royalties、licence fees、movable property rental 等）仍可被徵稅。 評稅及收取機制 (Assessment & Collection Mechanisms) ：三條主要途徑——s.20A(1) 直接評稅或以香港代理人 (agent) 名義評稅；s.20A(3) consignment tax （寄售貨品按銷售總額 1% 扣繳）；s.20B 由支付 royalties／藝人及運動員表演費的香港付款人扣繳 (withholding)。 扣繳稅計算 (Withholding Computation) ：娛樂表演／體育表演費按 2/3 視作應評稅利潤 （DIPN 17 (Revised) para. 14，餘下 1/3 視作可扣開支）；royalties 類按 s.21A 以 30%（非關聯方）或 100%（關聯方且知識產權曾由香港業務人士擁有） 視作應評稅利潤，再乘以適用稅率。 分行利潤計算 (Branch Profit Computation — IRR Rules 3 & 5) ：非金融機構用 proportionate turnover method （Adjusted worldwide profits × HK turnover / Worldwide turnover）；銀行分行用 proportionate assets method （× HK assets / Worldwide assets）；帳目清楚時用 actual profit method；兩者皆不可行時評稅主任可按 s.21 以 HK turnover 的公平百分比計算。 2. 必背考點清單 (A) 基本徵稅框架 IRO s.14(1) ：對每名在香港經營行業、專業或業務的人士，就其源自香港的應評稅利潤徵收利得稅。「Every person」涵蓋 residents and non residents（individuals、corporations、partnerships、trustees、bodies of persons）。 稅務居民 (s.20AB(2)) ：個人——通常居於香港 (ordinarily resides)，或於有關課稅年度在港逗留超過 180 天 ，或連續兩個課稅年度（其中之一為有關年度）超過 300 天 ；公司／合夥／信託受託人—— central management and control exercised in Hong Kong 。在香港註冊成立且中央管理及控制在港的公司一般視為香港稅務居民。 「Non resident」（就 s.20A / s.20B 而言，DIPN 17 (Revised) para. 8） ：指 no permanent business presence in Hong Kong 的人士。 (B) Permanent Establishment (PE) IRR Rule 5 定義 ：「a branch, management or other place of business」，但不包括代理人，除非該代理人 has, and habitually exercises, a general authority to negotiate and conclude contracts on behalf of his principal，或 has a stock of merchandise from which he regularly fills orders 。 不構成 PE 的活動 （preparatory / auxiliary 性質）：純儲存、展示或交付貨品；純存放貨品（包括供另一企業加工）；採購、廣告或收集資料；輔助性質活動及上述組合。 Representative Office (RO) 若 (1) 只為企業本身利益、(2) 不直接產生利潤、(3) 只為海外母公司提供支援，亦不視作 PE。 Schedule 17G （由 Inland Revenue (Amendment) (No. 6) Ordinance 2018 引入，2018 年 7 月 13 日生效）在 IRO 加入 PE 定義： CDTA 地區居民 跟隨相關 CDTA 的 PE article（CDTA 定義凌駕 IRD 定義）； 非 CDTA 地區居民 跟隨 IRO 內大致按 2017 OECD Model Tax Convention 的定義。 有 PE ≠ 免稅；沒有 PE ≠ 免稅——沒有 PE 的非居民仍可就源自香港的收入課物業稅、薪俸稅或利得稅。 (C) 針對非居民的特別條文 IRO 條文 內容 s.15(1)(a), (b), (ba), (bb), (d) Deemed trading receipts s.20 Business with closely connected resident persons s.20A(3) Assessments on HK agents and non resident persons for goods on consignment s.20B Withholding obligations on resident persons paying or crediting certain payments to non resident persons s.20AA Broker / investment adviser 為非居民行事時 deemed not to be an agent（詳見 DIPN 30） s.21 Assessable profits computed on a fair percentage of turnover s.21A Deemed assessable profits under s.15(1)(a), (b), (ba)：30% 或 100% s.79(3) Refund of tax overpaid by non resident persons (D) Deemed Trading Receipts — s.15(1) s.15(1)(a) ：在港放映或使用 cinematograph or television film or tape、sound recording 或相關廣告材料所得的款項。 s.15(1)(b) ：在港 use of or right to use patent、design、trademark、copyright material、secret process or formula 等知識產權（或傳授相關知識）所得的款項。 s.15(1)(ba) ：在 香港以外 使用上述知識產權，但該款項在計算付款人的應評稅利潤時屬 deductible 者（反避稅條文，因 Emerson Radio 案於 2004 年 6 月 25 日起生效的評稅實務而立法）。 s.15(1)(bb) ：非居民出售或轉讓 performer's economic right 所得款項。 s.15(1)(d) ： movable property 在香港使用的 hire、rental 或類似收費。 適用前提：該等交易 未落入 s.14 基本徵稅範圍 ；已在 s.14 下課稅者不適用。 (E) s.21A 視作利潤比率 非關聯方 (unrelated parties)： 30% of the payment 視作應評稅利潤。 關聯方 (related parties) 且 該知識產權／權利曾由在港經營業務的人士擁有 (previously owned by a person carrying on a trade, profession or business in HK)： 100% 視作應評稅利潤。 (F) Consignment Tax — s.20A(3) 非居民透過香港代理人在港售貨：代理人須按 1% of gross sale proceeds 計算並繳付 consignment tax 予稅局局長（經局長批准可低至 0.5% ）。 代理人須每季提交 Form BIR52B 申報香港銷售總額；須保留足夠款項以應付非居民的稅務責任，並獲 s.20A(2) 彌償保障 (indemnified)。 若非居民向 IRD 提供承擔稅務責任的 undertaking，局長可豁免代理人的扣繳責任。 Consignment tax 一般視為 final tax ；非居民可要求改按實際收入及開支（附財務報表及文件支持）評稅。若代理人活動構成非居民的 PE，可按 s.20A(3) 或 s.14 評稅，利潤按 IRR Rule 5 計算。 (G) Withholding under s.20B（因 ATV 案而立法） CIR v Asia Television Ltd (1987) 2 HKTC 198 ：高等法院裁定，當香港付款人與非居民按 principal to principal 基礎交易（非居民直接從 ATV 收款而非「透過」ATV 收款），ATV 不是 s.2 定義下的「agent」，s.20A 不適用。Inland Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance 1989 因此引入 s.20B （1989 年 4 月 1 日生效）。 s.20B 涵蓋兩類付款：(1) ss.15(1)(a), (b), (ba), (bb) 下視作源自香港的 royalties and licence fees ；(2) 非居民 entertainer or sportsman 在港就 commercial occasion or event 表演的報酬（包括宣傳活動、錄音、電影、電台、電視等）。 s.20B(2) ：付款或入帳的香港居民須在付款／入帳時扣起足夠稅款；即使款項支付予 另一名 非居民（例如非居民經理人），居民付款人仍須扣繳；若款項支付予另一名居民（代非居民收取），該名居民須代為扣繳。 s.20B(3) ：扣繳人獲彌償保障；扣起的稅款須保留至收到 IRD 的 demand note 方須繳付（香港非 self assessment 制度）。 Entertainer or sportsman 定義 (s.20B(4)) ：a person, other than a corporation , who gives a performance in the character of an entertainer/sportsman（公眾可觀看或收聽的任何體育或娛樂活動，不論收費與否、現場或錄播）。 (H) 扣繳稅額公式（s.8.3.3） 付款類型 視作應評稅利潤 稅率 ss.15(1)(a), (b), (ba) 款項（royalties 等） 30% 或 100% of sums（s.21A） Standard rate 或 corporate profits tax rate 非居民 entertainer/sportsman 商業表演 2/3 of the sums （s.21，1/3 視作可扣開支，DIPN 17 para. 14） 同上；另可選 actual profit method （須提供證明文件） (I) 稅率（Two tiered Profits Tax Regime，YA 2018/19 起） Corporations：首 HK$2 million 應評稅利潤 8.25% ，其後 16.5% 。 Unincorporated persons（包括個人 entertainer/sportsman）：首 HK$2 million 7.5% ，其後 15% 。 (J) 分行利潤計算 IRR Rule 5 （非銀行）：(a) actual profit method（帳目清楚反映香港真實利潤）；(b) proportionate method： Assessable profits = Adjusted worldwide profits × HK turnover / Worldwide turnover ；(c) 兩法均不可行或不公平時，按 HK turnover 的公平百分比（s.21 提供法律依據）。 IRR Rule 3 （銀行分行）：同上，但 (b) 用 HK assets / Worldwide assets 。不同意評稅可依 s.64(1) 提出反對 (objection)。 (K) 重要案例 CIR v Emerson Radio Corporation (2000) HKRC 90 102 ：CFA 裁定 trademark royalties 可 apportioned ——商標在港製造過程中貼附於貨品（affixing the mark in HK）即屬 use in HK ，該部分 royalties 應課稅。IRD 現行實務（2004 年 6 月 25 日起）：(1) 貨品在外地製造及銷售、商標在外地貼附——不在 s.15(1)(b) 下課稅，但須留意 s.15(1)(ba)；(2) 商標在港貼附——課稅；(3) 在港製造並在港銷售——課稅；(4) 外地製造但在港銷售——課稅。 Lam Soon Trademark Ltd v CIR (2005) HKRC 90 171 ：收購商標及授出特許的 strategic decisions 在港作出 、授權協議在港商議及簽訂、商標在港註冊、香港管理層積極保護商標——裁定納稅人在港經營業務、royalty 源自香港（s.14 課稅）；s.60 可用以發出補加評稅，即使之前已按 s.15(1)(b) 評稅。 (L) Refund of Tax Overpaid — s.79(3) 非居民按 s.20A 或 s.20B 以他人名義被評稅並已繳稅者， 該他人或非居民本人（兩者不可同時） 可申請退還多繳稅款。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：s.20A（Agent）vs s.20B（Principal to principal Payer） 對比： s.20A 只適用於香港付款人是非居民的真正「 agent 」（s.2 定義：agent、attorney、factor、receiver、manager，或任何「through whom」非居民收取源自香港利潤的人）。 ATV 案 裁定 principal to principal 直接付款不構成代理關係，s.20A 無法適用——漏洞由 s.20B 填補：只要是香港居民支付／入帳 royalties、licence fees 或非居民藝人／運動員表演費 ，不論是否代理人，均須扣繳。 例子：HK promoter 直接與美國歌星簽約並直接支付表演費 HK$1,000,000——兩者為 principal to principal， 不是 agent ，故用 s.20B 扣繳：HK$1,000,000 × 2/3 × 7.5% = HK$50,000。若該歌星在港有代理人代其收款，則 s.20A 亦適用。⚠️ 考官報告常見錯誤：考生混淆兩條條文的適用場景，見到「向非居民付款」便自動引用 s.20A，忽略先判斷付款人是否 agent。 Pitfall 2：30% vs 100% Deemed Assessable Profits（s.21A）vs 2/3 Deemed Basis（s.21, DIPN 17） 對比： 30% / 100% 只適用於 s.15(1)(a), (b), (ba) 的 royalties／licence fees／知識產權款項 ——非關聯方用 30%；關聯方 且 知識產權曾由香港業務人士擁有才用 100%。 2/3（two thirds） 只適用於 非居民 entertainer or sportsman 的商業表演收入（s.21 + DIPN 17 (Revised) para. 14），1/3 視作開支。兩套比率 不可互換 ，亦不可套用到 consignment tax（後者按 1% of gross proceeds ，完全不同基礎）。 例子：英國科技公司（非關聯方、公司）收 HK 客戶軟件 licence fee HK$2,400,000 → 視作利潤 = 30% × 2,400,000 = HK$720,000 → 稅 = 8.25% = HK$59,400 。若同一筆款誤用 2/3 基礎，會得出 HK$1,600,000 視作利潤——錯！⚠️ 考官報告指出：考生經常把 entertainer 的 2/3 比率誤用於 royalty 付款，或忘記關聯方 + previously HK owned IP 須用 100%。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): Does tax residency determine whether a person is chargeable to Hong Kong profits tax? When is residence relevant? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: No. HK profits tax follows the territorial source principle (IRO s.14(1)): only profits arising in or derived from Hong Kong from a trade, profession or business carried on in HK are chargeable. The IRO makes no distinction between residents and non residents ; the same rates apply to both. Residence is only relevant for applying Comprehensive Double Tax Agreements (CDTAs/DTAs) — e.g. the PE article of the relevant CDTA prevails over the IRD's PE definition. [中文白話解釋]: 香港利得稅睇嘅係「利潤來源喺邊度」，而唔係「你係咪香港稅務居民」。無論居民定非居民，只要在港經營業務並賺取源自香港的利潤就要交稅，稅率一樣。居民身分只有喺引用雙邊稅務協定 (CDTA) 先有用，例如決定 PE 定義用邊套。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): Under IRR Rule 5, when does an AGENT constitute a permanent establishment (PE) of a non resident in Hong Kong? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: PE = "a branch, management or other place of business"; an agent is not a PE unless he: (i) has, and habitually exercises, a general authority to negotiate and conclude contracts on behalf of his principal; OR (ii) has a stock of merchandise from which he regularly fills orders on behalf of his principal. Preparatory/auxiliary activities (storage, display, delivery, purchasing, advertising, information collection) do not create a PE; a Representative Office meeting the three conditions is not a PE either. For CDTA territory residents, the CDTA PE article prevails; otherwise the IRO (Schedule 17G, following the 2017 OECD Model) applies. [中文白話解釋]: 普通代理人本身唔構成 PE，除非佢「慣常地」有權代表非居民傾掂兼簽訂合約，或者手上有存貨並定期代為執貨出單。一次性行為通常唔算。記住關鍵字 habitually ——考官最鍾意考呢度。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): List the FIVE deemed trading receipts under IRO s.15(1) that can tax a non resident with no business presence in Hong Kong. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: s.15(1)(a) : sums from the exhibition or use in HK of cinematograph/TV film or tape, sound recordings or connected advertising material. s.15(1)(b) : sums for the use of or right to use in HK patents, designs, trademarks, copyright material, secret processes/formulae (or imparting connected knowledge). s.15(1)(ba) : sums for use of such IP outside HK which are deductible in computing the payer's HK assessable profits (anti avoidance, enacted after Emerson Radio ). s.15(1)(bb) : sums received by a non resident from sale/assignment of a performer's economic right . s.15(1)(d) : hire, rental or similar charges for use of movable property in HK . Pre condition: not already chargeable under s.14. [中文白話解釋]: 呢五條係「deeming provisions」：即使非居民喺香港冇生意、冇辦公室，只要收到呢五類錢，法例就「當」佢係源自香港的營業收入嚟徵稅。記口訣：film、IP in HK、IP outside HK (deductible)、performer right、movable property rental。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): A HK company pays HK$2,400,000 licence fee to an UNRELATED non resident corporation for use of a trademark in HK. Compute the withholding tax. What changes if the parties are related and the trademark was previously owned by a HK business? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Unrelated (s.21A): deemed assessable profits = 30% × HK$2,400,000 = HK$720,000 ; tax at 8.25% (first HK$2M, corporation) = HK$59,400 , withheld under s.20B. Related + IP previously owned by a person carrying on business in HK: deemed profits = 100% × HK$2,400,000 = HK$2,400,000; tax = HK$2M × 8.25% + HK$400,000 × 16.5% = HK$165,000 + HK$66,000 = HK$231,000 . [中文白話解釋]: Royalty／licence fee 呢類 s.15(1)(b) 款項，用 s.21A 嘅 30% 作為視作利潤再乘稅率。但係如果雙方係關聯公司，而個知識產權之前係由香港做生意嘅人持有，就要用 100%——係防避稅嘅懲罰性比率。記住：30% 係 normal，100% 係 related + previously HK owned。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): A non resident US tennis player (an individual) receives HK$2,400,000 for a one day exhibition match in HK. Compute the HK tax to be withheld under the deemed profit method. Can he elect otherwise? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Deemed profit method (s.21 + DIPN 17 (Revised) para. 14): assessable profits = 2/3 × HK$2,400,000 = HK$1,600,000 (1/3 treated as allowable expenses). Tax at 7.5% (individual, first HK$2M, two tiered rate) = HK$120,000 , withheld by the HK payer under s.20B(2). Yes — he may elect the actual profit method by filing a tax return with supporting documents for actual deductible expenses; excess tax withheld is refundable under s.79(3) (either the payer or the non resident may claim, not both). [中文白話解釋]: 非居民藝人／運動員表演費嘅標準做法：三分二當利潤，三分一當開支，再乘稅率（個人用 7.5% 起步，公司用 8.25%）。如果實際開支多過三分一，可以揀 actual profit method，但要拎得出單據證明。一日表演都照樣要課稅——逗留日數唔係考慮因素。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): What is "consignment tax" under s.20A(3)? State the rate, the agent's obligations, and the non resident's options. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: A non resident selling goods in HK through a HK agent is liable to consignment tax = 1% of gross sale proceeds (0.5% possible with the Commissioner's approval); generally a final tax . HK agent must: (i) calculate and pay the tax to the Commissioner; (ii) file quarterly returns (Form BIR52B) disclosing gross HK sales; (iii) retain sufficient funds for the non resident's tax liability — indemnified under s.20A(2). Exemption possible if the non resident gives an undertaking to the IRD to meet his tax liability. The non resident may instead request assessment on actual profits with supporting financial statements. [中文白話解釋]: 寄售稅只計香港客戶嘅銷售總額（中國大陸同香港係兩個獨立稅務管轄區，唔好夾埋計），稅率係 1%（經批准可 0.5%），而唔係 16.5%。香港代理人仲要按季報 BIR52B。呢個一般係 final tax，但非居民可以揀按實際利潤評稅。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): Why was s.20B enacted? Explain with reference to CIR v Asia Television Ltd (1987) and the scope of s.20B. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: ATV case : ATV paid licence fees directly to a non resident film distributor on a principal to principal basis; the High Court held ATV was not an "agent" under s.2 (the non resident received income directly from, not "through", ATV), so s.20A could not be used. Inland Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance 1989 introduced s.20B (effective 1 April 1989) to tax a non resident in the name of any person in HK who pays or credits : (i) royalties/licence fees deemed under ss.15(1)(a), (b), (ba), (bb); (ii) sums for HK performances by non resident entertainers/sportsmen in connection with commercial occasions/events. s.20A remains for genuine agents; s.20B(2)/(3) impose the withholding duty and indemnify the payer. [中文白話解釋]: ATV 案話俾大家知：直接付款、principal to principal 嘅交易入面，香港付款人唔係「agent」，稅局用唔到 s.20A。於是政府立法加 s.20B，將扣繳責任放喺「任何付款或入帳俾非居民嘅香港人」身上，專門針對 royalties 同藝人／運動員表演費兩類款項。s.20A 留返俾真正嘅代理關係。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): Maple Canada style computation: A non resident MANUFACTURING company's HK branch has adjusted worldwide profits of HK$40M, HK turnover HK$30M, worldwide turnover HK$100M, HK assets HK$20M, worldwide assets HK$60M; HK branch expenses are only estimates. Compute the assessable profits of the HK branch and justify the method. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Method selection (IRR Rule 5): the actual profit method is inappropriate (branch expenses merely estimated); the assets based proportionate method (IRR Rule 3) applies only to banks/financial institutions — a manufacturer/trader uses the proportionate turnover method . Assessable profits = Adjusted worldwide profits × HK turnover / Worldwide turnover = HK$40M × (HK$30M / HK$100M) = HK$12,000,000 . [中文白話解釋]: 揀方法嘅次序：先睇帳目可唔可以可靠咁顯示香港利潤——唔得（開支只係估計）就用 proportionate method。跟住睇行業： 非金融機構用 turnover ratio，銀行先至用 assets ratio 。呢間係製造公司，所以係 40M × 30% = 12M。見到 assets 數據唔好自動用，係陷阱。 Phase 3 測驗題目及答案請見另外兩個檔案：M9_Ch8_Crossborder_Profits_Tax_Quiz.md / M9_Ch8_Crossborder_Profits_Tax_Answers.md

text: HKICPA QP 備考系統 — AI Tutor 交接文件 (Handover Brief) 用法 ：將呢份文件 成個貼畀 Gemini（或任何 AI） 作為第一段訊息，佢就可以無縫接手做你嘅 tutor。 文件日期：2026 09 03 ｜ 目前進度：W3（M7 Ch3 + M9 Ch3） Part 1：直接貼畀新 AI 嘅指令（由呢度開始 copy） （copy 到呢度為止） Part 2：學生檔案 語言 ：母語廣東話/中文；英文係最大障礙 — 睇得明概念但睇唔明英文題目，曾試過 MCQ 因為英文理解而答唔到或答錯。需要「拆題」（教佢認題目關鍵字）。 弱點（按頻率排序） ： 1. 概念分類邊界 — 最致命。例：搞錯 EMH 三層嵌套、短期 vs 長期融資分界、PIPE vs rights offering 2. 公式背誦 — 閉卷下背唔出 BEY 公式（懂得用，但記唔起） 3. 英文作文慢 — fill in 題諗英文諗到超時；已教佢用「電報式作答」（ 31 March 2026 — s.60(1), 6 year limit from end of YA ） 強項 ：死規則/條文記憶（M9 稅務條文掌握明顯好過 M7 概念）；計數一旦記得公式就準確 學習行為 ：狀態有波動，有「hotshot」爆發日；會誠實申報「呢題係估嘅」同「超時咗」— 呢個好習慣要維持 作答風格 ：會用中文夾雜英文術語解釋思路，MCQ 直接畀字母 Part 3：考試與計劃 考試日 ：M7 + M9 = 2026 11 20 （仲有 11 週）；M6 + M8 + M10 = 2027 05 20 13 週計劃 （2026 08 19 開始，兩科並行每週各一章）： 週 M7 M9 W1 (8/19–25) Ch1 Financial Environment Ch1 Key Aspects of the Tax System in HK W2 (8/26–9/1) Ch2 Sources of Finance Ch2 Administration of the Tax System W3 (9/2–8) ← 而家 Ch3 Time Value of Money Ch3 Profits Tax（上） W4 (9/9–15) Ch4 Bond Investments Ch3 Profits Tax（下） W5 (9/16–22) Ch5 Equities Valuation Ch4 Salaries Tax（上） W6 (9/23–29) Ch6 CAPM Ch4 Salaries Tax（下） W7 (9/30–10/6) Ch7 Cost of Capital Ch5 Property Tax + Ch6 Personal Assessment W8 (10/7–13) Ch8 Capital Structure Ch7 Stamp Duty W9 (10/14–20) Ch9 Financial Analysis + Ch10 Forecasts Ch8 Cross border Transactions W10 (10/21–27) Ch11 SMA + Ch12 Pricing 弱項重練 W11 (10/28–11/3) Ch13 Investment Appraisal + Ch14 Post Appraisal OTQ drills W12 (11/4–10) Ch15 Performance Measurement + Ch16 Financial Risks 計時操卷 W13 (11/11–19) 總衝刺（Cheat Sheet + Flashcards + 錯題本） 同左 Part 4：進度現況（截至 2026 09 03） 週 M7 分數 M9 分數 W1 3/5 4/5 ✅ W2 2/5 ⚠️（需重測） 4/5 ✅（Q5 半對：識 rule 但無填日期同條文編號） W3 進行中 進行中 Active Retest Queue（未剔除嘅弱點）— 已注入 W3 Quiz： 1. M7 Ch2：短期 vs 長期融資 1 year boundary 2. M7 Ch2：PIPE vs 其他集資渠道（listed? registered? sold to whom? 三步分類法） 3. M7 Ch2：BEY = (Face − Price) ÷ Price × 360 ÷ Days（分母係發行價、用 360 日） 4. M9 Ch2：additional assessment 題必須答「日期 + 條文編號」（s.60(1)，6 年由 YA 結束起計；fraud/wilful evasion 先係 10 年） ⚠️ 2026 09 03 進度對帳（接手 AI 必讀） 學生離開咗一排，用咗另一個 AI 學習，嗰段時間 無跟 HANDOVER、無 quiz 記錄 。 科目 「睇完」進度（自報，未驗證） 「驗證過」進度（有 quiz 分數） 欠債 M7 Ch5 Ch2（2/5，弱） Ch3、Ch4、Ch5 三個 Quiz 未做 M9 Ch2 Ch2（4/5 ✅） Ch3（上）Quiz 未做 規矩：「睇完」唔等於「識」。冇 quiz 分數嘅章節一律當未學過。 接手 AI 第一件事：幫學生追做 M7 Ch3–5 + M9 Ch3（上）四個 Quiz（網站已有，見 Part 5），連帶清走上面 4 條 Retest Queue。 📅 合併後嘅三輪計劃（2026 09 03 起生效，取代舊 W table） 階段 日期 內容 追數週 9/3–9/10 做晒四個欠債 Quiz + 4 條 Retest；M9 停咗 9 日，優先重開 Round 1 9/11–10/11 剩餘 17 章（M7 Ch6–16、M9 Ch3下–8）；每章流程：Study Pack → LP 例題 → Quiz → 批改 → 錯題本 → 下章 Retest。M7/M9 每日交替 Round 2 10/12–11/1 專題攻堅：WACC、NPV/IRR、EVA；DIPN 21 source rules、salaries time apportionment、PA、stamp duty。用 Master Formula Sheet + Master Section List 做主軸，配合 past papers Round 3 11/2–11/19 計時模擬卷（materials repo 有 Module 7/9 past papers）、公式表 + 條文表強記 考試 11/20 — 已鞏固（唔使再測） ：profit maximisation 忽略 timing、EMH weak⊂semi strong⊂strong、香港對 dividends/interest 無 WHT（W2 前 retest 3/3 全對） 已記錄嘅 Model Sentences （喺錯題本度，見 Part 5）：M7 Ch1 兩條、M7 Ch2 三條、M9 Ch1 一條、M9 Ch2 一條。 Part 5：資源位置（全部公開，可直接叫 AI 讀取） 筆記網站（GitHub Pages） ：https://holaming111317 collab.github.io/hkicpa qp notes/ 按 W1–W12 分組；每章三份檔：Study Pack / Quiz / Answers Quiz 頂部有 🔄 Retest Section（錯題重測） 工具表：M7 Master Formula Sheet（16 章公式總表）、M9 Master Section List（8 章條文總表）、考試英文急救詞彙表 GitHub repo（raw markdown） ：https://github.com/holaming111317 collab/hkicpa qp notes Chapters/ 入面係 22 章嘅 .md 原檔（Gemini 可以經 GitHub raw link 直接讀） 錯題本_Error_Log.md = 錯題 + Model Sentences + Retest Queue HKICPA_Progress_Tracker.md = 每週分數 兩本 Learning Pack 原文 ：PDF 喺學生手上，AI 如需要章節原文可叫學生上傳 Part 6：分工建議（畀學生睇）— 2026 09 03 更新版 ⚡ 2026 09 03 起：全職接手模式 — 學生 Kimi 額度有限，日常 tutor 工作由 而家讀緊呢份文件嘅 AI （Gemini 或其他 agent 都得）全權負責，唔使再搵任何人覆核。 工作 邊個做 點做 概念講解、出題、批改、更新三份記錄檔（錯題本/詞彙表/Tracker） 接手 AI 全權 佢輸出更新區塊，你貼上 GitHub 網站更新 全自動（GitHub Actions） .md 一貼上 repo，1–2 分鐘後網站自動更新，唔使任何人推送 Flashcards 自測 你自己（網站 flip cards） 兩輪過篩法 技術支援（Actions 壞咗、repo 問題） Kimi 有額度嗰時先返嚟 Gemini 單人操作嘅每週循環（背咗佢） 1. Gemini 跟網站 Quiz 出題（或直接叫佢出：「出 W4 M7 Ch4 quiz，跟返之前格式」） 2. 你 用英文答（限時 2.5 分鐘/題） 3. Gemini 批改：X/5 + Rule Check + 盲點分析 + Model Sentence 4. Gemini 輸出三份更新區塊：錯題本新 entry、Retest 隊列變動（啱→剔除/錯→帶落下週）、詞彙表新字 5. 你 貼上 GitHub（下面 30 秒教學） 6. GitHub Actions 自動更新網站 ✅ 點樣將 Gemini 嘅更新貼上 GitHub（30 秒，唔使技術知識） 1. 打開 https://github.com/holaming111317 collab/hkicpa qp notes 2. 入 notes/ 資料夾，撳要改嘅檔案（例如 錯題本_Error_Log.md ） 3. 撳右上角 鉛筆 icon（Edit this file） 4. 將 Gemini 畀你嘅更新區塊貼落去（佢會話你知貼喺邊個位置） 5. 撳綠色 Commit changes 掣 6. 等 1–2 分鐘，網站 https://holaming111317 collab.github.io/hkicpa qp notes/ 自動更新 ✅ ⚠️ 唯一規矩：Gemini 改嘅嘢 一定要貼上 GitHub 先算數 — 錯題本、Retest 隊列、分數紀錄全部以 repo 為準。 Part 7：俾 Gemini 睇 Learning Pack 原文（手動上傳指引） 原文 PDF 已經全部存喺 公開 repo holaming111317 collab/hkicpa qp materials （155 個檔，約 111MB；2026 09 03 由 private 轉 public，用戶已知悉並承擔版權風險）。 任何人（包括 AI）都可以透過 raw 直連讀取，例如： https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holaming111317 collab/hkicpa qp materials/main/Module%207_4th%20ed.pdf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holaming111317 collab/hkicpa qp materials/main/Module%209_4th%20ed.pdf 但要講現實：Gemini 對 URL 讀取 PDF 嘅支援唔穩定，最可靠嘅方法仍然係直接喺對話入面 upload PDF。 PDF 喺你自己電腦已經有（即係你當日上傳嗰批），或者喺上面個 repo 下載返都得。 建議做法（每個 module 開一個獨立 chat）： Gemini Chat 上傳檔案 用途 M7 溫書房 Module 7_4th ed.pdf （11MB）+ 本 HANDOVER 文件 出題、批改、解釋概念 M9 溫書房 Module 9_4th ed.pdf （4.3MB）+ 本 HANDOVER 文件 出題、批改、稅例條文查證 （2027 先開）M6 / M8 / M10 各自一個 chat 對應 Module X_4th ed.pdf + HANDOVER 第二輪考試先需要 開場白（貼呢句落新 chat 嘅第一個訊息，連住上面 Part 1 一齊貼）： 特別提醒： Past papers（ Module X Question/Answer .pdf ）同 Panelists' Reports 都喺 repo 入面；想 Gemini 用歷屆試題出題，照樣 upload 落對應 chat 就得。 每個 Gemini chat 有檔案數量/容量上限，所以先好一次過倒晒啲嘢落一個 chat——分 module 開 chat 先係正路。 長 chat 會退化 ：Gemini 免費版對話太長會開始唔記得開頭嘅嘢。每隔兩三個禮拜（或者一發現佢唔跟規則）就開新 chat，重新 upload HANDOVER + PDF，再貼呢句叫佢追返進度：

Financial Management 2 hours 30 minutes 100% OTQs (Objective Type Questions) Closed book, CBE 電腦考 M9 Principles of Taxation 2 hours 30 minutes 100% OTQs (Objective Type Questions) Closed book, CBE 電腦考 ⚠️ 注意：由 December 2025 session 起，M7 及 M9 已由舊制 3 小時書寫卷改為 100% 客觀題（OTQ） 。你上傳的 past papers（Dec 2020 – Dec 2024）屬舊制書寫題， 內容仍然適用 於練習計算與概念，但操卷時我會將題目改編為 OTQ 形式，貼近真實考試。 一、總體策略：四階段推進 階段 週數 目標 Stage 1: 基礎掃描 W1–W9 完成兩科全部章節第一輪（每章走 Phase 1→4 流程） Stage 2: 收尾 + 鞏固 W10–W11 完成 M7 餘下計算重章；M9 進入總複習；錯題重練 Stage 3: 操卷實戰 W12 計時 OTQ drills + past paper 改編題 + 全科 mock Stage 4: 考前衝刺 W13 只溫 Cheat Sheet + Flashcards + 錯題本，不做新題 Profits Tax（下：deductions, depreciation allowances, losses, basis period） ✅ Checkpoint Quiz 1 W5 9/16–22 Ch5 Equities Valuation Ch4 Salaries Tax（上：scope, source, income, benefits in kind） W6 9/23–29 Ch6 Capital Asset Pricing Model Ch4 Salaries Tax（下：deductions, allowances, computation） W7 9/30–10/6 Ch7 Cost of Capital Ch5 Property Tax + Ch6 Personal Assessment ✅ Checkpoint Quiz 2 W8 10/7–13 Ch8 Capital Structure Theories Ch7 Stamp Duty W9 10/14–20 Ch9 Financial Analysis + Ch10 Financial Forecasts Ch8 Cross border Transactions + M9 全科總複習 M9 首輪完成 W10 10/21–27 Ch11 SMA Framework + Ch12 Pricing Strategies M9 弱項重練 + OTQ drill W11 10/28–11/3 Ch13 Investment Project Appraisal + Ch14 Post Appraisal Audit M9 OTQ drill ✅ Mock 1（兩科） W12 11/4–10 Ch15 Performance Measurement + Ch16 Financial Risks + M7 總複習 M9 計時操卷 ✅ Mock 2（兩科） W13 11/11–19 Cheat Sheet + Flashcards + 錯題本總複習（輕量） 同左 🎯 11/20 考試 說明：M7 共 16 章、M9 共 8 章。M9 的 Ch3 Profits Tax 與 Ch4 Salaries Tax 佔全書近半篇幅且為出題核心，故各拆兩週；M7 的 Ch13 Investment Appraisal 與 Ch6/7 CAPM & Cost of Capital 是計算重災區，安排在中後段等你計算手感成熟後攻克。 三、每週學習節奏（4 Phase Study Mode 循環） 每個章節循環如下（建議 M7 放星期一至三、M9 放星期四至六，星期日休息/補落後）： 步驟 你做什麼 我做什麼 ① 指定章節 告訴我「開始 M7 ChX」，我先快速通讀 Learning Pack 對應章節 — ② Phase 1 收 Cheat Sheet （核心架構 3–5 點 + 必背考點 + 2 個易混淆對比） 產出重點梳理 ③ Phase 2 收 8 張雙語 Flashcards ，用 1–2 天背誦 產出閃卡 ④ Phase 3 用 英文、計時、閉卷 完成 OTQ 測驗並交出答案 出題（貼合新制 OTQ 模式） ⑤ Phase 4 收批改報告：評分 + Rule Check + 盲點分析 + Model Sentence 批改並記入錯題本 間隔重溫機制 ：每週日我會用 3–5 條快問快答抽考你「前兩週」的 flashcard 內容，防止遺忘。 四、兩科高分策略要點 M7 Financial Management（計算導向） 必背公式核心 ：TVM/annuity、Bond pricing、Dividend Growth Model、CAPM (Ke = Rf + β(Rm−Rf))、WACC、NPV/IRR、EOQ、profitability ratios 新制 OTQ 下，計算題會拆成「中間步驟選擇題」， 每一步都要識計 ，不能只背 final answer Ch9 ratios、Ch12 pricing、Ch13 NPV 是歷年 Panelists' Report 點名考生弱項，優先操練 M9 Principles of Taxation（規則 + 計算混合） 必背框架 ：Profits Tax s.14/s.16/s.17；Salaries Tax s.8/s.9 + time apportionment；Property Tax s.5；Stamp Duty Heads Tax computation 有固定 proforma（assessable profits → less DA → less losses → tax at 8.25%/16.5% two tiered rates），OTQ 會逐步抽問 2025/26 課稅年度最新 allowance 數字以 Learning Pack 4th ed. Tax Tables 及 Errata 為準（你已上傳 Errata，我出題會跟足） 五、你已上傳的資源（我已盤點） 資源 用途 Module 7_4th ed.pdf / Module 9_4th ed.pdf 主教材，Phase 1–3 的出題依據 M7/M9 Past Papers Q&A（Dec 2020–Dec 2024）+ Pilot Papers Stage 3 操卷材料（我會改編為 OTQ） Panelists' Reports（M7/M9 各期） 分析考官最常扣分位，融入教學 M9 Errata Combined 稅率/免稅額更新依據 New QP Student Handbook 考試規則與 exaimnable scope Suggested Reading Lists 延伸閱讀（有需要先睇） 計劃版本 v1.0（2026 08 19）— 會按你每週進度與答題表現動態調整

text: M7 Financial Management — Master Formula Sheet（累積式總表） 每完成一章自動追加。考前第 13 週呢份就係你嘅終極複習表。 Ch1 Financial Environment（本章以概念為主，公式較少） Net working capital = Total current assets − Total current liabilities Current assets 包括：inventories、trade receivables、prepayments and deposits、cash and cash equivalents Current liabilities 包括：trade payables、short term bank loans、accruals and other payables 應用：衡量短期償債能力與營運資金管理（Week 1 Quiz Q4 實戰過） 本章核心概念對比（詳見 Week 1 Study Pack）：money market vs capital market｜primary vs secondary market｜brokers vs dealers｜marketability vs liquidity｜EMH 三形態（weak / semi strong / strong） Ch2 Sources of Finance 1. Bond Equivalent Yield (BEY) on Commercial Paper Formula: BEY = (Face Value − Issue Price) / Issue Price × 360 / Days to maturity Variables: Face Value = amount repaid at maturity; Issue Price = discounted price paid by investor; Days to maturity = 1–270 days (typical 30) When to apply: pricing/quoting money market instruments (CP) issued at a discount; money market uses a 360 day year . The result is the promised yield (maximum yield if held to maturity; expected return < promised yield when default risk exists). Yield spread = CP yield − T bill yield (compensation for default risk). Text example: (HK$100m − HK$99.55m)/HK$99.55m × 360/30 = 5.424%. 2. Borrowing Base Credit Limit (Line of Credit) Formula: Maximum credit limit = 75% × Accounts Receivable + 50% × Inventory Variables: AR and inventory from the statement of financial position; cash and other current assets are excluded When to apply: bank caps the maximum value of a line of credit using a standard formula; percentages as given in the chapter's Illustrative Example 1 (= HK$51,000,000 from AR 18,536,000 and inventory 74,196,000). 3. Minimum Earnings Required by an Interest Coverage Ratio Covenant Formula: Required earnings before interest = Interest expense × Minimum interest coverage ratio, where Interest expense = Principal × Annual interest rate When to apply: revolving lines of credit impose financial restrictions such as a minimum interest coverage ratio (coverage = earnings before interest / interest). Text example: HK$50m × 9.75% = HK$4,875,000 interest; × 1.75 = HK$8,531,250 required earnings. 4. Net Working Capital (NWC) Formula: NWC = Current Assets − Current Liabilities When to apply: liquidity measurement; gross working capital = current assets (the two terms are the same); most firms have positive NWC. Cash conversion cycle (time from paying for raw materials to collecting cash from sales) measures working capital efficiency — shorter is better. 5. Inventory Turnover and Days in Inventory Formulas: Inventory turnover = Cost of Goods Sold / Average Inventory; Days in inventory = 365 / Inventory turnover When to apply: assessing inventory liquidity/management; high turnover + low days in inventory while meeting customer needs = success. EOQ model minimises the sum of reorder (ordering) costs and carrying costs. Key rules / thresholds to memorise (Ch2): Short term = < 1 year (money market); long term = 1 year (funded debt); leases 1 year = long term financing, ~100% debt financing CP: 1–270 days (typical 30), unsecured, discount; backup line of credit commitment fee ≈ 0.125% p.a.; dealer commission ≈ 5 bp (0.05%); ABCP via SPV, 90–140 days typical; CP ratings A 1 / P 1 / F1 (highest) BA: 1–180 days (typical 90), discount, bank's credit supports it; stamping fee 0.50–0.75% Line of credit: setup fee ≈ 0.50% (also on unused balance); revolving line ≥ 364 days up to 5 years ("evergreen"); prime = floating benchmark, most borrowers "prime plus"; overdraft interest usually higher than bank loan Debt terminology: < 10 yrs = note/MTN; 4–10 yrs = intermediate term bond; 10 yrs = bond/long term bond Bond ratings: highest AAA/Aaa; lowest investment grade BBB/Baa; below = junk/high yield; stable rating philosophy + hierarchy principle Convertible bonds: conversion typically attractive only after share price rises 15–20%; lower coupon; dilution risk; coco bonds convert only when capital conditions trigger (favour issuer) Issuance costs (issue ≥ US$500m): common stock ≈ 3.63% vs non convertible corporate bonds ≈ 0.65%; equity issues virtually always negotiated sales; vanilla bonds cheaper via competitive sales in stable markets VC: staged funding (3–7 stages), convertible preference stock, exit in 3–7 years (strategic buyer / financial buyer / IPO); PE: mature firms, hold 3–5 years, LBO leverage 3–4×; PIPE: unregistered shares at a discount, registration within ~90 days, damages up to 1.5%/month Retained earnings restrictions: legal / contractual / voluntary; internal financing = cheaper, no collateral, no dilution, but smaller amounts Ch3 Time Value of Money and Investing Basics Formula name Formula Variable meanings When to apply Simple Interest Interest = P × i × n P = principal; i = interest rate; n = time Short term situations (typically one year or less); interest on initial principal only Compound Interest Interest = P × (1 + i/n)^(nt) P = principal; i = interest rate; n = number of compounding times per year; t = number of years Most business situations; interest earned on principal plus previously accrued interest Future Value (single sum) FV = P × (1 + i)^n P = principal; i = interest rate per period; n = number of periods Value at a future date of a single amount invested, assuming compound interest (compounding) Present Value (single sum) PV = FV / (1 + i)^n FV = future amount; i = discount rate; n = number of periods Value now of a future amount (discounting); bond prices, notes payable, lease liabilities, capital budgeting PV of Ordinary Annuity PVAn = CF × [1 − 1/(1+i)^n] / i CF = level, equally spaced cash flows; i = discount rate; n = number of periods Equal cash flows received/paid at the END of each period (e.g. loan repayments) FV of Ordinary Annuity FVAn = CF × [(1+i)^n − 1] / i Same as above Terminal value of regular end of period contributions (e.g. savings/retirement plans) Annuity Due adjustment PV(due) = PV(ordinary) × (1+i); FV(due) = FV(ordinary) × (1+i) — Cash flows at the BEGINNING of each period (e.g. apartment rental); always larger than ordinary annuity PV of Perpetuity PVP = CF / i CF = periodic cash flow; i = interest rate Cash flows continuing forever, FIRST payment in one year (preference share dividends, Consols) PV of Perpetuity Due PVP = CF / i + CF — Perpetual cash flows with the first payment IMMEDIATELY PV of Growing Perpetuity PV0 = PMT1 / (k − g) PMT1 = payment in one year; k = effective annual rate; g = constant growth rate Cash flows growing at a constant rate forever; valid ONLY when k g PV of Growing Annuity PV0 = [PMT1 / (k − g)] × [1 − ((1+g)/(1+k))^n] n = terminal period Cash flows growing at constant rate g ending at period n; valid only when k g and growth constant throughout Annual Percentage Rate (APR) APR = periodic rate × number of periods per year e.g. 1.5%/month × 12 = 18% Nominal/quoted rate; excludes compounding; NOT for finance decisions Effective Annual Rate (EAR) EAR = (1 + i/m)^m − 1 i = quoted (nominal) rate; m = number of compounding periods per year True annual cost of borrowing/lending; use in finance decisions; APR = EAR only when m = 1 (annual compounding); higher m → higher EAR Key reference values (24% APR, from source): semi monthly EAR 26.97% monthly 26.82% bi monthly 26.53% quarterly 26.25% semi annually 25.44% annually 24.00%. Discount rate selection: use WACC for average risk projects; adjust the discount rate upward (downward) for projects with higher (lower) risk than the firm's typical projects. Ch4 Introduction to Bond Investments 1. Current Yield (CY) CY = Annual interest ÷ B CY = current yield; B = market price When to apply: quick yield measure ignoring capital gain/loss; also called cash yield / flat yield. Not a true return measure. 2. Yield to Maturity (YTM) B = (i/kb) × [1 − 1/(1+kb)ⁿ] + F/(1+kb)ⁿ B = market price; kb = discount rate / YTM; n = number of periods to maturity; F = amount paid at maturity; i = interest per period When to apply: find the discount rate that makes PV of coupon + principal payments equal to the bond price (solve by financial calculator/trial). Assumes held to maturity, all payments on time, cash flows reinvested at YTM. 3. Bond Valuation Formula (annual coupons) PB = (C/i) × [1 − 1/(1+i)ⁿ] + Fn/(1+i)ⁿ PB = price of the bond; C = coupon payment per period; i = market interest rate; n = periods to maturity; Fn = par value at maturity When to apply: coupon annuity PV + face value PV. Pricing rules: i coupon rate → discount; i < coupon rate → premium; i = coupon rate → par. 4. Semi annual Compounding Formula PB = (C/i) × [1 − 1/(1+i/m)^(mn)] + Fmn/(1+i/m)^(mn) C = annual coupon payment; m = coupon payments per year (semi annual: m = 2); n = years to maturity; i = annual market interest rate; Fmn = face value at maturity When to apply: coupons paid more than once a year — divide coupon and rate by m, multiply years by m (all three must be adjusted consistently). 5. Zero Coupon Bond Pricing PB = Fmn / (1 + i/m)^(mn) PB = price of the bond; Fmn = payment at maturity; i = annual market rate; m = compounding periods per year; n = years to maturity When to apply: bonds with no periodic coupons (deep discount bonds); special case of the compounding formula with all coupons = 0. Most price volatile bond type. 6. Effective Annual Yield (EAY) EAY = (1 + Quoted interest rate / m)^m − 1 Quoted interest rate = simple annual yield (semi annual yield × 2); m = number of compounding periods per year When to apply: to annualise a per period yield correctly (captures compounding); essential when comparing bonds with different compounding frequencies (e.g. European annual vs US semi annual bonds). 7. Realised Yield Mechanics identical to YTM, but equates the PV of actual cash flows (coupons received + sale price) to the original purchase price When to apply: bond sold before maturity — measures the return actually earned over the holding period. Related price volatility rules (bond theorems): Bond prices are negatively related to interest rate movements (rates ↓ → prices ↑). Longer maturity → greater price volatility. Lower coupon rate → greater price volatility. Ch5 Equities Valuation Formula Formula expression Variable meanings When to apply Present value of a stock PV (stock) = PV (dividend) + PV (sale price) — Foundation of all equity valuation; value of any asset = PV of its future cash flows Single period valuation P0 = (D1 + P1) / (1 + R) P0 = current price; D1 = dividend paid at end of period; P1 = stock price at end of period; R = required return for the risk class Stock bought now and sold after one period with known dividend and sale price General dividend valuation model P0 = Σ (t=1→∞) Dt / (1+R)^t Dt = dividend in period t; R = required return Theoretical basis for all dividend models; makes no assumption about dividend pattern or sale date; requires forecasting infinite dividends Zero growth valuation P0 = D / R D = constant cash dividend each period; R = required return Dividends constant forever (g = 0); non growing companies and perpetual preference shares Future dividend under constant growth Dt = D0 × (1 + g)^t; D1 = D0 × (1 + g) D0 = dividend paid in current period; g = constant growth rate Compute any future dividend as input to the models below Constant growth (Gordon) valuation P0 = D1 / (R − g) P0 = current price; D1 = dividend in next period (t = 1); g = constant dividend growth rate; R = required return Mature companies with stable constant dividend growth; valid only if g < R — meaningless if R ≤ g Future stock price (constant growth) Pt = D(t+1) / (R − g) Pt = price at time t; D(t+1) = dividend one period after t Price at any point in time once dividends grow at constant g; implies share price itself grows at rate g Mixed (supernormal) growth valuation P0 = D1/(1+R) + D2/(1+R)² + … + Dt/(1+R)^t + Pt/(1+R)^t, where Pt = D(t+1)/(R − g) Dt = dividends in the non constant growth phase; Pt = terminal price when constant growth begins Firms with two growth stages: supernormal/variable growth early, then stable constant growth g; identify when constant growth starts Preference share with fixed maturity P0 = Σ (D/m)/(1+i/m)^t + P/(1+i/m)^(mn) D = annual preference dividend; P = stated (par) value; i = yield to maturity; m = dividend payments per year; n = years to maturity Preference shares with mandatory retirement / sinking fund / call date — valued like a bond Preference share with no maturity P0 = D / R D = constant cash dividend; R = required rate of return Perpetual preference shares (no maturity) — valued as a perpetuity Implied required return (rearranged Gordon) R = D1 / P0 + g D1/P0 = expected dividend yield; g = growth rate (= capital gains yield under constant growth) Inferring the market's required return from an observed share price Ch6 Capital Asset Pricing Model Name Formula Variable meanings When to apply Capital appreciation return R_CA = (P₁ − P₀) / P₀ = ΔP / P₀ P₁ = price at period 1; P₀ = price at period 0; ΔP = change in price Price change component of holding period return Income return R_I = CF₁ / P₀ CF₁ = cash flow at period 1 (dividend/coupon) Income component of holding period return Total holding period return R_T = R_CA + R_I = (ΔP + CF₁) / P₀ As above Total return over a specific holding period Arithmetic mean AM = ΣRᵢ / n Rᵢ = return in period i; n = number of periods ~12 month horizons; always overstates returns Geometric mean GM = [(1+R₁)(1+R₂)…(1+Rₙ)]^(1/n) − 1 Rᵢ = return of i th period; n = number of periods Compound growth over multiple/longer periods Expected return (probabilities differ) E(R_Asset) = Σᵢ pᵢ·Rᵢ pᵢ = probability of situation i; Rᵢ = return in situation i Probability weighted expected return of an asset Expected return (equal probabilities) E(R_Asset) = ΣRᵢ / n As above When p₁ = p₂ = … = 1/n Total return decomposition R = E(R) + m + ε E(R) = expected return; m = systematic portion; ε = unsystematic portion Splitting actual/realised return into expected + unexpected components Variance (probabilities differ) σ² = Σᵢ pᵢ·[Rᵢ − E(R)]² pᵢ, Rᵢ, E(R) as above Risk (total) of an asset with probability data Standard deviation σ = √σ² — Total risk; normal distribution: ±1σ ≈ 68%, ±2σ ≈ 95%, ±3σ ≈ 99.7% Coefficient of variation CV = σ_Asset / E(R_Asset) σ = standard deviation; E(R) = expected return Risk per unit of return; lower CV preferred (risk minimisation) Modified coefficient of variation CV = σ_Asset / [E(R_Asset) − R_rf] R_rf = risk free rate Risk per unit of excess return over the risk free rate Portfolio expected return E(R_p) = Σᵢ wᵢ·E(Rᵢ) wᵢ = proportion invested in asset i; E(Rᵢ) = expected return on asset i; m = number of assets Weighted average return of a multi asset portfolio Two asset portfolio variance σ²_p = w_A²σ_A² + w_B²σ_B² + 2w_A·w_B·COV(A,B) w_A, w_B = weights; σ_A, σ_B = standard deviations; COV(A,B) = covariance Total risk of a two asset portfolio Covariance COV_AB = Σᵢ pᵢ·[R_Ai − E(R_A)][R_Bi − E(R_B)] R_Ai, R_Bi = returns of A and B under event i How returns of two assets move together Correlation coefficient ρ_AB = COV_AB / (σ_A·σ_B) COV_AB = covariance; σ_A, σ_B = standard deviations −1 ≤ ρ ≤ +1; ρ = +1: no diversification benefit; ρ = −1: can eliminate all risk; typical stocks ρ ≈ 0.65 Beta of an asset βᵢ = ρ_Mi·σᵢ / σ_M = COV(i,M) / σ²_M ρ_Mi = correlation of asset i with market; σᵢ, σ_M = standard deviations of asset i and market; COV(i,M) = covariance with market; σ²_M = market variance Measuring systematic risk; β=1 same as market; β 1 higher; β<1 lower; β=0 zero systematic risk CAPM E(Rᵢ) = R_rf + βᵢ[E(R_m) − R_rf] E(Rᵢ) = expected return of asset i; R_rf = risk free rate (HK: Exchange Fund Bills and Notes); E(R_m) = expected market return; [E(R_m) − R_rf] = market risk premium Required/expected return of a security; economic feasibility test; cost of equity Portfolio beta / Portfolio CAPM β_p = Σᵢ xᵢ·βᵢ ; E(R_p) = R_rf + β_p[E(R_m) − R_rf] xᵢ = weighting of asset i; βᵢ = beta of asset i Expected return of a portfolio under CAPM Security Market Line (SML) kᵢ = R_rf + [E(R_m) − R_rf]·βᵢ kᵢ = required return of asset i; slope = market risk premium Plot of required return vs beta; above SML = undervalued; below SML = overvalued; on SML = correctly priced Capital Allocation Line (CAL/CML) E(r_p) = w_r·E(r_r) + (1 − w_r)·E(r_f) ; Business risk components: variation in unit sales, unit prices, production/selling costs, and the degree of operating leverage. Forwards: customised, OTC, can eliminate basis risk. Futures: standardised, exchange traded, marked to market daily. Ch11 Strategic Management Accounting Framework SMA Core Concepts Strategic management accounting (SMA) = brings together strategic business objectives with management accounting information → forward looking projections and models. When: distinguishing SMA (external focus: cost trends, prices, market share, competitors, suppliers, technologies; sequence of decisions) from traditional management accounting (internal, introspective, single issue/period; originated as an expansion of cost accounting). SMA triangular structure — three considerations: Technical analysis / Behavioural considerations / Cultural considerations. Examined in light of QCT factors: Quality, Cost, Time. Current issues: globalisation of supply/value chains; coordination between SMA (formulates forward looking strategies) and traditional management accounting (implements them); value beyond financial measures (ESG, brand loyalty, consumer opinion — not quantifiable in monetary terms). Strategy cascade: Board of directors sets mission, vision, long term goals (5–10+ years) → senior management formulates strategic plans → implemented via tactics → quantified by annual budgets (planning, control, performance measurement). Business Planning Process — Five Steps (Exhibit 11.1, in order) 1. Develop a strategy; 2. Estimate revenues, expenses and other financial variables; 3. Create an operating budget; 4. Analyse any potential risks and deviations (worst case to best case); 5. Monitor and review performance and results. Planning is ongoing; strategic plans forecast 1–5+ years. Inventory Management Approaches (11.4.1) EOQ model: optimal inventory level minimising shortage + carrying costs (point where carrying costs = shortage costs); assumes constant sales rate → unsuitable for seasonal products. MRP (Materials Requirement Planning): computerised system aligning inventory with production schedules; computes raw materials/in process inventory needed for a given order volume. JIT: goods manufactured/purchased/delivered exactly when needed; near zero inventory; needs close supplier relationships and finely tuned logistics; ideal = delivery straight to shelf. TQM (11.4.2) Goal: zero defects. Four step cycle PDCA (Plan, Do, Check, Act): (1) Identify and plan (find root cause); (2) Take action (implement fix + measurement system); (3) Check the results (before/after testing); (4) Disseminate the information. Repeated continually. Product Life Cycle Costing (11.4.3) Four phases in order: Introduction → Growth → Maturity → Decline. (Maturity: defend market share, downward price pressure → target costing introduced; cash flows may be positive.) Life cycle costing (LCC): tracks/accumulates actual costs and revenues from invention until termination = total cost of ownership; long term view vs traditional cost accounting's focus on immediate accounting periods. Target Costing (11.4.4) — FORMULA Target cost = Market price − Desired profit (Exhibit 11.2). When: prices set by supply and demand → profitability pursued through cost control; target cost must cover ALL production costs over the product's entire life cycle; reverses the traditional design→cost→price procedure. Quality Costing (11.4.5) — Four COQ Categories Total cost of quality = Prevention + Appraisal + Internal failure + External failure costs. Prevention: prevent problems (specifications, QA system/department, TQM training). Appraisal: monitor conformance (supplier pre approvals, audits, verification). Internal failure: defects found BEFORE delivery (rework, defect cause investigation, unusable stock losses). External failure: defects found AFTER delivery (complaints, warranty repairs, return/recall transport). In COQ theory "quality cost" = cost of POOR quality; quality costs may be 10%–30% of sales and 25%–40% of operating expenses; ABC is a proven tool to identify/quantify the four categories. Theory of Constraints (11.4.6) TOC (Goldratt, "The Goal", 1984): identify and manage constraints/bottlenecks → profit rises; fixing constraints beats chasing full capacity. Tools: Five focusing steps (Identify → Exploit → Subordinate → Elevate → Repeat), Thinking processes (What needs changing? What to? What actions?), Throughput accounting. Constraints: internal (demand capacity: equipment, skills, policies) vs external (output market demand → create more demand). Throughput accounting treats inventory as a LIABILITY (vs traditional accounting's ASSET). Throughput Analysis (11.4.7) — FORMULAS Throughput = Revenue − Totally variable expenses. Net profit = Throughput − Operating expenses. ROI = Net profit ÷ Investment (investment = cash invested to increase production capacity). Decision priority: increase throughput (no theoretical upper limit) reduce operating expenses (floor of zero); evaluates investment decisions by impact on the WHOLE company. any quote above this is profitable Key Rules & Concepts Demand based optimum: for each price, profit = (Price − Variable cost) × Quantity demanded − Fixed costs; pick the price with the highest profit. Cost behaviour: variable (proportional to activity), fixed (unchanged), mixed. Traceability: direct vs indirect (common) costs — NOT the same split as variable/fixed; both direct and indirect costs can be fixed or variable. Price taker vs price setter: takers accept market price (petrol, commodities); setters have unique/patented/differentiated products (Intel chips, Starbucks). Psychological pricing: price just below a round number (HK$149,999); customers read left to right; advantages include lower price band perception, easy discounting (ending digit), inventory control. Government policy: price ceilings (maximum) / floors (minimum), taxes, tariffs; predatory pricing may be prohibited — HK Competition Ordinance (Cap. 619), enacted 13 Jan 2013. Skimming = initial price HIGHER than competitors → early adopters → lower price later (iPhone, patented drugs). Penetration = price LOWER than competitors → rapid volume, market share, economies of scale (FMCG 'No Frill', Xiaomi). Opposite directions. Complementary product: one product priced low for volume to boost a high margin complement (razor & blades). Product line: related products priced in combination; captive pricing (KFC side dishes); loss leaders (supermarkets). Volume discounting: lower unit price for large volumes; reasons = attract new customers, competitiveness, lower distribution costs; drawbacks = thinner margins, product devaluation, hard to raise prices later. Price discrimination: same product, different prices. 1st degree = max price per unit; 2nd degree = by quantity consumed; 3rd degree = by customer group. More INELASTIC demand → charge MORE (funeral services). Customer groups must not overlap. Relevant costing: sunk costs irrelevant; opportunity costs included; materials in continuous use → replacement cost; materials not otherwise used → net realisable value; labour at full capacity → lower of overtime premium vs basic pay + contribution forgone; labour below capacity → hourly rate only; absorbed fixed overheads irrelevant. Cost of quality (cost of POOR quality): Preventive, Appraisal, Internal failure, External failure costs. Quality of design (meets customer expectations) vs quality of conformance (matches design specifications). Cheaper to fix internally than after delivery. Environmental costs: Conventional, Hidden (in overheads), Contingent (future clean up), Image and relationship. Oil industry: up to 20% of operating costs. ISO 14001 standard. External market factors: Demand, Competition, Government regulation (+ user group, location, time/perishability). Internal: fixed vs variable cost mix; cost based pricing. ABC four steps: (1) form cost pools by activity; (2) allocate only controllable capacity costs; (3) cost drivers with strongest causal relation; (4) denominator volume = practical capacity → reveals unused capacity. Activity hierarchy: unit level, batch level, product/customer level, facility level. Non profit pricing: Voluntary pricing / PWYW (pay from zero up; German experiment — most paid ~19% below list but volume rose); Ability to pay (banking = "capacity"); Versioning = quality discrimination (suits high fixed / low variable cost, e.g. software); Bundling/memberships capture consumer surplus (= willingness to pay − price paid).
